emails.body: 在新一年里，渠道协同作战能力的提升，仍然是广发银行电子银行工作的重中之重。“通过有机整合各个渠道特色优势，将其无缝链接，重新组合包装，打造出属于广发特色的个性七巧板。” 据广发银行电子银行部负责人介绍，网上银行与手机银行应该是各有特点、各有侧重。如汇款，手机银行更适合小额的、紧急的汇款。广发电子银行先搭建起渠道功能，再考虑渠道裁减，把每个渠道不需要的东西裁减掉。“根据各自渠道的特点实现差异化，真正让七巧板中的每个板都‘巧’，在此基础上加强渠道协同，为客户提供有别于竞争对手的特色服务。” 2013年1月23日，在首届电子支付发展研讨会暨“2012电子支付行业十大新闻”评选中，广发银行一举荣膺“2012年电子支付行业创新奖”、“2012年网民最信赖网银支付品牌奖”两项大奖，这充分标志着广发银行电子银行渠道建设和产品用户体验得到了同业和市场的高。

emails.subject: 欢迎使用 Windows 10
emails.body:
了解“入门”应用、相关支持及如何导航设备

第 1 封（共 3 封）电子邮件

此封电子邮件的内容针对的是 Windows 10 设备。

* 欢迎使用 Windows 10 *

* 入门系列 *

这是一系列电子邮件中的第一封电子邮件，旨在帮助您充分利用 Windows 10。这封电子邮件包含快速入门和运行所需的信息。

******************************

* 这就是您所熟知的 Windows，一切只会越来越好 *

Windows 10 如此熟悉，且简单易用，让您感觉像专家一样。 由于系统已启用自动更新 (1)，因此您将始终拥有最新发布的功能，这意味着 Windows 将只会越来越好。

******************************

* 了解“入门”应用 *

设计“入门”应用的目的是帮助您充分利用 Windows 10。该应用能帮助您上网、导航设备、移动文件、设置打印机和硬件等。 向 Windows 10 添加新功能时，应用将会自动更新 (1)，以帮助您执行这些操作。

[打开“入门”应用]
http://communication.microsoft.com/Key-5802401.C.Ggsh.C.K3.-.HxFD3L

******************************

* Cortana 简介 *

现在，您有了自己的个人助理。 Cortana (2) 能为您提供全天候服务，并与您的 Windows 10 设备搭配使用，帮助您轻松搞定一切。 通过陆续了解有关您的更多内容，Cortana 将会在您的日常生活中变得更加实用。
只需说话或键入，Cortana 将会帮助您：

打开应用 | 发送电子邮件 | 播放音乐
http://communication.microsoft.com/Key-5802401.C.Ggsh.p.K3.-.nFdBMgr

[设置 Cortana]
http://communication.microsoft.com/Key-5802401.C.Ggsh.q.K3.-.nF70LDq

[了解更多内容]
http://communication.microsoft.com/Key-5802401.C.Ggsh.r.K3.-.nF2qJYp

******************************

* 浏览和使用您的设备 *

使用任务栏或 Cortana (2) 进行搜索

搜索网络和设备及访问和分享 OneDrive 上的文件的最简单方式是：通过任务栏中的 Windows 搜索框；或者只需询问 Cortana 即可。

[了解更多内容]
http://communication.microsoft.com/Key-5802401.C.Ggsh.s.K3.-.nFYRGhm


了解设置

更新您的设置，并按自己喜欢的方式对 Windows 10 进行个性化设置。

[打开设置]
http://communication.microsoft.com/Key-5802401.C.Ggsh.F.K3.-.JPmK2P

[了解更多内容]
http://communication.microsoft.com/Key-5802401.C.Ggsh.G.K3.-.JVYMJQ


触摸 (3)或键入

以最自然的方式与您的设备进行互动。

[了解更多内容]
http://communication.microsoft.com/Key-5802401.C.Ggsh.H.K3.-.JZxNlR


上网冲浪

介绍 Microsoft Edge，这是一款能按您的方式执行 Web 工作的新型浏览器。

[打开您的浏览器]
http://communication.microsoft.com/Key-5802401.C.Ggsh.J.K3.-.J9JSHT

[了解有关 Microsoft Edge 的更多内容]
http://communication.microsoft.com/Key-5802401.C.Ggsh.K.K3.-.JfgTkV

******************************

* 随时为您提供帮助 *

是否有疑问或需要某些信息？ 帮助已经内置在设备中。只需使用 Windows 搜索框，Windows 10 将会使用 Cortana (2)，为您提供快速答复和分步教程，或通过“联系支持人员”应用联系到真实的人员。(4)

******************************

* 探索可通过 Microsoft 帐户实现的全部内容 *

通过这一帐户，您可以在所有设备（而不仅仅是 Windows 设备）上随时随地操控已在 OneDrive 上备份的设置、首选项和文件。此外，您只需记住用户 ID 和密码即可。

[更新您的 Microsoft 帐户]
http://communication.microsoft.com/Key-5802401.C.Ggsh.L.K3.-.JlSW0W

******************************

* 加入 Windows 10 相关会话。*

[在微博上关注我们]
http://communication.microsoft.com/Key-5802401.C.Ggsh.Db.K3.-.nGm5xK

[在 Pinterest 上观看我们]
http://communication.microsoft.com/Key-5802401.C.Ggsh.Dc.K3.-.nP4TJ

******************************

(1) 其他软件和/或硬件要求可能会随着更新而有所变化。
(2) Cortana 体验可能会因区域和设备而异。
(3) 取决于硬件。
(4) 选定市场内提供聊天。 全天候提供免费服务电话和聊天支持（英文版）；在延长办工期间提供大多数其他语言。 在中国，针对一对一技术支持收取费用。

[Microsoft]
http://communication.microsoft.com/Key-5802401.C.Ggsh.S.K3.-.nJTqKr1

Microsoft 尊重您的隐私权。欲了解更多内容，请阅读我们的在线[隐私声明]。
http://communication.microsoft.com/Key-5802401.C.Ggsh.T.K3.-.nJPRJN0

Microsoft Corporation
One Microsoft Way
Redmond, WA 98052 


.

emails.subject: 广告: Windows 10： 应用让生活更精彩！
emails.body:
了解 Windows 应用以及这些应用如何使 Windows 10 更加出色。

入门系列

第 2 封（共 3 封）电子邮件

此电子邮件专用于 Windows 10 设备。

* 无限乐趣即将到来 *

在此系列的第二封电子邮件中，您将了解 Windows 10 的内置应用，以及全新 Windows 应用商店中提供的所有内容。
http://communication.microsoft.com/Key-5803401.C.CwWq.Fx.K3.-.31BL2

******************************

* 两个“开始”都是最好的 *
http://communication.microsoft.com/Key-5803401.C.CwWq.Fy.K3.-.8CCp3

“开始”菜单重新回来了，其操作方式与它在 Windows 7 中一样，只需点击屏幕左下方的 Windows 图标即可。

“开始”菜单位于“开始”屏幕的左侧。 您可以将其空间放大或缩小，并固定应用、歌曲和其他内容，就像在 Windows 8 中一样。 

[了解有关“开始”的更多信息]
http://communication.microsoft.com/Key-5803401.C.CwWq.GB.K3.-.nC9tkCB

* 可跨设备运行的出色内置应用 *

Windows 10 带有“地图”、“照片”、“邮件”、“日历”、“音乐”和“电影和电视”(1)，使您畅享更多乐趣，完成更多事情。

所有这些应用都能使用 OneDrive 网盘跨 Windows 10 设备存储和同步您的文件和照片，因此能及时满足您的需要。

[了解详细信息]
http://communication.microsoft.com/Key-5803401.C.CwWq.GH.K3.-.nCF07Ds

******************************

* Windows 应用商店是您的一站式服务商店 *

Windows 应用商店简介：带给您全新的统一购物体验。 获取出色的免费和付费应用、游戏、电影、电视节目和最新的音乐 - 全部经过 Microsoft 认证。(2)

emails.subject: 利用 Windows 10，像专家那样处理多个任务
emails.body:
了解多任务处理、“邮件”和“日历”应用及更多内容。

第 3 封（共 3 封）电子邮件

此电子邮件专用于 Windows 10 设备。

入门系列

* 借助多任务处理完成更多工作 *

在第三封电子邮件中，您将了解如何处理多个任务以及如何将您的所有电子邮件都放置在一个地方。

******************************

* 在操作中心接收您的所有通知 *
 
使用操作中心，您的电子邮件、提醒、更新和重要设置等通知都将位于一个地方，因此，您无需打开单独的应用即可快速操作。

[了解如何使用操作中心]
http://communication.microsoft.com/Key-5814901.C.Gdgd.L8.K3.-.Dm5hCX

******************************
 
* 在任务视图中查看打开的所有内容 *

在一个视图中查看打开的应用、文档和文件，以便轻松管理和切换任务。

[了解详细信息]
http://communication.microsoft.com/Key-5814901.C.Gdgd.L9.K3.-.DtHjfY

******************************

* 多任务处理可提高您的工作效率 *
 
在屏幕中同时贴靠多达 4 个应用，以及跨文档完成工作。 也可以签出多个网站，而无需在它们之间切换。

[了解详细信息]
http://communication.microsoft.com/Key-5814901.C.Gdgd.Lb.K3.-.JcvHkN

******************************

* 创建虚拟桌面以保持井然有序 *

要获得更多空间并保持内容相互分离，您可以创建多个桌面。 例如，当您开始工作时，可在一个桌面上放置文件和文档，而当您要放松娱乐时，可在另一个桌面上放置音乐、照片和游戏。

[了解详细信息]
http://communication.microsoft.com/Key-5814901.C.Gdgd.Lc.K3.-.Jj4K0P

******************************

* 体验全新“邮件”和“日历”应用 *

使用全新的内置“邮件”和“日历”应用，您可以更好地管理收件箱，使每天的生活更有条理。 Microsoft Word 功能已内置到“邮件”应用中，因此您可以按熟悉的方式插入表、添加照片和设置文本格式。 您还可以使用新的导航栏在电子邮件和日历之间轻松地移动。

[了解详细信息]
http://communication.microsoft.com/Key-5814901.C.Gdgd.Ld.K3.-.JqGMGQ
 
邮件
[打开“邮件”应用]
http://communication.microsoft.com/Key-5814901.C.Gdgd.Lf.K3.-.nJgw34c
 
日历
[打开“日历”应用]
http://communication.microsoft.com/Key-5814901.C.Gdgd.Lg.K3.-.nJbX1qb

******************************

* Cortana 可帮助您完成更多工作 *

借助您的个人数字助理 Cortana(1)，您可以发送电子邮件、设置提醒或约会、播放音乐等等，而所有这些都不需要您中断当前正在做的事情。

[了解详细信息]
http://communication.microsoft.com/Key-5814901.C.Gdgd.Lh.K3.-.nJ5l0M9

******************************

* 让 Cortana 帮助您完成搜索 *

搜索您的设备上的应用、游戏和娱乐内容的最简单方式是：使用任务栏中的 Cortana。(1) 您还可以使用 Cortana 搜索网络，以及访问和共享您保存在 OneDrive 中的文件。

[了解详细信息]
http://communication.microsoft.com/Key-5814901.C.Gdgd.Lj.K3.-.nJWbWr7

******************************

*“入门”应用随时为您提供帮助 *

设计“入门”应用的目的是帮助您充分利用 Windows 10。该应用能帮助您上网、导航设备、移动文件、设置打印机和硬件等。 只要我们向 Windows 10 中添加新功能，该应用就会自动更新(2)，以帮助您获得这些功能。

[打开“入门”应用]
http://communication.microsoft.com/Key-5814901.C.Gdgd.Lk.K3.-.nJRDVN6

******************************

* 加入 Windows 10 相关会话。*

[在微博上关注我们]
http://communication.microsoft.com/Key-5814901.C.Gdgd.Ll.K3.-.nJL2S65

[在 Pinterest 上观看我们]
http://communication.microsoft.com/Key-5814901.C.Gdgd.Lm.K3.-.nJFsQs4

******************************

(1) Cortana 发布时将在选定市场提供；Cortana 体验可能因区域和设备而异。
(2) 其他软件和/或硬件要求可能会随更新而不断变化。

[Microsoft]
http://communication.microsoft.com/Key-5814901.C.Gdgd.Lp.K3.-.nHmKKt1

商务英语是以适应职场生活的语言要求为目的，内容涉及到商务活动的方方面面。商务英语课程不只是简单地对学员的英文水平、能力的提高，它更多地是向学员传授一种西方的企业管理理念、工作心理，甚至是如何和外国人打交道，如何和他们合作、工作的方式方法，以及他们的生活习惯等，从某种程度上说是包含在文化概念里的。商务英语面向的人群大致可以分为两类人，一是身处商务工作环境，二是希望将来在商务工作环境中工作。
退订

退订

emails.subject: 《Hi-English》每日读,升职加薪无压力（AD）
emails.body:
来上课大家都会带上很多工具，比如笔记本，字典，但最重要的工具是：勇气，你必要要有开口说的勇气。不要害怕去使用你所学的语言。在我的课上，我会让我的学生去在发言前做一些准备，这样可以最大程度的调动他们的积极性去组织他们学过的词汇，发挥出最好的流利度。”为孩子报读一个短期的英语培训班不仅能提高孩子的口语能力，还能让孩子在学习中结识更多同龄的朋友，开拓视野，增长自信心。韦博国际英语特别开设了暑期短期班，让学员在丰富多彩的教学形式中高效地提高英语技能，既要让孩子玩得有趣，又能学得有益。
退订

emails.subject: 平安跟你分享一份秘密，30万元的出行意外险等着你（AD）
emails.body:
社会需要好人，需要每一个人的善良。当当善良屡屡遭遇“碰瓷”，屡遭亵渎和挑衅，献爱心都要变得小心翼翼，社会信任和善良的大厦面临崩塌的时刻该咋办？面对这样的问题，笔者认为若要让社会善良被人恶性消费的现象减少或是绝迹需要相关部门、社会公众每一个人的努力。敢于“碰瓷”社会善良者之所以如此肆无忌惮，完全是因为败露之后付出的成本极低，一个道歉，甚至仅一个狡辩，就可以敷衍塞责，溜之大吉。因此，为了防止社会善良被无故消费，相关部门应当拿起法律的武器，严格执法，对有此行为者严惩不贷，严厉打击，让怀有不轨之心者有所忌惮。除此之外，作为社会公众应当多点理性，多点思考，尽力做到帮助那些真正需要帮助的人，而不可盲目跟风，浪费自己的善心。
如果邮件内容无法正常显示，请点击查看| 我要退订|我要投诉

emails.body:
最近，网路上流行着出国旅游攻略住宿省钱六大狠招。它们分别是：沙发客（couch surfing），换房旅游（House swapping），房屋照看（Caretaking/House sitting），入住修道院（Staying in Convents or Monasteries），入住当地家庭（Renting Rooms from local families），以及蹭房（Freeloading）。在入住期间，有几点是可能要询问酒店工作人员的。第一点就是WIFI， 用英语问这里有没有免费wifi？可以这么说：Is there free wifi here? 然后是问密码What is the password?第二点，就是问能不能加床？Can we add a bed to our room?
退订

我们都有这样的经验，在学校时学习很好的同学，大多长大进入社会后会变得平庸。相反，那些学业上差一些的同学，在进入社会后却如鱼得水。很多人对此解释叫做“混得开”！我仔细想一想，却觉得当年后进的同学，多半早早学会了学校以外的“生活课”，当生活的大幕一拉开，这些同学便立刻跃上舞台翻腾起来；而那些只学会语文数学英语的同学，一旦这些学习产品停产，变会出现对生活的各种不适应。

如今，每一次回忆那段日子，依然觉得感激不尽，也许现在看来很多人都觉得那样的日子无比的艰难，没有什么乐子，可是，在我心里，竟然因为苦过，却也对当今每一天的生活更加充满了感激，对幸福的追求变得更加简单而纯粹。有时候甚至觉得，那样的日子都过去了，人生还有什么更难的事情呢，这样想着自己都像注入了满满的正能量。

emails.subject: 您在获奖榜首，奖品请领取（AD）
emails.body: 图片看不到，请点查看不想收到，请点退订重庆是名副其实的山城，城在山上，山在城中，少有平地，许多楼房倚山而建。这些地基不在同一条水平线的建筑，参差错落，层叠耸起，构成了极具立体感的视觉。怪不得余秋雨先生赞叹“重庆是一座站立着的城市”。山城的道路立体交织，盘旋蜿蜒，时低时高，坡多弯多。时而上坡，时而下坡，时而拐弯，时而在立交桥上打圈圈，让你难辨东南西北。

emails.body:
初春的阳光如水晶般透明，车子从雨城区的北郊进入一个“空翠湿人衣”的峡谷。竹叶在目光所及处跳跃,阳光在翠绿的竹叶尖眨眼。不宽的公路蜿蜒在绿色画廊,半山上处处都是笔直粗壮的竹林，随着海拔的升高,路在土崖上蔓延，崖上崖下的竹子给公路搭建了长长的凉棚。虽然是早春，这里处处被绿覆盖，深涧的水哗哗地响。

emails.subject: Steam 隐私政策更新
emails.body:
亲爱的客户：
我们对 Steam
隐私政策进行了更新，使其更清晰地展示客户资料的用途。以下是我们的改动摘要：
  * 我们纳入了欧盟《通用数据保护条例》（GDPR）以及欧盟和瑞士隐私护盾框架的概念。
  * 我们对 Valve
处理客户数据的原因和处理的数据类型，以及数据保护权益的相关信息进行了阐释。
若要了解更多隐私实践相关的信息，请前往 Steam
网站上查阅新的隐私政策。

emails.subject: An idea selected for you, 张: The surprising habits of original thinkers
emails.body:
An idea selected for you, 张: The surprising habits of original
thinkersHow do creative people come up with great ideas? Organizational
psychologist Adam Grant studies "originals": thinkers who dream up new
ideas and take action to put them into the world. In this talk, learn three
unexpected habits of originals -- including embracing failure. "The
greatest originals are the ones who fail the most, because they're the ones
who try the most," Grant says. "You need a lot of bad ideas in order to get
a few good ones." <https://www.ted.com>

张, here is a TED Talk selected for you: Why helmets don't prevent
concussions -- and what mightWhat is a concussion? Probably not what you
think it is. In this talk from the cutting edge of research, bioengineer
(and former football player) David Camarillo shows what really happens
during a concussion -- and why standard sports helmets don't prevent it.
Here's what the future of concussion prevention looks like.
<https://www.ted.com>

Hi 张,

emails.subject: 张, we selected this idea just for you: Why I'm done trying to be "man enough"
emails.body:
张, we selected this idea just for you: Why I'm done trying to be "man
enough"Justin Baldoni wants to start a dialogue with men about redefining
masculinity -- to figure out ways to be not just good men but good humans.
In a warm, personal talk, he shares his effort to reconcile who he is with
who the world tells him a man should be. And he has a challenge for men:
"See if you can use the same qualities that you feel make you a man to go
deeper," Baldoni says. "Your strength, your bravery, your toughness: Are
you brave enough to be vulnerable? Are you strong enough to be sensitive?
Are you confident enough to listen to the women in your life?"
<https://www.ted.com>

Hi 张,
Here’s an idea we think you’ll appreciate. Why I'm done trying to be
"man enough" <https://explore.ted.com/watch/UUOdR7ZaQKf9> by Justin Baldoni
was recommended by *Elizabeth Levesque*:

This talk is so important for the world to see – not just for men, but
for humanity as a whole. Justin can help lead men forward into unknown
territory. This is one of the best TED talks I've seen. I hope that men
share it.
*Elizabeth Levesque*

emails.body:
张, we selected this idea just for you: Get comfortable with being
uncomfortableLuvvie Ajayi isn't afraid to speak her mind or to be the one
dissenting voice in a crowd, and neither should you. "Your silence serves
no one," says the writer, activist and self-proclaimed professional
troublemaker. In this bright, uplifting talk, Ajayi shares three questions
to ask yourself if you're teetering on the edge of speaking up or quieting
down -- and encourages all of us to get a little more comfortable with
being uncomfortable. <https://www.ted.com>

Hi 张,
Here’s an idea we think you’ll appreciate. Get comfortable with being
uncomfortable <https://explore.ted.com/watch/gDeZaQAHPSSe> by Luvvie Ajayi
was recommended by *Alex Cancellaire*:

When I see a woman like Luvvie speak up for her rights — and insist that
other women do so as well — I feel a certain thrill. She inspires me so
much, and I will take her advice to heart as I go on my own journey!
*Alex Cancellaire*, TED Staff, United States

confusing) technology, Bettina Warburg describes how the blockchain will

system for exchanging value. <https://www.ted.com>

emails.subject: An idea selected for you, 张: Teach girls bravery, not perfection
emails.body:
An idea selected for you, 张: Teach girls bravery, not perfectionWe're
raising our girls to be perfect, and we're raising our boys to be brave,
says Reshma Saujani, the founder of Girls Who Code. Saujani has taken up
the charge to socialize young girls to take risks and learn to program --
two skills they need to move society forward. To truly innovate, we cannot
leave behind half of our population, she says. "I need each of you to tell
every young woman you know to be comfortable with imperfection."
<https://www.ted.com>

Hi 张,
Here’s an idea we think you’ll appreciate. Teach girls bravery, not
perfection <https://explore.ted.com/watch/mqjxRVwCJeI6> by Reshma Saujani
was recommended by *Yulia Petrina*:

I study psychology, and I'm aware of the necessity of failure when writing
code — so I'm familiar with the ideas that Reshma shares. But she
delivers them in such a vivid way that I saw myself in the girls she
describes, and I actually cried. We must teach girls it's okay to fail
sometimes.
*Yulia Petrina*, London

emails.body:

is killing Black women. A first step toward change...T. Morgan Dixon and
Vanessa Garrison, founders of the health nonprofit GirlTrek, are on a
mission to reduce the leading causes of preventable death among Black women
-- and build communities in the process. How? By getting one million women
and girls to prioritize their self-care, lacing up their shoes and walking
in the direction of their healthiest, most fulfilled lives.

emails.subject: An idea selected for you, 张: How judges can show respect
emails.body:
An idea selected for you, 张: How judges can show respectIn halls of
justice around the world, how can we ensure everyone is treated with
dignity and respect? A pioneering judge in New Jersey, Victoria Pratt
shares her principles of "procedural justice" -- four simple, thoughtful
steps that redefined the everyday business of her courtroom in Newark,
changing lives along the way. "When the court behaves differently,
naturally people respond differently," Pratt says. "We want people to enter
our halls of justice ... and know that justice will be served there."
<https://www.ted.com>

Hi 张,
Here’s an idea we think you’ll appreciate. How judges can show respect
<https://explore.ted.com/watch/Qs7gG3vXmUf8> by Victoria Pratt was
recommended by *Lorena Aviles*:

For me, the beauty of this talk rests in Judge Pratt’s view of the court
as a place for the rehabilitation of humans, rather than strictly the
punishment of criminals. Not only does she advocate for overthrowing
traditional thinking in the court, but she also warns us against stripping
others of dignity in our everyday lives -- a message much too needed at a
time when the news are replete with human rights violations and tragedies. 
*Lorena Aviles*, Curation Team Coordinator, TED, New York, United States 

*How judges can show respect* <https://explore.ted.com/watch/Qs7gG3vXmUf8>
Victoria Pratt <https://explore.ted.com/watch/Qs7gG3vXmUf8>
<https://explore.ted.com/watch/Qs7gG3vXmUf8>
Watch now ► <https://explore.ted.com/watch/Qs7gG3vXmUf8>Add to list

 This idea has been viewed *1,113,454* times, and translated into *10*
languages.

 It was recommended to you because of your interest in *Innovation* and
*Communication*. (Pro tip: you can adjust your interests
<https://www.ted.com/settings/recommends> any time you like, or see all
your past recommendations in your dashboard
<https://www.ted.com/dashboard/recommends>.) 

 *What did you think?*
<https://explore.ted.com/watch/f4bdrXjiPbCF?src=email_feedback>
We’d love to know what you thought about What makes a good life? Lessons
from the longest study on happiness
<https://explore.ted.com/watch/f4bdrXjiPbCF?src=email_feedback>.
I liked it <https://explore.ted.com/feedback/f4bdrXjiPbCF/1> • I didn’t
like it <https://explore.ted.com/feedback/f4bdrXjiPbCF/0>

 *Parting thought*
“In a market where people believe in cycles … you have to wait all the
way for the cycle to fail before you [say] there's something wrong.”
*Eddie Obeng*, Business Educator, from Eddie Obeng: Smart failure for a
fast-changing world
<https://explore.ted.com/parting_thought/Qs7gG3vXmUf8/eddie_obeng_smart_failure_for_a_fast_changing_world>

 *Questions?* Hit reply and we’ll be in touch.

Today’s recommendation is...We'll go to the doctor when we feel flu-ish
or a nagging pain. So why don’t we see a health professional when we feel
emotional pain: guilt, loss, loneliness? Too many of us deal with common
psychological-health issues on our own, says Guy Winch. But we don’t have
to. He makes a compelling case to practice emotional hygiene — taking
care of our emotions, our minds, with the same diligence we take care of
our bodies. <https://www.ted.com>

Here’s an idea we think you’ll appreciate. Why we all need to practice
emotional first aid <https://explore.ted.com/watch/U8wpV5uRSC4R> by Guy

emails.subject: 张, here's your newest recommendation
emails.body:
张, here's your newest recommendationOur culture is obsessed with
happiness, but what if there's a more fulfilling path? Happiness comes and
goes, says writer Emily Esfahani Smith, but having meaning in life --
serving something beyond yourself and developing the best within you --
gives you something to hold onto. Learn more about the difference between
being happy and having meaning as Smith offers four pillars of a meaningful
life. <https://www.ted.com>

Hi 张,
Here’s an idea we think you’ll appreciate. There's more to life than
being happy <https://explore.ted.com/watch/7hxOonqaon46> by Emily Esfahani
Smith was recommended by *Aruzhan Ilanbay*:

Belonging, transcendence, having a purpose and telling good stories -- all
of these construct and give color to your life. Emily Esfahani Smith had a
tremendous impact on me.
*Aruzhan Ilanbay*

emails.subject: 张, your recommendation for Nov 16th is...
emails.body:
张, your recommendation for Nov 16th is...Around the world, hundreds of
thousands of lost ancient sites lie buried and hidden from view. Satellite
archaeologist Sarah Parcak is determined to find them before looters do.
With the 2016 TED Prize, Parcak is building an online citizen-science tool
called GlobalXplorer that will train an army of volunteer explorers to find
and protect the world's hidden heritage. In this talk, she offers a preview
of the first place they'll look: Peru -- the home of Machu Picchu, the
Nazca lines and other archaeological wonders waiting to be discovered.
<https://www.ted.com>

Hi 张,
Here’s an idea we think you’ll appreciate. Hunting for Peru's lost
civilizations -- with satellites
<https://explore.ted.com/watch/zsxOkLHxMDV8> by Sarah Parcak was
recommended by *Isaac Luis Bringas Gozme*:

I'm a student of archaeology from Perú, and I am inspired by the work
Sarah does in my country. This video gives a tantalizing introduction to
the wonders she hopes to uncover here.
*Isaac Luis Bringas Gozme*

*Hunting for Peru's lost civilizations -- with satellites*
<https://explore.ted.com/watch/zsxOkLHxMDV8>

writer Anne Lamott decided to write down everything she knew for sure. She
dives into the nuances of being a human who lives in a confusing,
beautiful, emotional world, offering her characteristic life-affirming
wisdom and humor on family, writing, the meaning of God, death and more.

emails.body:
张, your recommendation for Dec 7th is...Most of us will do anything to
avoid being wrong. But what if we're wrong about that? "Wrongologist"
Kathryn Schulz makes a compelling case for not just admitting but embracing
our fallibility. <https://www.ted.com>

Hi 张,
Here’s an idea we think you’ll appreciate. On being wrong
<https://explore.ted.com/watch/z8dwDuL58Gyg> by Kathryn Schulz was
recommended by *Nadia Goodman*:

When I need to remember to make space for the possibility that I might not
be right, I return to this talk.There's always another perspective worth
considering. Kathryn has given us a wise, thoughtful, and helpful reminder
to admit that we could be wrong.
*Nadia Goodman*, Social Media Director, TED, Brooklyn NY, United States 

*On being wrong* <https://explore.ted.com/watch/z8dwDuL58Gyg>
Kathryn Schulz <https://explore.ted.com/watch/z8dwDuL58Gyg>
<https://explore.ted.com/watch/z8dwDuL58Gyg>
Watch now ► <https://explore.ted.com/watch/z8dwDuL58Gyg>Add to list
<https://explore.ted.com/watch_later/z8dwDuL58Gyg>

 This idea has been viewed *4,348,288* times, and translated into *40*
languages.

 (Pro tip: you can adjust your interests
<https://explore.ted.com/settings/recommends?rid=z8dwDuL58Gyg> any time you
like, or see all your past recommendations in your dashboard
<https://explore.ted.com/dashboard/recommends?rid=z8dwDuL58Gyg>.) 

 *What did you think?*
<https://explore.ted.com/watch/lNwdkLVMMGLj?src=email_feedback>
We’d love to know what you thought about Trial, error and the God complex
<https://explore.ted.com/watch/lNwdkLVMMGLj?src=email_feedback>.
I liked it <https://explore.ted.com/feedback/lNwdkLVMMGLj/1> • I didn’t
like it <https://explore.ted.com/feedback/lNwdkLVMMGLj/0>

 *Parting thought*
“Because women don't look like men, they don't look like that
male-pattern heart disease that we've spent the last 50 years understanding
… they're not recognized for their heart disease.”
*C. Noel Bairey Merz*, Physician, from Noel Bairey Merz: The single biggest
health threat women face
<https://explore.ted.com/parting_thought/z8dwDuL58Gyg/noel_bairey_merz_the_single_biggest_health_threat_women_face>

emails.subject: 张, your top recommendation is...
emails.body:
张, your top recommendation is...What do you want to be when you grow up?
Well, if you're not sure you want to do just one thing for the rest of your
life, you're not alone. In this illuminating talk, writer and artist Emilie
Wapnick describes the kind of people she calls "multipotentialites" -- who
have a range of interests and jobs over one lifetime. Are you one?
<https://www.ted.com>

Hi 张,
Here’s an idea we think you’ll appreciate. Why some of us don't have
one true calling <https://explore.ted.com/watch/RtaH3eEuQHGN> by Emilie
Wapnick was recommended by *Khoi Le Minh*:

Many people do not even know that it is a blessing, instead of an
abnormality, to be a "multipotentialite." This talk could liberate and
inspire people, like it has for me.
*Khoi Le Minh*

*Why some of us don't have one true calling*
<https://explore.ted.com/watch/RtaH3eEuQHGN>
Emilie Wapnick <https://explore.ted.com/watch/RtaH3eEuQHGN>
<https://explore.ted.com/watch/RtaH3eEuQHGN>
Watch now ► <https://explore.ted.com/watch/RtaH3eEuQHGN>Add to list
<https://explore.ted.com/watch_later/RtaH3eEuQHGN>

languages.

(Pro tip: you can adjust your interests
<https://explore.ted.com/settings/recommends?rid=RtaH3eEuQHGN> any time you
like, or see all your past recommendations in your dashboard
<https://explore.ted.com/dashboard/recommends?rid=RtaH3eEuQHGN>.) 

 *What did you think?*
<https://explore.ted.com/watch/rnNhgYiwTaBY?src=email_feedback>
We’d love to know what you thought about Embrace the near win
<https://explore.ted.com/watch/rnNhgYiwTaBY?src=email_feedback>.
I liked it <https://explore.ted.com/feedback/rnNhgYiwTaBY/1> • I didn’t
like it <https://explore.ted.com/feedback/rnNhgYiwTaBY/0>

 *Parting thought*
“When you can't smoke, if you stand and stare out of the window on your
own, you're an antisocial, friendless idiot. If you stand and stare out of
the window on your own with a cigarette, you're a philosopher.”
*Rory Sutherland*, Advertising guru, from Rory Sutherland: Perspective is
everything
<https://explore.ted.com/parting_thought/RtaH3eEuQHGN/rory_sutherland_perspective_is_everything>

张, your recommendation for Dec 28th is...Luck is rarely a lightning
strike, isolated and dramatic -- it's much more like the wind, blowing
constantly. Catching more of it is easy but not obvious. In this insightful
talk, Stanford engineering school professor Tina Seelig shares three
unexpected ways to increase your luck -- and your ability to see and seize
opportunities. <https://www.ted.com>

Hi 张,
Here’s an idea we think you’ll appreciate. The little risks you can
take to increase your luck <https://explore.ted.com/watch/FqCEuFZbOJyq> by
Tina Seelig was recommended by *Dusan Curic*:

This talk brings up some interesting points about ways we can
“engineer” our luck. Tina made me realize that there are things we
neglect every day that could make a difference in our lives.
*Dusan Curic*

*The little risks you can take to increase your luck*
<https://explore.ted.com/watch/FqCEuFZbOJyq>

emails.subject: 张, your top recommendation is...
emails.body:
张, your top recommendation is...Check out your latest talk recommendation
from TED Recommends. <https://www.ted.com>

Hi 张,
Here’s an idea we think you’ll appreciate. The search for "aha!"
moments <https://explore.ted.com/watch/qu8ytqDEPEPT> by Matt Goldman was
recommended by *Corey Hajim*:

It is so heartbreaking to see your child -- creative, open, aspirational --
be crushed by a school environment that decides way too early what they are
good at and where they are deficient. Some people overcome discouraging
teachers and systems, as Matt did, but others get worn down. The world
doesn't need a lot of adults who can memorize and recite facts and figures
or even people who fit in one box or another. I love that Matt's mission is
to encourage creativity, curiosity and collaboration among school kids.
*Corey Hajim*, Business Curator, TED, New York NY, United States

张, here’s why you should watch this talk...Check out your latest talk
recommendation from TED Recommends. <https://www.ted.com>

Hi 张,
Here’s an idea we think you’ll appreciate. How to gain control of your
free time <https://explore.ted.com/watch/syiFmxrVmRcB> by Laura Vanderkam
was recommended by *Francisco Diez*:

As someone who deals with multiple side projects at any given time, I have
always feel harried and struggling to find time for the things I love.
Laura’s talk made me rethink the way I approach my calendar and the time
I have. With some simple steps and examples we can all grasp, she sets
forward a way to make time for the things that really matter in our lives.
*Francisco Diez*

张, your top recommendation is...Pianist and composer Jennifer Lin gives a
magical performance, talks about the process of creativity and improvises a
moving solo piece based on a random sequence of notes.
<https://www.ted.com>

Hi 张,
Here’s an idea we think you’ll appreciate. Improvising on piano, aged
14 <https://explore.ted.com/watch/RgEZbCui70hu> by Jennifer Lin was
recommended by *Ryan Harvey*:

At age 14, Jennifer is a piano virtuoso and an artistic tour de force. She
composes an entire piece right on the spot, based on an arbitrary ordering
of 5 notes. This talk amazes me every time I see it. I think you'll love it
too.
*Ryan Harvey*, Data Engineer, TED, Mandeville LA, United States

that made him miserable, and spent the next four years wondering how to

deceptively simple talk about finding out what matters to you — and then
getting started doing it. <https://www.ted.com>

Some among them had sworn by their God to put her to a fearful death if ever they made her captive, for they held her in superstitious awe, and thought the spell of the Frankish successes would be broken if she were slain. Another apprehension I had was, the cruel usage wemight meet with from them if we fell into their hands; then thestory of Amboyna came into my head, and how the Dutch might perhapstorture us, as they did our countrymen there, and make some of ourmen, by extremity of torture, confess to crimes they never wereguilty of, or own themselves and all of us to be pirates, and sothey would put us to death with a formal appearance of justice; andthat they might be tempted to do this for the gain of our ship andcargo, worth altogether four or five thousand pounds. emails.subject: 张, here’s why you should watch this talk...
emails.body:
张, here’s why you should watch this talk...Using examples from
vacations to colonoscopies, Nobel laureate and founder of behavioral
economics Daniel Kahneman reveals how our "experiencing selves" and our
"remembering selves" perceive happiness differently. This new insight has
profound implications for economics, public policy -- and our own
self-awareness. <https://www.ted.com>

Hi 张,
Here’s an idea we think you’ll appreciate. The riddle of experience vs.
memory <https://explore.ted.com/watch/IIVGGrJKuJJE> by Daniel Kahneman was
recommended by *Jason Bender*:

I would call this talk from Daniel Kahneman a 'must-watch' for anyone
interested in how mind and memory play a role in consciousness. This
perception-altering talk will make you reconsider how your sense of self
connects to the memories of your experiences.
*Jason Bender*, Dir. Digital Strategy, TED 

*The riddle of experience vs. memory*
<https://explore.ted.com/watch/IIVGGrJKuJJE>

张, here’s why you should watch this talk...In every workplace, there
are three basic kinds of people: givers, takers and matchers.
Organizational psychologist Adam Grant breaks down these personalities and
offers simple strategies to promote a culture of generosity and keep
self-serving employees from taking more than their share.
<https://www.ted.com>

Hi 张,
Here’s an idea we think you’ll appreciate. Are you a giver or a taker?
<https://explore.ted.com/watch/jCcCZczelwqh> by Adam Grant was recommended
by *Jane Marks- Hastig*:

organization succeed. Funny, relevant, and insightful.

张, here’s why you should watch this talk...Working hard but not
improving? You're not alone. Eduardo Briceño reveals a simple way to think
about getting better at the things you do, whether that's work, parenting
or creative hobbies. And he shares some useful techniques so you can keep
learning and always feel like you're moving forward. <https://www.ted.com>

Hi 张,
Here’s an idea we think you’ll appreciate. How to get better at the
things you care about <https://explore.ted.com/watch/18VjRCT9G0P4> by
Eduardo Briceño was recommended by *Shanti Alexandra*:

I loved Eduardo's diagram comparing the "learning zone" and the
"performance zone" — in fact, I copied it into my notebook so I can look
at it often and remind myself about the learning process. I think this is a
really valuable way to think about improving performance.
*Shanti Alexandra*, TED community member

emails.subject: 张, your recommendation for May 3rd is...
emails.body:
张, your recommendation for May 3rd is...Lux Narayan starts his day with
scrambled eggs and the question: "Who died today?" Why? By analyzing 2,000
New York Times obituaries over a 20-month period, Narayan gleaned, in just
a few words, what achievement looks like over a lifetime. Here he shares
what those immortalized in print can teach us about a life well lived.
<https://www.ted.com>

Hi 张,
Here’s an idea we think you’ll appreciate. What I learned from 2,000
obituaries <https://explore.ted.com/watch/RsAorweb4WWt> by Lux Narayan was
recommended by *Barbara Hignite*:

Although some might consider this a morbid topic, I found this talk
interesting and upbeat. An obituary should be seen as a data source that
inspires curiosity.
*Barbara Hignite*, TED community member

<https://explore.ted.com/watch/RsAorweb4WWt>

emails.subject: What idea will you discover next, 张?
emails.body:
What idea will you discover next, 张?Check out your latest talk
recommendation from TED Recommends. <https://www.ted.com>

Hi 张,
Here’s an idea we think you’ll appreciate. How to spot a liar
<https://explore.ted.com/watch/8iw7Uq04bFWb> by Pamela Meyer was
recommended by *Laura Sanchez*:

This talk offers interesting information and examples on how to spot a
liar. Pamela's opening statement is so true—we are all liars, whether we
like to admit it or not. We are made up of small lies that may not be
harmful—but we may also be attached to larger and more destructive lies.
*Laura Sanchez*, TED community member

talk, Larry Smith pulls no punches when he calls out the absurd excuses
people invent when they fail to pursue their passions.
<https://www.ted.com>

Here’s an idea we think you’ll appreciate. Why you will fail to have a
great career <https://explore.ted.com/watch/NTni2GYtIYMA> by Larry Smith

making excuses and go out and fight for a truly great job.
*Corey Hajim*, Business Curator

emails.subject: 张, your top recommendation is...
emails.body:
张, your top recommendation is...In a culture where being social and
outgoing are prized above all else, it can be difficult, even shameful, to
be an introvert. But, as Susan Cain argues in this passionate talk,
introverts bring extraordinary talents and abilities to the world, and
should be encouraged and celebrated. <https://www.ted.com>

Hi 张,
Here’s an idea we think you’ll appreciate. The power of introverts
<https://explore.ted.com/watch/g7UKtPU7piNh> by Susan Cain was recommended
by *Victor Pisano*:

A delightful expression of honesty and humility​ that provides the
opportunity to change your course of thinking as a leader. Kudos Susan
Cain, I sincerely enjoyed this, just sorry I was so late to the show!
*Victor Pisano*, TED community member

*The power of introverts* <https://explore.ted.com/watch/g7UKtPU7piNh>
Susan Cain <https://explore.ted.com/watch/g7UKtPU7piNh>
<https://explore.ted.com/watch/g7UKtPU7piNh>
Watch now ► <https://explore.ted.com/watch/g7UKtPU7piNh>Add to list
<https://explore.ted.com/watch_later/g7UKtPU7piNh>

 This idea has been viewed *22,268,015* times, and translated into *46*
languages.

 (Pro tip: you can adjust your interests
<https://explore.ted.com/settings/recommends?rid=g7UKtPU7piNh> any time you
like, or see all your past recommendations in your dashboard
<https://explore.ted.com/dashboard/recommends?rid=g7UKtPU7piNh>.) 

 *What did you think?*
<https://explore.ted.com/watch/7H6gRid9balB?src=email_feedback>
We’d love to know what you thought about How to build (and rebuild) trust
<https://explore.ted.com/watch/7H6gRid9balB?src=email_feedback>.
I liked it <https://explore.ted.com/feedback/7H6gRid9balB/1> • I didn’t
like it <https://explore.ted.com/feedback/7H6gRid9balB/0>

 *Parting thought*
“It's a good thing to get poetry off the shelves and more into public
life.”
*Billy Collins*, Poet, from Billy Collins: Everyday moments, caught in time
<https://explore.ted.com/parting_thought/g7UKtPU7piNh/billy_collins_everyday_moments_caught_in_time>

 *Questions?* Hit reply and we’ll be in touch.
<https://www.ted.com>Copyright © 2019 TED Conferences LLC. All rights
reserved.
Need more info? Email us: contact@ted.com <mailto:contact@ted.com>
Unsubscribe
<https://explore.ted.com/unsubscribe/recommendations?rid=g7UKtPU7piNh>

emails.subject: 张, here’s why you should watch this talk...
emails.body:
张, here’s why you should watch this talk...At the end of our lives,
what do we most wish for? For many, it's simply comfort, respect, love. BJ
Miller is a hospice and palliative medicine physician who thinks deeply
about how to create a dignified, graceful end of life for his patients.
Take the time to savor this moving talk, which asks big questions about how
we think on death and honor life. <https://www.ted.com>

Hi 张,
Here’s an idea we think you’ll appreciate. What really matters at the
end of life <https://explore.ted.com/watch/PMTF5u4s2zAi> by BJ Miller was
recommended by *K Thom*:

In a nut shell, this talk hits on every salient point regarding the nature
of human suffering with honesty and dignity – a perspective of our
existence we rarely take the time to explore.
*K Thom*, TED community member

*What really matters at the end of life*
<https://explore.ted.com/watch/PMTF5u4s2zAi>
BJ Miller <https://explore.ted.com/watch/PMTF5u4s2zAi>
<https://explore.ted.com/watch/PMTF5u4s2zAi>
Watch now ► <https://explore.ted.com/watch/PMTF5u4s2zAi>Add to list
<https://explore.ted.com/watch_later/PMTF5u4s2zAi>

 This idea has been viewed *9,420,575* times, and translated into *34*
languages.

 It was recommended to you because of your interest in *Health*. (Pro tip:
you can adjust your interests
<https://explore.ted.com/settings/recommends?rid=PMTF5u4s2zAi> any time you
like, or see all your past recommendations in your dashboard
<https://explore.ted.com/dashboard/recommends?rid=PMTF5u4s2zAi>.) 

 *What did you think?*
<https://explore.ted.com/watch/gvXYh65dfc7D?src=email_feedback>
We’d love to know what you thought about The revolutionary power of
diverse thought
<https://explore.ted.com/watch/gvXYh65dfc7D?src=email_feedback>.
I liked it <https://explore.ted.com/feedback/gvXYh65dfc7D/1> • I didn’t
like it <https://explore.ted.com/feedback/gvXYh65dfc7D/0>

 *Parting thought*
“It’s very painstaking work, but the best things come in small
packages.”
*Willard Wigan*, Micro-sculptor, from Willard Wigan: Hold your breath for
micro-sculpture
<https://explore.ted.com/parting_thought/PMTF5u4s2zAi/willard_wigan_hold_your_breath_for_micro_sculpture>

 *Questions?* Hit reply and we’ll be in touch.

reserved.

emails.subject: What idea will you discover next, 张?
emails.body:
What idea will you discover next, 张?In the early days of digital culture,
Jaron Lanier helped craft a vision for the internet as public commons where
humanity could share its knowledge -- but even then, this vision was
haunted by the dark side of how it could turn out: with personal devices
that control our lives, monitor our data and feed us stimuli. (Sound
familiar?) In this visionary talk, Lanier reflects on a "globally tragic,
astoundingly ridiculous mistake" companies like Google and Facebook made at
the foundation of digital culture -- and how we can undo it. "We cannot
have a society in which, if two people wish to communicate, the only way
that can happen is if it's financed by a third person who wishes to
manipulate them," he says. <https://www.ted.com>

Hi 张,
Here’s an idea we think you’ll appreciate. How we need to remake the
internet <https://explore.ted.com/watch/PcQNxoDAKOZB> by Jaron Lanier was
recommended by *David Biello*:

I worry a lot about the internet and its affect on my brain. Jaron and his
friends helped to build the internet, and he feels the same way. So who
better to teach us how to fix the problem, than from the person who created
it in the first place?
*David Biello*, Science Curator, TED 

*How we need to remake the internet*
<https://explore.ted.com/watch/PcQNxoDAKOZB>
Jaron Lanier <https://explore.ted.com/watch/PcQNxoDAKOZB>
<https://explore.ted.com/watch/PcQNxoDAKOZB>
Watch now ► <https://explore.ted.com/watch/PcQNxoDAKOZB>Add to list

languages.

future*, and *Communication*. (Pro tip: you can adjust your interests
<https://explore.ted.com/settings/recommends?rid=PcQNxoDAKOZB> any time you
like, or see all your past recommendations in your dashboard
<https://explore.ted.com/dashboard/recommends?rid=PcQNxoDAKOZB>.) 

 *What did you think?*
<https://explore.ted.com/watch/PMTF5u4s2zAi?src=email_feedback>
We’d love to know what you thought about What really matters at the end
of life
<https://explore.ted.com/watch/PMTF5u4s2zAi?src=email_feedback>.
I liked it <https://explore.ted.com/feedback/PMTF5u4s2zAi/1> • I didn’t
like it <https://explore.ted.com/feedback/PMTF5u4s2zAi/0>

 *Parting thought*
“For one week, what did the world see? CNN was saying that Palestinians
were dancing in the streets. Were they? Let’s look at the Palestinian
television and find out.”
*Brewster Kahle*, Digital librarian, from Brewster Kahle: A free digital
library
<https://explore.ted.com/parting_thought/PcQNxoDAKOZB/brewster_kahle_builds_a_free_digital_library>

 *Questions?* Hit reply and we’ll be in touch.

emails.subject: What idea will you discover next, 张?
emails.body:
What idea will you discover next, 张?What does it look like when someone
in Sweden brushes their teeth or when someone in Rwanda makes their bed?
Anna Rosling Rönnlund wants all of us to find out, so she sent
photographers to 264 homes in 50 countries (and counting!) to document the
stoves, bed, toilets, toys and more in households from every income bracket
around the world. See how families live in Latvia or Burkina Faso or Peru
as Rosling Rönnlund explains the power of data visualization to help us
better understand the world. <https://www.ted.com>

Hi 张,
Here’s an idea we think you’ll appreciate. See how the rest of the
world lives, organized by income
<https://explore.ted.com/watch/8ydcx7xztEA6> by Anna Rosling Rönnlund was
recommended by *Samantha Zerman*:

Anna Rosling Ronnlund opened my eyes to the big differences, but also the
great similarities, in living situations across the globe. You will
definitely look at the world around you with new eyes once you're done with
this talk. 
*Samantha Zerman*, Editorial Content Specialist, TED 

*See how the rest of the world lives, organized by income*
<https://explore.ted.com/watch/8ydcx7xztEA6>
Anna Rosling Rönnlund <https://explore.ted.com/watch/8ydcx7xztEA6>

张, here’s why you should watch this talk...Check out your latest talk
recommendation from TED Recommends. <https://www.ted.com>

Hi 张,
Here’s an idea we think you’ll appreciate. The biology of our best and
worst selves <https://explore.ted.com/watch/EoNXT2KCDu8S> by Robert
Sapolsky was recommended by *Martin Marquis*:

Sapolsky focuses on the genetics of violence and benevolence, and carefully
contextualizes how environmental factors impact how we behave. As a
sociologist, I really appreciated that Sapolsky pointed out how complex it
can be to explain our behavior. His talk was not only insightful but
engaging.
*Martin Marquis*, TED community member

emails.subject: 张, here’s why you should watch this talk...
emails.body:
张, here’s why you should watch this talk...How often does technology
interrupt us from what we really mean to be doing? At work and at play, we
spend a startling amount of time distracted by pings and pop-ups -- instead
of helping us spend our time well, it often feels like our tech is stealing
it away from us. Design thinker Tristan Harris offers thoughtful new ideas
for technology that creates more meaningful interaction. He asks: "What
does the future of technology look like when you're designing for the
deepest human values?" <https://www.ted.com>

Hi 张,
Here’s an idea we think you’ll appreciate. How better tech could
protect us from distraction <https://explore.ted.com/watch/3TqOOVhZXgQV> by
Tristan Harris was recommended by *Dan Bernier*:

I find Tristan's perspective deeply inspiring. In this talk, he discusses
how we can improve products to form more meaningful offline relationships
rather than optimize to keep people's attention online. I believe this
message is more important than ever. If tech companies are serious about
having positive impacts on the world and not simply increasing people's
screen time, they should take this message to heart.
*Dan Bernier*, Back-end Engineer, TED 

*How better tech could protect us from distraction*
<https://explore.ted.com/watch/3TqOOVhZXgQV>
Tristan Harris <https://explore.ted.com/watch/3TqOOVhZXgQV>
<https://explore.ted.com/watch/3TqOOVhZXgQV>

 *What did you think?*
<https://explore.ted.com/watch/EoNXT2KCDu8S?src=email_feedback>
We’d love to know what you thought about The biology of our best and
worst selves
<https://explore.ted.com/watch/EoNXT2KCDu8S?src=email_feedback>.
I liked it <https://explore.ted.com/feedback/EoNXT2KCDu8S/1> • I didn’t
like it <https://explore.ted.com/feedback/EoNXT2KCDu8S/0>

 *Parting thought*
“HIV brings out the best and the worst in humanity, and the laws reflect
these attitudes.”
*Shereen El Feki*, Arab sexuality expert, from Shereen El-Feki: HIV -- how
to fight an epidemic of bad laws
<https://explore.ted.com/parting_thought/3TqOOVhZXgQV/shereen_el_feki_how_to_fight_an_epidemic_of_bad_laws>

emails.subject: 张, here’s why you should watch this talk...
emails.body: Did you know that almost 150 million people worldwide are born intersex -- with biology that doesn't fit the standard definition of male or female? (That's as many as the population of Russia.) At age 10, Emily Quinn found out she was intersex, and in this wise, funny talk, she shares eye-opening lessons from a life spent navigating society's thoughtless expectations, doctors who demanded she get unnecessary surgery -- and advocating for herself and the incredible variety that humans come in. (Contains mature content)

emails.subject: 张, here’s why you should watch this talk...
emails.body: Salman Khan talks about how and why he created the remarkable Khan Academy, a carefully structured series of educational videos offering complete curricula in math and, now, other subjects. He shows the power of interactive exercises, and calls for teachers to consider flipping the traditional classroom script -- give students video lectures to watch at home, and do "homework" in the classroom with the teacher available to help.

    https://www.voscreen.com or “Mail Us” button on “Profile” section of Voscreen apps.



 Have fun! 

 Voscreen Team

emails.subject: 欢迎使用 iCloud
emails.body:
欢迎使用 iCloud（由云上贵州运营）

您的 Apple ID 是 2645471525@qq.com。

iCloud 现在会安全地备份您的 iPad，确保您不会丢失重要信息。iCloud 会自动存储您的所有照片和视频、文稿、通讯录等，使这些内容保持最新，以便您随时可以在您的所有设备上访问这些内容的最新版本。


==========


# iCloud 云备份
iCloud 每天通过 Wi-Fi 自动备份您的 iPhone 和 iPad，以保护这些设备上的信息。如果您丢失或更换了 iPad，可以借助 iCloud 云备份功能在新设备上将您的信息恢复原样。
了解更多信息: https://support.apple.com/zh-cn/HT203977



# iCloud 照片
您拍摄的所有照片和视频都会被妥善保存，您还可以在任意设备上访问这些内容。iCloud 甚至可以在您需要时帮助您释放 iPad 上的空间，具体方式是：将根据屏幕调整的较小版本保留在您的设备上，而将完整分辨率版本保留在 iCloud 中。
了解更多信息: https://www.apple.com/cn/icloud/photos/


# iCloud 云盘
任何类型的文件都能存储在 iCloud 中，并在您所有设备上保持最新状态。您甚至可以直接在 iPhone 上访问 Mac 台式电脑中的文件。 
了解更多信息: https://www.apple.com/cn/icloud/icloud-drive/

iPhone、iPad、Mac、iCloud.com 和 PC 上均提供 iCloud 云盘。从 iOS App Store 获取 iCloud 云盘应用。


# iCloud 储存空间
供您存储所有重要数据的空间。

iCloud 云备份、iCloud 照片和 iCloud 云盘都使用 iCloud 储存空间。您可以免费获取 5 GB 储存空间。如果您需要更多储存空间，可以选取适合自己的方案。


# 家人共享
与家庭成员共享您购买的音乐、电影、电视节目、图书和 App。共享家庭相簿中的照片并在家庭日历中添加项目。您还可以通过“查找” App 定位或锁定丢失的 iPhone、iPad 或 iPod touch。
了解更多信息: https://www.apple.com/cn/icloud/family-sharing/

购买 Apple Music 家庭订阅后，家庭成员（最多六位）便拥有独立且无限制访问 Apple Music 的权限。


# 查找
定位、锁定或抹掉您丢失的 iPhone、iPad 和 iPod touch，防止他人使用或出售您的设备。
了解更多信息: https://www.apple.com/cn/icloud/find-my-iphone.html

提供的内容因国家或地区而异。


# 邮件、日历、通讯录、备忘录、Keynote 讲演和 Pages 文稿等
有了 iCloud，您可以随时访问您的收件箱、日历、通讯录和其他重要信息。邀请您的朋友和家人在 iCloud 中协作处理备忘录、Keynote 讲演、Pages 文稿和 Numbers 表格中的文稿，以便他们进行编辑并查看您所做的更改。


# 在您的其他设备上设置 iCloud
在您的所有设备上登录并设置 iCloud，这样您便可以从您使用的任何设备访问您的照片、视频、文稿等。 

## 在 iOS 上设置
https://www.apple.com/cn/icloud/setup/ios.html

## 在 Mac 上设置
https://www.apple.com/cn/icloud/setup/mac.html

## 在 PC 上设置
https://www.apple.com/cn/icloud/setup/pc.html

iCloud 是 Apple 的一项服务。中国内地的 iCloud 由云上贵州运营。
Apple ID： https://appleid.apple.com/choose-your-country/
支持： https://www.apple.com/support/icloud/ww
条款与条件： https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/icloud/ww/
客户隐私政策： https://www.apple.com/legal/privacy/szh/

emails.body:
New tech, RTX games, and more!
CATCH UP ON ALL THE ANNOUNCEMENTS <http://nvemail.nvidia.com/s0Ql1ps09BS20N0SzU20l0S>
NVIDIA CEO, Jensen Huang, just revealed the all-new GeForce RTX 30 Series graphics cards, powered by the NVIDIA Ampere architecture, plus RTX coming to Fortnite and Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War, and many new features for gamers and creators. Catch up on all the news.
RTX 30 Series <http://nvemail.nvidia.com/An1G0zNB20SlsUS00p0s09S>
Watch the Event <http://nvemail.nvidia.com/s0Ql1ps09BS20N0SzU20l0S>
FORTNITE
WITH RTX
Ray tracing, DLSS and NVIDIA Reflex are coming to Fortnite. Hitch a ride on the RTX Battle Bus.
LEARN MORE <http://nvemail.nvidia.com/I0s1RN90pzU3Sl2S0l0BS00>
CALL OF DUTY
WITH RTX
We’ve partnered with 
Call of Duty to bring ray tracing, DLSS, and NVIDIA Reflex to Call of Duty: 
Black Ops Cold War.
LEARN MORE <http://nvemail.nvidia.com/tlSU2S1kN90pA00SBz000sp>
CYBERPUNK 2077 
WITH RTX
Experience ray tracing and DLSS in our new trailer for Cyberpunk 2077 captured on GeForce RTX 30 Series.
LEARN MORE <http://nvemail.nvidia.com/HN0020S0SUF9kSz1psB00ul>
NVIDIA
REFLEX
Acquire targets faster, react quicker, and improve aim through a revolutionary suite of technologies built to measure and optimize system latency for competitive games.
LEARN MORE <http://nvemail.nvidia.com/f00nl0p09t01sB2SNSSHU0z>
NVIDIA
BROADCAST
The NVIDIA Broadcast app upgrades your livestreams, voice chats, and video calls with powerful AI effects like noise removal and virtual background.
LEARN MORE <http://nvemail.nvidia.com/rz0u0S2n0BIp9SNsU01S0l0>
UP YOUR
CREATIVE GAME
Take your creative projects to the next level with GeForce RTX 30 Series GPUs. AI-accelerated. Backed by the NVIDIA Studio platform. And built to perform—fast.
LEARN MORE <http://nvemail.nvidia.com/p0z00N0sLS0S1xSBlp0U9n2>
8K HDR: A NEW PINNACLE
GeForce RTX 3090 graphics cards are the world’s first to let you play, capture, and watch in 8K HDR.
LEARN MORE <http://nvemail.nvidia.com/JB2pNS0ysS0SMn90lU001z0>
WATCH DOGS: LEGION WITH RTX
Check out highlight from JX3, feel the the power from RTX.
LEARN MORE <http://nvemail.nvidia.com/NB00WNSl001sUlS08Sz092p>
MINECRAFT WITH RTX BETA
New ray-traced worlds and beta update now available for Windows 10. Build, create, and explore your Minecraft worlds like never before with RTX technology.
LEARN MORE <http://nvemail.nvidia.com/qsSN0l19pD0Szk02B0Us00S>

emails.subject: 张, here’s why you should watch this TED talk...
emails.body: Sleep is your life-support system and Mother Nature's best effort yet at immortality, says sleep scientist Matt Walker. In this deep dive into the science of slumber, Walker shares the wonderfully good things that happen when you get sleep -- and the alarmingly bad things that happen when you don't, for both your brain and body. Learn more about sleep's impact on your learning, memory, immune system and even your genetic code -- as well as some helpful tips for getting some shut-eye.

emails.subject: 张, your recommendation for November 22, 2020 is...
emails.body: To those who feel like they don't belong: there is beauty in being a misfit. Author Lidia Yuknavitch shares her own wayward journey in an intimate recollection of patchwork stories about loss, shame and the slow process of self-acceptance. "Even at the moment of your failure, you are beautiful," she says. "You don't know it yet, but you have the ability to reinvent yourself endlessly. That's your beauty."

emails.subject: 张, here’s why you should watch this TED talk...
emails.body: In long-term relationships, we often expect our beloved to be both best friend and erotic partner. But as Esther Perel argues, good and committed sex draws on two conflicting needs: our need for security and our need for surprise. So how do you sustain desire? With wit and eloquence, Perel lets us in on the mystery of erotic intelligence.

emails.subject: 少数人-公告
emails.body:
Hi, zxx

VMess(v2ray)协议下线预告：

一、VMess（即v2ray）协议将在6月1日全面下线：
由于我们的主流节点已经全面接入IEPL专线，并且在3月1日正式淘汰了年久失修的SSR协议，亦不再需要傻大黑粗的VMess（即v2ray）协议
Shadowsocks(注意不是ShadowsocksR)拥有比VMess更好的效率和更佳的udp性能，在未来将作为我们的主流协议使用

上述信息已在1月1日通过Twitter:@ssrbase、Telegram:@shaoshuren提前发布过预告
由于本站用户众多，本条公告将通过邮件在5月15日下午开始至5月16日上午结束发送

二、当您收到公告时该做些什么操作呢？
若您正在使用Windows的v2rayN客户端，请在6月1日前进入网站更换为Clash或SSTap客户端使用
若您正在使用Android的v2rayNG客户端，请在6月1日前进入网站更换为Clash或Sagernet客户端使用
若您已经在使用Shadowrocket、Clash系列客户端并且正在使用其中的VMess节点时，请在收到请在6月1日前更新一次订阅并且只使用非VMess节点即可（关于如何更新订阅，请参考相应教程页面最后的“可能遇到的疑问”）

三、6月1日之后还有哪些客户端能使用？
iOS：Shadowrocket、PotatsoLite、Stash、Quantumult/X
Android：Clash(CFA)、Sagernet
Windows：Clash(CFW)、SSTap、Netch
macOS：ClashX
其中的Clash系列（包含CFW、CFA、ClashX、Stach等）目前已经非常完善，后续将作为长期客户端使用。

我们的官网是：
https://ccav.ac.cn

emails.subject: 少数人-公告
emails.body:
Hi, zxx

一、节点在5月29日凌晨已经全部恢复！
但是因为提前下线了VMess节点，有部分用户可能仍旧无法使用
这里再次发送全体邮件通知，希望没有打扰到您，感谢您的理解和支持！

二、当您看到此公告时该做些什么操作呢？
若您正在使用Windows的v2rayN客户端，请立即更换为Clash或SSTap客户端使用
若您正在使用Android的v2rayNG客户端，请立即更换为Clash或Sagernet客户端使用
若您的Clash或者ClashX客户端显示超时，请更新一次配置文件即可（如何更新配置请看教程页面最后）

若您已经在使用Shadowrocket客户端：
当只有VMess节点的情况下，请先断开连接，然后根据教程页面第二个步骤重新添加订阅
如果有VMess节点也有IEPL节点，但还是用不了，请更新一次订阅即可（如何更新订阅请看教程页面最后）

三、VMess节点下线之后还有哪些客户端能使用？
iOS：Shadowrocket、PotatsoLite、Stash、Quantumult/X
Android：Clash(CFA)、Sagernet
Windows：Clash(CFW)、SSTap、Netch
macOS：ClashX
其中的Clash系列（包含CFW、CFA、ClashX、Stach等）目前已经非常完善，后续将作为长期客户端使用。

如果您还是不明白，请登录网站与我们联系，请务必附带客户端截图，谢谢！

emails.body:
本次评估为徐州工程学院发起，诚邀你积极参与
若你以后不想收到此类邮件，请点击 这里 拒绝。打扰见谅
亲爱的电气工程及其自动化专业的张潇潇同学：
你好， 徐州工程学院为从能力素养增值、学习投入、专业认知、职业成熟度等多角度出发，了解学生年度成长，跟踪评价过程，帮助学校进一步做好在校生的教学，生活，求职服务工作，于近期开展大四学年学生成长项目的评价。请大家配合完成调研，感谢大家支持！
对于积极完成问卷的同学，我们将与之分享更多期刊以表感谢。
可查看学校官网通知：http://pgzx.xzit.edu.cn/85/2e/c252a165166/page.htm
评价操作步骤：
1、通过移动终端（手机或者电脑）进入答题链接：
https://xscz.mycosresearch.net/login.aspx?uspell=xzit&entry=invite
或者扫描二维码答题：
2、进入登录界面后输入学生本人学号或本邮箱地址，验证无误后即可开始答题。
温馨提示：若出现无法正常登陆、答题过程中有疑问或对本次调研有任何意见/建议，可反馈至邮箱（xzit@chinahigheredu.net）进行咨询。
郑重承诺：本次调研将对学生个人信息严格保密，问卷所收集到的相关信息仅作学校分析研究使用（技术支持由麦可思公司提供）。请广大学生积极配合，如实填写。
再次感谢你的信任和支持！
徐州工程学院

emails.subject: 关于蓝桥杯大赛获奖选手申领《工业和信息化人才岗位能力评价证书》的通知
emails.body:
同学你好！
    为更好地建立赛证融通机制，提升蓝桥杯大赛对参赛院校以及获奖选手的支持及服务水平，大赛组委会特推出证书申领增值服务：自第十一届蓝桥杯大赛起（含第十一届），省赛及决赛获奖选手可申领 《工业和信息化人才岗位能力评价证书》。
    《工业和信息化人才岗位能力评价证书》是依据工业和信息化部人才交流中心系列产业人才岗位能力要求标准，从专业知识、技术技能、工程实践和综合能力四个维度制定的一套人才考核与评价体系。证书自 2019 年推出以来，已经发布工业互联网、人工智能等十个产业的岗位能力评价标准，获得广大社会的高度认可。
    具体申领要求及操作流程，可详见邮箱附件。

 	* 文献鸟 Pro

	* NIH经费数据库
	* PubMed中英对照版
	* 大分析
	* 流畅谷歌学术
	* 文献引用网络
	* 预印文献推送

emails.subject: 潇潇, Writing Assistant helps you write better papers
emails.body:
潇潇,

	Have you ever found yourself in the following situations? 

 	* rewriting and paraphrasing paragraphs copied from past papers and
grants
 	* editing and rewriting manuscripts written by international
collaborators or students
 	* looking for sophisticated synonyms for a given word
 	* struggling in writing perfect English (if English is not your
native language)

	Writing and rewriting papers can be a difficult and time-consuming
process, something that we as researchers understand all too well. To
help with this, we have created Writing Assistant, a new app designed
to make the process easier. She is able to help you with: 

 	* changing simple words to more advanced synonyms (e.g. cheap to
affordable)
 	* rewriting and paraphrasing a given sentence(s) in professional
English
 	* converting sentence fragments (e.g. words and phrases) to full
sentences
 	* converting non-English text to professional English
 	* correcting typos and grammar errors

	Examples: 

	Before: fNIRS is better than fMRI because it's cheap and easy to
carry.
 After: fNIRS is more affordable and portable than fMRI, making it a
more practical option. 

	Before: internet, too many opinions, conflict, no listen to each
other, polarized
 After: The internet has brought about a deluge of opinions, which has
lead to increased conflict as people struggle to be heard. Instead of
listening to each other, people have become polarized, only valuing
opinions that confirm their own. 

	Before: 部分宋朝文人，经济，改革，过于激进
 After: Some Song Dynasty literati advocated for reform, but their
ideas were too radical for many people. 

	To learn more, including more examples, please visit the details. 

	Request to try (log in required) 

	Please don't hesitate to contact us if you have any questions or
feedback. We hope Stork will help you write better papers. 

	 Stork Team

emails.subject: ZXX! Z-Library fundraising campaign
emails.body:
Hello, ZXX!

You've downloaded 1 book(s) and article(s) using our service in the past 6 months.If you can make a donation [mirror] to support our work at this time, we would be extremely grateful.

Z-Library is one of the largest online libraries in the world that contains over 11,179,413 books and 84,837,000 articles. We aim to make literature accessible to everyone.

Only thanks to your support over the past six months, the following important updates have been implemented: moderation interface for users, recruited a big team of moderators, which resulted in improving the quality of the book collection; made a selection of booklists for the categories, added over 100 languages to filter and translated our Android app in to 27 languages.Many visual changes have also taken place, such as redesigned book requests section, new Z-Library letters, improved “My uploads” and “Add book” pages, completely reworked the "Report a problem" option. Moreover, numerous invisible but essential technical updates have been made.

Your active support gives strength to our Team and inspires to work. Each donated dollar is not only money for us, but it is also the confidence that you really need our project!

On 15 September 2022, as in March and September of each year, we launched additional fundraising to project maintenance and development. We will be extremely thankful for every dollar that will be donated. Furthermore, UNLIMITED downloads (for 1 month) are available for ALL contributors who will donate during the fundraising period. The fundraising will run until 1 October 2022

Millions of people use Z-Library every month for their purposes — this shows us that we are on the correct track. But it will be difficult to achieve our goals without your help. Z-Library is a non-profit project that exists at its founders' expense, and with your support.

Please consider making a donation.



Z-Library Team

You have received this letter because of your registration at https://b-ok.com/. If you want to be removed from this mailing list - UNSUBSCRIBE

emails.body:

Ever have feedback for us? Send us an email at support@mathpix.com or tweet at us!

Sincerely,
The Mathpix Team

emails.subject: PDF page selection, collaborative editing, Spectra update, and more
emails.body:
You can now upload a portion of a PDF for conversion to DOCX / LaTeX / Markdown, instead of converting an entire PDF. 


** PDF page selection
------------------------------------------------------------
You can now upload a portion of a PDF for conversion to DOCX / LaTeX / Markdown, instead of converting an entire PDF. Simply drag and drop a PDF into the Snip web app (https://snip.mathpix.com) , and provide the page range of interest. You can even specify multiple page ranges separated by commas, as shown here:


** Collaborative editing
------------------------------------------------------------
You can now invite users to edit a Note by clicking the “Share” button and providing email addresses for your intended recipients:

The recipients can then accept the invitations that are sent to their email. The Note owner can remove a user's access at any time (this can be found in the “Share” dropdown menu as well):

You can distinguish between owned Notes and shared Notes via the new dropdown filter:

Collaboration is available in the web and mobile apps. Collaboration is implemented using a simple last-write-wins algorithm, the same algorithm that we use for syncing notes for individual users between mobile to web:


**
Snip improvements
------------------------------------------------------------
* Added an auto-complete feature to the editor:

* Added support for proofs / theorems / lemmas / unnumbered sections in Mathpix Markdown and updated our VS Code extension (https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=mathpix.vscode-mathpix-markdown) :

* Added Snip editing to the mobile (iOS (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/mathpix-snip/id1445642260) and Android (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mathpix.snip&hl=en_US≷=US&pli=1) ) apps:

* Improved our syntax highlighting for code blocks
* You can now drag each panel of the editor to resize it
* Added support in Mathpix Markdown to configure image size (more details in our documentation here: https://mathpix.com/docs/mathpix-markdown/figures)
* Added support for the LaTeX command \pagebreak to Mathpix Markdown: add this command and the page break will be reflected in your LaTeX or DOCX output document


** PDF bugfixes
------------------------------------------------------------
* Fixed conversion bugs for LaTeX and PDF with LaTeX for # and £ characters
* Fixed line ordering issue in PDF conversion
* Improved overall robustness of PDF conversion


** Spectra update: Winners announced!
------------------------------------------------------------
We now announce the winners of the latest Spectra writing competition.
* A New Paradigm for Exploiting Pre-trained Model Hubs by Kaichao You  (https://spectra.mathpix.com/article/2022.09.00043/a-new-paradigm-for-exploiting-pre-trained-model-hubs)
* Spiking Neural Network : Towards Brain-inspired Computing by Weihua He  (https://spectra.mathpix.com/article/2022.09.00050/spiking-neural-network--towards-brain-inspired-computing)
* Text Generation Models - Introduction and a Demo using the GPT-J model by Srishti Saha  (https://spectra.mathpix.com/article/2022.09.00106/text-generation-models---introduction-and-a-demo-using-the-gpt-j-model)

All cash rewards for competition winners are $2000 and they will be rewarded within 2 weeks. All eligible submissions were given Mathpix Pro for 12 months free of charge. A special thank you to those who submit interesting content to Spectra!

	今天为您介绍一下我们的“听文献”高级功能。（试听朗读效果）


	我们知道，科研工作往往需要处理大量的文献。然而，在忙碌的工作中，有时候您可能会发现没有足够的时间阅读最新的文献，或者在开车、坐车或者疲劳的时候无法集中精力阅读。因此，我们推出了“听文献”高级功能，帮助您在这些场合下更加高效地了解最新的文献。


	“听文献”高级功能有以下几个好处： 

	1.
不受时间和场所限制：在不适合阅读的时候（比如车上、或者眼睛疲惫时），还可以了解最新文献。
 2.
提高英文听力、掌握单词（特别是术语）的标准发音：听文献可以帮助您更好地掌握文献中的术语和标准发音，提高英文听力。
 3.
增强对文献的记忆：有时候阅读速度太快、或者干扰太多，读过一遍好像没什么印象。听会加深对文献的记忆。
 4.
方便高效：您只需要点击“听文献”图标，就可以在一次推送里听到所有文章的标题和摘要的标准朗读。


	
另外，我们还刚刚做了一个更新，您可以把声音文件（mp3）下载到本地，方便您在没有网络的时候听文献。


	
如果您想了解一下朗读的质量，可以点击进行试听。 

	您也可以点击试用该功能，或者订阅。 

	我们非常期待您的使用体验和反馈。如果您有任何问题或建议，请随时与我们联系，我们会尽快为您解答。谢谢！

emails.subject: Table recognition, institutional licenses for universities, edu and free plan changes, bug fixes
emails.body:
We have added support for extremely large tables, which previously were not supported at all. 


** Improved table recognition
------------------------------------------------------------
We have added support for extremely large tables, which previously were not supported at all. Here are some examples of tables that didn’t use to work but now work:

Example input:

Example MMD output:

You can also now export to TSV directly from the Snip web app:

Copy TSV to clipboard:

And paste the result into your spreadsheet:


** Educational and free plan changes
------------------------------------------------------------
We are limiting edu accounts to 20 Snips and 20 PDF pages per month, and accounts on the free plan to 10 snips and 10 PDF pages per month. We encourage users with heavy usage needs to upgrade to Pro or contact their university’s accessibility department to buy an institutional license for the whole school.


** Institutional licenses for universities and colleges
------------------------------------------------------------
We’re pleased to announce that we are now offering university licenses for the entire school system. This means that our educational plan is being limited to those who signed up with an educational domain, which is not related to organizations that have acquired an institutional license.

If you are associated with an institution, please contact them and let them know you are interested in using Mathpix’s services. The institutional license ensures that every user who signs up using a corporate email gets a Pro Plan automatically. To find out more information and fill in the request for service form, please visit this page (https://mathpix.com/use-cases/for-universities) .


** Other fixes
------------------------------------------------------------
* improved robustness of PDF processing and PDF uploading
* improved checkout flow for Alipay users
* add support on mobile for the latest Markdown features (including theorems, proofs, and lemmas)
* improved robustness of web and mobile apps
* improved speed of exporting to DOCX
* formatting improvements for tables (numbers no longer considered as math equations inside tables)

emails.subject: Folders, export tables to CSV, plain Markdown outputs for PDFs, and more
emails.body:
The Files tab is a new addition to Mathpix Snip's interface, which allows users to organize their Notes and PDFs into Folders.


** Files tab and folders
------------------------------------------------------------
The Files tab is a new addition to Mathpix Snip's (https://snip.mathpix.com/) interface, which allows users to organize their Notes and PDFs into Folders.

To create a folder, open the Files tab and click the Create new folder icon.

Then type the name of your folder and click Create.


**
Selection mode and bulk actions
------------------------------------------------------------
You can now select multiple Notes and PDFs at once, making it easier to delete or move files to a specific folder.

You can activate selection mode by either clicking the selection mode button on the top of the Files tab or by hovering over any file.

Select files that you want to add into your new folder and click the Move icon:

You will see the list of all your folders. Select where you want to move chosen files and click Move here.


**
Export tables to CSV
------------------------------------------------------------
Our latest Snipping tool update released a new export to CSV option for tables. To use the new feature, simply select the table you want to export, click the "Export CSV" button, and save the file to your computer.

You can also export tables directly from the PDF viewer in the Snip web app:
CSV files can be opened in any spreadsheet software, such as Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, and can be used for a variety of purposes, including data analysis and storage.


**
Using Snip with ChatGPT
------------------------------------------------------------
We recommend using $..$ as LaTeX delimiters for best results with ChatGPT!


**
Export your PDFs to plain Markdown
------------------------------------------------------------
We use Mathpix Markdown extensively because it is an expressive and feature-rich markup language for handling STEM documents that resolves many of the limitations of plain Markdown. However, plain Markdown is widely supported by productivity apps and even LLMs like ChatGPT, so we have decided to support it!

Tables, for instance, are represented in our plain Markdown outputs using standard Markdown syntax, eg.
| Syntax      | Description |
| ----------- | ----------- |
| Header      | Title       |
| Paragraph   | Text        |
instead of using the Mathpix Markdown syntax \begin{tabular} … \end{tabular} (which is the same syntax used for LaTeX).

Section headers for plain Markdown outputs use the more standard
# Section and ## Subsection.

Also, note that Markdown outputs also use dollar delimiters $...$ and
$$ … $$ for mathematical expressions by default instead of the \( … \) and \[ … \] delimiters we use by default for Mathpix Markdown outputs. We have noticed that this greatly enhances interoperability with ChatGPT.


**
Improved chemistry algorithm
------------------------------------------------------------
Image to SMILES conversion overall has been significantly improved, and now includes support for stereochemistry and Markush structures.

Stereochemistry:

O=S(=O)(c1ccc(F)cc1)N1C[C@@H](O)[C@H](N2CCCC2)C1

Markush structures:

[Z2]Nc1c(CC([R10])CSC)ncn1CC#C


**
Free admin seat for organizations
------------------------------------------------------------
A free admin seat lets you bring on team members responsible for billing and managing users without having to pay for additional Snip users in your organization who don’t need access to the app.


**
Create Snip from text
------------------------------------------------------------
With this feature, you can easily convert text to a Snip in just a few clicks, similar to what's available in our desktop app.
By simply copying and pasting LaTeX code into the Mathpix Snip app, users can easily convert the code into MathML and other useful formats.


**
Other improvements
------------------------------------------------------------
* Improved Korean language recognition
* Faster PDF processing
* Improved Markdown style table outputs

emails.subject: 潇潇, ChatPaper更新：可以直接翻译段落了
emails.body:
潇潇,

	
ChatPaper更新了！我们听到一些用户的反馈，说怎么才能把某些句子或者整个段落翻译成中文，更便于阅读？我们增加了一个功能：如果你选择了几个句子或一个段落，ChatPaper可以直接帮您翻译。截图见下：


	> Stork wrote ... 

	做科研，有件事非常累，但是又不得不做，那就是读文献。许多术语要另起窗口查询，而几乎每读一段都有一些疑问。加上我们的母语不是英语，语言又是另一层障碍。如果有个专家可以在我们读文献的时候在旁边向我们解释就好了。


	为此，我们特意为大家开发了ChatPaper。它就是您的文献阅读助手，可以随时随地不厌其烦地回答您的疑问，帮助您高效理解文献。


	具体功能如下： 

	*
名词解释：在阅读科学文献的时候，我们常被一些术语或者简写卡住。这时候就需要打开另一个窗口来搜索一下这个术语什么意思。现在，你只要用鼠标选中
PDF
论文中的一个或多个词，ChatPaper就会自动帮你解释。这样大大提高了你阅读的效率。

	*
交互问答：在不懂的时候，您可以直接问ChatPaper。比如你可以问论文的亮点、局限性等问题。ChatPaper
会给您做出回答。
  	*
信息定位：ChatPaper在回答您的问题的时候，一般会列出相关的页码。点击这个页码，PDF会自动跳转到相应的段落，供您快速找到来源。
 	*
支持多语言：您可以选择ChatPaper回答时的语言。可以选择中文或者英文。用母语帮您解释论文，会让您更快速地理解文章。

	您可以通过演示视频（5分钟）快速了解ChatPaper的功能和用法。也可以到我们的主页了解更多信息。


	您现在就可以试用ChatPaper：点击进入ChatPaper主页，然后点击试用按钮。您也可以点击这里订购。


	我们非常期待您的使用体验和反馈。如果您有任何问题或建议，请随时与我们联系，我们会尽快为您解答。谢谢！

emails.subject: Search AI: Google-like search experience for your docs
emails.body:
We are excited to announce a new AI powered search experience for all your documents in Snip!


** Search AI: Google-like search experience for your docs
------------------------------------------------------------
We are excited to announce a new AI-powered search experience for all your documents in Snip!

Use the top most tab in the Mathpix Snip (https://snip.mathpix.com/) web app (coming soon on mobile) to search all your documents:

Click on a search result to navigate to the matching location in the source document, where the region of interest will be highlighted for your convenience:

Click anywhere in the document to clear the search highlight.

Use the search history to quickly refer back to your previous searches and resources without re-entering the same query.

We use OpenAI and Anthropic for our generative answering capabilities, which appear in the “Intelligence” column on the right side of the search results. Third-party APIs retain data for 30 days for abuse and misuse monitoring purposes. To disable the “Intelligence” question-answering capability, click on the settings bar on the bottom left:

Disabling AI powered results will prevent search result data from being shared with 3rd party APIs. The search feature will still work as before, and only the “Intelligence” section will be disabled:

Our new search AI feature includes basic capabilities to find math symbols in PDFs:

Note that math search is still a work in progress! Much more coming soon here.

Any feedback or ideas on how we can improve our search experience? Please let us know! You can leave feedback inside the app, or you can simply email support@mathpix.com (mailto:support@mathpix.com?subject=User%20feedback%20about%20Search%20AI) .


** Other updates
------------------------------------------------------------
* fixed password reset bug
* speed improvements for snipping images and PDFs
* fixed DOCX exporting bugs


** Coming soon
------------------------------------------------------------
* better math search
* chemistry search
* PDF conversion formatting bug fixes
* UI feature to limit search to a single document or folder

emails.subject: Z-Library: Notification of ending donations
emails.body:
Support us in the fight for the freedom of knowledge Sign the petition

你好, zxx!

非常感谢您对我们项目的捐款30 July 2023支持。
我们高度感谢您的支持，并感谢您成为我们社区的一员。ZLibrary在您的帮助下运营并发展。

我们想通知您，您的高级会员身份将在30 August 2023 到期 。
根据我们的政策，高级会员身份有效期为 31 天，因为我们使用捐款资金每月支付服务器并奖励我们的员工。

致敬

Z-Library — 您通向知识和文化的大门。

Official channel

Hello, zxx!

Thank you very much for making a donation on 30 July 2023 to support our project.
We highly appreciate your support and thank you for being a part of our community. ZLibrary is living and developing with your help.

We would like to inform you that your Premium membership status will expire on 30 August 2023.
According to our policy, Premium status is valid for 31 days as we use donations for the monthly payments for the servers and for rewarding our employees.

Sincerely yours

Z-Library — your gateway to knowledge and culture.

Official channel

You have received this letter because of your registration at Z-Library. If you want to be removed from this mailing list - UNSUBSCRIBE

emails.subject: 潇潇, 预印本：斯坦福博士后的调查
emails.body:
潇潇,

	最近，针对预印本文章，斯坦福大学的博士后进行了一项问卷调查。预印本重要吗？斯坦福的科研人员何时会把他们的文章上传到像biorxiv这样的预印本平台？预印本有哪些好处和坏处？以下是调查结果。

	strtoupper("上传预印本的时间：")

	90%的回应者将他们的手稿上传到像biorxiv这样的预印本平台。就时间而言，80%在向正式期刊投稿的同时上传。

	上传预印本的原因：")

	用于求职面试/申请：3个回应

	在审查过程中可被引用：2个回应

	为了宣告优先权：1个回应

	由于在一个竞争激烈的领域工作：1个回应

	作为实验室常规操作：1个回应

	strtoupper("预印本的好处：")

	有助于求职和面试：2个回应

	能够更早地被引用：2个回应

	更广泛的传播和读者：1个回应

	有助于奖学金申请：1个回应

	strtoupper("预印本的坏处：")

	减少了最终版本论文的流量：1个回应

	预印本和最终版本之间的潜在引用分裂：1个回应

	strtoupper("提到的平台：")

	bioRxiv：9次提及

	Research Square：1次提及

	strtoupper("总结：")

	这项调查表明，大多数斯坦福大学研究人员在投稿给期刊时把文章上传到预印平台。主要的好处是可以帮助申请工作以及使文章在早日被引用。

emails.text: ul { list-style: disc; padding-left: 30px; } ul li { margin-bottom: 6px; } .donation-link:hover { color: #fff !important; background-color: #5eb4a5 !important; text-decoration: none !important; } 捐赠 9月15日2023 – 10月1日2023 你好, zxx!您下载了 41 书 和在过去6个月中使用我们服务的文章。 如果你能给我们捐赠[备选链接]来支持我们的工作，我们将非常感激。Z-Library是世界上最大的资源之一，自2009年以来，它提供不同语言自由阅读独特的书籍和科学文章。 Z-Library存在的主要目标是提高全世界人们的教育水平。 众所周知，在2022年11月，应美国特勤局的命令，封锁了几乎所有图书馆的公共领域。项目的内部基础设施也受到了重大损害。 Z-Library目前正在经历自己存在14年来最艰难的时期。尽管存在所有这些困难，图书馆继续在运作和发展。 不久前我们实施了几项重要的新举措：启动了纸质书籍交换服务，打开了Z-Points的第一站；推出了桌面应用程序和浏览器扩展；改善了书籍专栏和书籍页面上多层次的评论；把我们的收藏转移到IPFS仓库；为恢复对图书馆的访问创建了神奇的email；为Premium用户提供新的线上阅读器和Send-to-Pocket选项等。今天9月15日2023，这意味着，我们通常每年3月和9月启动额外筹款来支持和发展这个项目。 我们会感激每一美元的捐赠。此外，对在筹款期间捐赠的所有用户提供无限下载(为期一个月)。 筹款将持续到10月1日2023 主要来自于教育机构的上百万人使用Z-Library来满足自己的需求。 这意味着，我们处在正确的道路上。但没有您的支持，很难达到既定的目标。您的积极支持给我们的团队带来力量并激励工作。每一美元的捐赠不仅是支持项目的发展，还是对您真正需要我们项目的信心！支持Z-Library — 您通向知识和文化的大门。 Official channelHello, zxx!You've downloaded 41 book(s) and article(s) using our service in the past 6 months. If you can make a donation [mirror] to support our work at this time, we would be extremely grateful.Z-Library is one of the largest resources in the world, providing free access to unique books and scientific articles in many different languages since 2009. The main purpose of Z-Library's existence is to enhance the level of education of people around the world. As you may know, almost all public domains of the library were blocked in November 2022 by order of the US Secret Service. The inner infrastructure of the project suffered some substantial damage too. At the moment, Z-Library is going through the hardest times in all the 14 years of its existence.However, despite all the difficulties, the library continues to function and develop. We have recently introduced several important features:we have started working on a book swap service and opened the first Z-Points;launched a desktop app and browser extension;improved multilevel comments in booklists and on the book page;moved our collection to IPFS storage;created a magic email for restoring access to the library;introduced a new online reader for Premium users and Send-to-Pocket book option, and more.On September 15, 2023, as in March and September of each year, we launched additional fundraising to project maintenance and development. We will be extremely thankful for every dollar that is donated. Furthermore, UNLIMITED downloads (for 1 month) are available for ALL contributors who donate during the fundraising period. The fundraising will run until October 1, 2023 Millions of people, mostly from educational institutions, use Z-Library for their purposes. And that means we're on the right track. However, reaching our goals would be challenging without your support. Your active support gives strength to our Team and inspires to work.
