潇潇, 用户小Ｋ：我和ChatPaper的故事
emails.body:
潇潇,

	下面是文献鸟用户小K的文章，帮您了解ChatPaper。 

	strtoupper("“$this->_build_link_list("https://www.storkapp.me/chatpaper/",
"ChatPaper")论文对话系统，一键理解最新前沿论文”")

	“遗憾没有早点使用$this->_build_link_list("https://www.storkapp.me/chatpaper/",
"ChatPaper")，不然也不会走那么多的弯路。”

	这是某生物化学与分子生物学专业的一名高年级博士小Ｋ的叹息。

	小K的经历很特殊，小K的大学生涯其实比较‘潇洒’。他并没有宅在实验室里捣鼓瓶瓶罐罐，而是和学弟学妹一起玩转PPT创业比赛，尝试组队创业。不过，很快他发现：啊哦，我其实没有什么创业的核心技术！于是，小K决定开启他的“学霸模式”，考了研究生投身学术研究。但谁知，研究生之路并不是那么容易走。像是在学术的大门前，小K像是个“门卫”，总是在门口踌躇，不敢进入。到了博士阶段，他还在边上“吭哧吭哧”地尝试发文章，结果却是七投七被拒。

	回顾原因嘛，一是他的二导就像是时装周的模特，换得比衣服还快，让他有点跟不上节奏，没有受到系统性科研学术训练，二是自己闭门造车造轮子，本来基础薄弱，学习能力不强，造出来的轮子质量不过关，高估了自己造车能力而自暴自弃，经常自己玩到“游戏结束”。

	导致的结果是，
找工作的过程中，小K感到相当沮丧，总觉得自己总是被挑选的一方，而没有资格选择别人。面对连续的论文被拒、工作申请不顺以及毕业推迟的三重打击，他开始怀疑博士毕业后的前途是否一片光明，甚至没有出路。

	小Ｋ进科研学术圈初衷是学习系统科研的方法论，掌握先进技术后塑造深化他的世界观。恰逢有些迷茫，好在命运的转机来了，小K遇到了ChatPaper。这神奇的工具不仅帮他翻译了从未尝试过的实验方案，还能让他秒懂顶级学术期刊的文章。

	strtoupper("1. Chatpaper可以做什么?")

	$this->_build_link_list("https://www.storkapp.me/chatpaper/",
"ChatPaper")不仅是一个论文阅读工具。它结合了先进的自然语言处理技术，使用户能够与论文进行“对话”。以聊天的方式轻松读懂晦涩的文献。您可以使用鼠标在PDF中选择一个术语，它将向您解释。您也可以使用鼠标在PDF中
选中较长的句子或者段落，它将为您翻译到中文。您可以询问关于论文的具体问题，例如“列举本文亮点。”或“这篇论文有什么新意？”或“这篇论文有什么局限性？”以及“作者是如何进行实验的？”等，ChatPaper会为你提供简明扼要的答案，让你不再为长篇累牍的论文而感到困惑。

	小Ｋ明白了，ChatPaper论文对话系统可以帮助解决：一是每日都在与数量繁多的学术论文打交道，不知道自己要干嘛？二是知道要干嘛，但是不知道怎么迅速、准确地理解并吸收这些论文中的核心知识等问题。

	ChatPaper就是一款科研生产力工具。ChatPaper它可能是你科研学术路上寻找的那个解决方案！

	strtoupper("2. ChatPaper的封面介绍和使用步驟")

	图１

	ChatPaper的界面设计简洁直观，以用户体验为中心。如图１所示，主页面上有一个上传全文按钮，用户可以点击这里选择文件，或者把一个文件拖到这里（支持PDF和HTML格式）。最大20M/100页。上传文件后，自动弹出一个“开始问我问题吧”对话框，进入与论文的对话模式。如图2所示，在对话框的右侧有一个五角星，它的功能是点击即可收藏到常用的问题提示语，方便再次调用。在对话框中输入你对论文的疑问后点击最右侧的纸飞机图标，ChatPaper会迅速为你提供答案。

	图２

	strtoupper("３. ChatPaper的实际应用")

	现在，让我们以“Capturem™ IP text-wrap: wrap;">3.2")
想象一下：小K，一个刚入研究生的学生，不仅基础知识薄弱，还是跨专业的，甚至连英文阅读都有难度。他看到试剂盒上的“Co-IP”时一头雾水，因为实验室里的师兄师姐都没做过这个实验。于是，他不得不花费大量时间和精力搜索和阅读文献，试图理解这个实验的原理。但现在，有了ChatPaper，他只需用鼠标选中“Co-IP”，如图3所示的紫色高亮部分，对话框中就会立刻出现中文解释。这样，小K不再被语言障碍所困，可以更加直观、迅速和准确地获取所需信息。

	strtoupper("3.3")
如果你发现提供的解释仍然难以理解，你可以继续输入一个中文指令，“要求用本科生可以理解的简单语言进行解释。”

	strtoupper("3.4")
在理解了实验原理之后，你可以直接点击指令：“作者是如何进行实验的？”，相关内容将会显示，如图4展示的那样。

	图４

	strtoupper("3.5")
根据前文简要的实验步骤总结，我们已经对整个过程有了大致的了解，这样就可以准备试剂和耗材了。但为了确保不错过关键的细节，我们还可以直接点击原文中的数字步骤，进行逐条翻译。之后，再输入中文指令“总结具体实验步骤”。这样，从完全理解试剂盒的原理到掌握实验步骤，仅需20分钟。

	从那以后，小K把审稿人拒稿的意见输入到ChatPaper中，逐条进行对话式的理解和吸收。这让他清晰地看到了自己的问题所在，他已经认真修改了论文，带着新的希望准备第八次投稿，就像在漫长的黑夜中看到了那么一点曙光。

	现如今，小K不仅重新找回了他对科研的热情，还常常半开玩笑地说：“如果早点知道ChatPaper，我可能已经是某杰出青年了！”

	自从ChatPaper上线，许多研究机构、大学和科研人员都开始广泛使用它。不止是小K在黑暗中看到了曙光，许多用户都表示，通过ChatPaper他们能迅速掌握论文的关键信息，从而显著提高了自己的研究效率。

	strtoupper("北京大学汪阳明教授")：“用了一篇我刚刚读过的文献，那感觉，真的是太棒
了！推荐所有刚入门的和研究老手、任何想要轻松阅读文献的人，赶紧来用ChatPaper！至少提高效率3倍以上！

	strtoupper("北京大学口腔医学院张然主治医师") ：“
chatpaper可以把整篇文献拖进分析框，使用非常方便。遇到不认识的单词可以直接选中，秒出翻译，速度快，翻译精准。还可以帮助分析文章的亮点，局限性，采用的实验技术等等，非常好用，强烈推荐！”

	strtoupper("常州大学徐月华副教授")：“在海量的相关文献中，可以快速确定文章的新意和亮点，从而找到快速找到我需要的信息，这对我指导研究生很有帮助。”

	strtoupper("衡阳师范学院黄耿博士")：“真的很好用，一下子就看完一篇论文了。实在是太高效率了。棒棒哒~
”

	一些教育机构和科研机构甚至开始考虑在课堂上和实验室里使用ChatPaper，帮助学生更好地理解学术文章。

	ChatPaper的出现无疑为迷茫的硕博小白新手带来了一场学习革命。它不仅提供了一个全新的论文阅读方式，更重要的是，它使科研人员和学生们能够更加深入、直观地理解学术论文，大大提高了研究和学习的效率。如果你还没有试过，那么现在就来体验一下ChatPaper的“威力”吧！

	strtoupper("４. ChatPaper的简要攻略")

	strtoupper("4.1") 示例中文提问指令：

	请详细描述method / 什么是IP-MS？/详细描述Results /
请详细描述【某个专业名词】部分

	strtoupper("4.2") 错误示例中文提问指令：

	推荐几篇类似的文献 / 翻译全文 /
将这篇文章整理成一篇小综述 /
我只想了解其中的【某个专业名词】部分

	strtoupper("4.3")
请注意:少数提问会因为搜索不到对应段落，会有答非所问，避免ChatPaper车轱辘话反复说需要多次调试“指令”。ChatPaper可以启发我们对自身所处信息环境和学术生态的头脑风暴，而不能全盘代替学术思考。

emails.subject: Welcome to Grok Academy!
emails.body:
Hi there,
A massive Grok welcome to you!
You're probably wondering where to start. Never fear! Just follow these simple steps to get Grokking like a pro.

Request Teacher Verification
We take the privacy of students very seriously. Getting verified allows us to confirm that you are a teacher at your nominated school before giving you access to student data.

This will then allow you to sign up students and manage student accounts at your school. You'll also receive FREE access to all of our materials, including problem solutions and teacher notes!

You will receive a confirmation email within 1 - 3 business days once your request has been approved. (Please note this may take longer during school holidays)

How do I request verification?
Step 1. Check your details.
It's best if you add your full (legal) name and school email address to your account. This makes it easier for us to verify you. Check or update your name and your email address.

Step 2. Add your school or institution.
If you haven't already added your school or institution, add it now!

Step 3. Request verification.
Click the orange "Request verification" button next to your school. That's it!


You are now ready to get Groking!
Make sure you check out our Teacher Grokit guide for info about our courses, our resources, how to register students, assign courses, view student progress, and everything else there is to know about using Grok!

emails.text: Hi there, A massive Grok welcome to you! You're probably wondering where to start. Never fear! Just follow these simple steps to get Grokking like a pro. Request Teacher Verification We take the privacy of students very seriously. Getting verified allows us to confirm that you are a teacher at your nominated school before giving you access to student data. This will then allow you to sign up students and manage student accounts at your school. You'll also receive FREE access to all of our materials, including problem solutions and teacher notes! You will receive a confirmation email within 1 - 3 business days once your request has been approved. (Please note this may take longer during school holidays) How do I request verification? Step 1. Check your details. It's best if you add your full (legal) name and school email address to your account. This makes it easier for us to verify you. Check or update your name and your email address. Step 2. Add your school or institution. If you haven't already added your school or institution, add it now! Step 3. Request verification. Click the orange "Request verification" button next to your school. That's it! You are now ready to get Groking! Make sure you check out our Teacher Grokit guide for info about our courses, our resources, how to register students, assign courses, view student progress, and everything else there is to know about using Grok! emails.subject: Localization, reduced pricing for extra usage, full-page Snip view, and more
emails.body:
Learn about a bundle of exciting updates in the Mathpix Snip app.


** Localization
------------------------------------------------------------
Mathpix can now handle data in more languages than ever, which means you can use Mathpix’s best-in-class tools wherever in the world you are, and whatever your native tongue!

Mathpix currently supports: English, Bengali, German, Spanish (Castilian), French, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Urdu, Vietnamese, Chinese, and we are always working on adding more languages!

To choose a new language, open your Editor Preferences and click Language & Region. Then choose your language from the dropdown list:


** Major price reduction for extra usage for Mathpix Pro customers
------------------------------------------------------------
Extra Snip and PDF usage is now more affordable than ever.

Current pricing:
* $0.002 per Snip;
* $0.01 per PDF page.

Previous pricing:
* $0.01 per Snip;
* $0.05 per PDF page.


** Major improvements to the Snips tab
------------------------------------------------------------
We’ve made a series of updates to the Snips tab. Here's what's new:
* Full-page Snip mode: More possibilities in editing your Snips, and a wider array of export options.
* Bulk selection: Simplify organization and deletion through the selection of multiple Snips at once.
* List view: Alongside our classic gallery view, you now have the option to view your Snips in a list format. This alternative view is ideal for quick navigation and a more compact display.
* Renaming: It is now possible to rename your Snips.


** Home page
------------------------------------------------------------
Our new Home Page is more functional than ever,  displaying recent files, allowing you to upload and create various file types (PDFs, Snips, Notes), and to search through your document repository with ease.


** PDF section numbering
------------------------------------------------------------
An entire new array of options for organizing and numbering your PDFs upon upload,
including:

1. Auto numbering: This option removes the existing numbers in your document and numbers the sections automatically for you.
2. Remove numbering: Select this option to remove all section numbers from your PDF.
3. Preserve numbering: To ensure that the original layout and numbering of your PDF remain unchanged.


** Extended support for LaTeX commands
------------------------------------------------------------
Recognition support for 12 new, previously unsupported LaTeX commands!
\xrightarrow
\xlongequal
\gtrdot
\boxtimes
\downharpoonleft
\downharpoonright
\leftharpoondown
\leftharpoonup
\rightharpoondown
\rightharpoonup
\upharpoonleft
\upharpoonright
You can find image examples of all newly added commands at Mathpix OCR documentation (https://mathpix.com/docs/ocr/changelog#december-13%2C-2023) .


** Other improvements and bugfixes
------------------------------------------------------------
* More accurate Chinese text recognition than ever before
* A more seamless experience scrolling and navigating through files
* Improved auto-correction in our Search tab
* Bugfixes for PDF to DOCX conversion

We work daily at Mathpix to improve the product for our valued customers, and we are always open to feedbacks to better serve you. Drop us a line any time with questions, comments, and suggestions at support@mathpix.com (mailto:support@mathpix.com?subject=Mathpix%20Snip%20Feedback) !

We would like to bring to your attention that there has been a surge in fraudulent websites masquerading as Z-Library. These deceptive sites mimic the original name and design of Z-Library, stealing users' personal and credit card information. Moreover, these fraudulent sites often appear at the top of search engine results (Google, Bing, and others). Some of the most notorious fraudulent websites include:

  • 🛇 z-lib.id
  • 🛇 z-lib.io

DO NOT use these domains, as they have no affiliation with the original project. Distinguishing features of these fraudulent sites also include "Lifetime membership" and requests to use Discord for file downloads.

The current domains of the original Z-Library project are:

  • ✓ https://z-library.se
  • ✓ https://singlelogin.re

Please check Reddit commumity and Wikipedia page as well.

Furthermore, we strongly recommend subscribing to our Telegram channel, where you can find current domains and stay updated with the latest project news.



Z-Library — your gateway to knowledge and culture.

The fundraising will run until April 1, 2024 Millions of people, mostly from educational institutions, use Z-Library for their purposes. And that means we're on the right track. emails.subject: 报名 | 网络研讨会：MISRAC++2023:   C++项目中应用新标准（5月17日 星期五）
emails.body:
参加我们的网络研讨会，了解Axivion如何在C++项目中应用新标准来进行静态分析。另外，在MISRA C++规则之外，应该如何结合Axivion的其它静态分析特性和架构验证功能来让您的代码质量得到显著提升。

网络研讨会: MISRAC++2023: C++项目中应用新标准

总览

很长一段时间以来，MISRA C:2004和MISRA C++:2008是许多软件开发项目的首选。但随着硬件及开发范式和编程语言的发展，MISRA标准也进行了更新，以确保新的语言特性可以安全可靠地用于现代开发。现在新标准MISRA C++2023已经发布，它支持了C++17的特性，并在Axivion Suite中得以实施。

参加我们的网络研讨会，了解Axivion如何在C++项目中应用新标准来进行静态分析。另外，在MISRA C++规则之外，应该如何结合Axivion的其它静态分析特性和架构验证功能来让您的代码质量得到显著提升。

时间

5月17日 星期五 15:00-15:40

面向人群

> 所属行业：汽车、医疗设备、消费类电子、工业自动化、军工、航空航天、飞机、石油等

> 目前岗位：开发者，项目经理，研发负责人，QA工程师

参会者应对产品质量管理有一定的了解。

报名链接：https://bZgN04.na1.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/45+113/bZgN04/VWGFym20ZZwLW16nw-w29ZByzW6N147h5dlDj9N4Tr4M65jMY8W50kH_H6lZ3m-W34VCLy5YtVGhW99r0711Sw7DsW1c1cmd8VMYMlW1_t3f82x1dKYW8V97H75PpZPKW8ddRNj2nGqPLW3sW66r7-rx0tN5tMWb24WXS8W5lXvTr6Y82wcVP58k24bH7CYW7Q6FD44mq0ZSW3H-zyr556brqVQ3gL_1S0fFyVkRpgr31YnzLML9DH8N1W9yW5Y00fd6hCD_DW2G_N6y7h5jb3W7v4DwB6xfpYZW5txHdt6MRgYJW4Y7wrb3g6s70W83RlPJ84-fbqW5WKGt78vj15VW2nTj4t1dFqmjW7GNXDZ4rvnSMN3ktzJsc3Ft7VnFRMg27x84vW5fTsvS8LWP9LW6GQZq7225dmkW6b4dyf6q-BgsW3tx0Z13n_C7HW7MfH_J2bYTrDW6rpDtR92qQgzf2rvSTs04

常见问题

问1：网络研讨会与上班时间冲突，无法参加怎么办？

答：不用担心，我们的课程都设置了回放功能。扫描二维码报名后，在直播结束后你可以收到回放的观看链接进行学习，回放也可以让收看直播的小伙伴们有一个复习巩固的机会。当然，我们还是鼓励大家尽量参加直播，可以和我们的讲师有一个很好的互动，及时解答你在听讲过程中的问题。

注意：请保持关注“Qt软件”微信公众号，不然会错过消息提醒哦

问2：本次网络研讨会收费吗？

emails.body:
Put yourself in control of your love life

https://www.16personalities.com/?utm_source=welcome-mediator&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=romance&utm_content=scene

Hello Mediator,

Today, we’re talking about romance and love for Mediators (INFPs). Chances are you’ve spent years daydreaming about the perfect relationship, perhaps even longing to meet your soul mate.

Whether you've found them already or not, you're in luck. We’ve compiled what you need to know about creating and maintaining romantic relationships in the Relationships Reports section of your profile page. Be sure to check that out.
Explore your profile → (https://www.16personalities.com/profile/reports/relationships?utm_source=welcome-mediator&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=romance&utm_content=explore-your-profile-3)

It’s near impossible to overstate how much Mediators love love. They’re true dreamers and idealists – and Mediators bring those wonderful qualities to their romantic relationships. Our research shows that, among people with your personality type:
* 81% say they construct an “ideal” partner in their mind when they’re single.
* But only 7% describe themselves as very good at attracting a potential partner.

Mediators long for a kind of love that sets their soul on fire. They set their expectations high in the romance department and can sometimes worry about their relationships living up to those ideals.

To read more about what Mediators expect from love, revisit the Romantic Relationships (https://www.16personalities.com/infp-relationships-dating?utm_source=welcome-mediator&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=romance&utm_content=romantic-relationships-page-3) section of your personality type overview. It provides a brief but thorough rundown of the topic.


And if you’d like to go deeper, you can see how to attract partners and forge meaningful relationships – without settling – inside your Premium Mediator Suite of guides & tests. It provides an in-depth look at Mediator relationships of all kinds, from fulfilling friendships to elusive “true love” to the nurturing relationship between parent and child.

You can use the discount code ACC4D6E752 to save 20% on your Premium Mediator Suite of guides & tests. Take a look and consider joining thousands of other Mediators who have used this knowledge to improve their lives and boost their confidence.
Get your Premium Mediator Suite → (https://www.16personalities.com/academy/mediator?utm_source=welcome-mediator&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=romance&utm_content=get-the-relationships-guide-tests-sales-3)


Until next time,

The 16Personalities Team

P.S. Trying to navigate the online dating world? We have just the article. Check out our in-depth Introverts’ Guide to Online Dating. A fellow Turbulent Mediator shares how you can bring your full, authentic self to your online dating adventures.

Start reading → (https://www.16personalities.com/articles/the-introverts-guide-to-online-dating?utm_source=welcome-mediator&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=romance&utm_content=start-reading-blog-3)

https://www.16personalities.com?utm_source=newsletter-mediator&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=issue-1&utm_content=logo


** Well hello there.
------------------------------------------------------------

Let’s kick this newsletter series off right with an interesting stat – 92% of Mediators (https://www.16personalities.com/infp-careers?utm_source=newsletter-mediator&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=issue-1&utm_content=type-personality-career-1) (INFPs) say their dream job involves having the freedom to decide what they do and how they do it. Curated just for you.

Unlikely (but Magical) Careers for Mediators

Real Mediators all over the world are thriving in jobs that might not seem like a match for their personality type. Read on to discover careers that you may have overlooked.
Read more (https://www.16personalities.com/articles/unlikely-but-magical-careers-for-mediators-infps?utm_source=newsletter-mediator&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=issue-1&utm_content=read-more-article-1)

7 Surprising Mediator Facts You Should Know

When it comes to Mediators, some things are obvious (like their active imaginations and desire to help others) – but there’s also a lot hidden beneath the facade of someone with this personality type. Do you agree with these surprising Mediator stats?
Read more (https://www.16personalities.com/articles/7-surprising-facts-you-should-know-about-mediators-infps?utm_source=newsletter-mediator&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=issue-1&utm_content=read-more-article-2-1)

More content, handpicked for Mediators.

Let’s explore what that typically looks like. Read more → (https://www.16personalities.com/articles/assertive-mediator-infp-a-vs-turbulent-mediator-infp-t?utm_source=newsletter-mediator&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=issue-1&utm_content=read-more-article-3-1)

Can your personality traits help you find a job? Yes, indeed, they can. Each of your personality traits can aid your job search in unique ways. So take a few deep breaths and get ready to feel better about yourself and your future employment. Read more → (https://www.16personalities.com/articles/how-each-personality-trait-can-help-you-find-a-job?utm_source=newsletter-mediator&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=issue-1&utm_content=read-more-article-4-1)

Read on to see how the two intertwine to prevent Mediators from pursuing a more productive path. Read more → (https://www.16personalities.com/articles/mediator-infp-productivity-tips-focus-and-relevancy?utm_source=newsletter-mediator&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=issue-1&utm_content=read-more-article-5-1)

Which job fields fit your personality best? Among the most important things that you decide in life is how you’re going to make a living. Get a customized list of potential career paths to explore with our premium Job Preferences Test. Take test → (https://www.16personalities.com/specialized-tests/preview/job-preferences?utm_source=newsletter-mediator&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=issue-1&utm_content=take-test-test-1)

The 16Personalities Team

Extended Deadline - 2024 ISAFE Thailand Conference - 08-10 July
 2024
emails.body:
<<ISAFE_2024.png>> [https://isafe2024.sciencesconf.org/]



DEADLINE EXTENSION
2024 International Society for the Advancement of Financial Economics Thailand Conference

08 - 10 July 2024, Pattaya, Thailand

https://isafe2024.sciencesconf.org/ [https://isafe2024.sciencesconf.org/]

Dear colleagues and friends,

You are cordially invited to submit your research papers (English only and in PDF files) to the second annual meeting of the International Society for the Advancement of Financial Economics, that will take place on 08 – 10 July 2024 in Kasetsart University - Sriracha Campus, Pattaya, Thailand. We will organize the conference in a HYBRID FORMAT that allows either residential or online presentation, so please do not hesitate to submit your work.

This meeting, jointly organized by the International Society for the Advancement of Financial Economics (ISAFE) [https://www.isafesociety.org/],  Kasetsart University [https://www.ku.ac.th/en/community-home], the AVSE Global [https://avseglobal.org/], and the National Research Council of Thailand, aims to bring together academics, practitioners, and policymakers to share their research findings and discuss current and challenging issues in financial economics. The meeting is also an ideal occasion for rising/early career scholars to exchange research experiences and develop research projects with their international colleagues.
TOPICS

The scientific and organizing committees welcome submissions in all areas of financial management for presentation at the conference no later than 30 April 2024 15th May 2024. The main topics of the conference include, but are not limited to:

 * Asset pricing, allocation, and valuation
 * Behavioral and experimental finance
 * Central banking and monetary policy
 * Corporate finance and governance
 * Financial accounting, law, and regulation
 * Financial engineering and derivatives
 * Financial intermediation, institutions & services
 * Financial markets and market microstructure
 * International finance and capital markets
 * IPOs, SEOs, M&As & Divestitures
 * Personal finance and household finance
 * Portfolio management and optimization
 * Quantitative finance and financial econometrics
 * Real estate finance
 * Small business and entrepreneurial finance
 * Sustainable finance, ethics, and CSR



KEYNOTE SPEAKERS

Jonathan Batten [https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=PqEqUcAAAAAJ&hl=en], Professor in Finance, RMIT University, Melbourne, Australia.

Iftekhar Hasan [https://www.fordham.edu/gabelli-school-of-business/faculty/full-time-faculty/iftekhar-hasan/], University Professor and E. Gerald Corrigan Chair in International Business and Finance, Fordham University, United States.

STEERING COMMITTEE

Hung Do [https://www.massey.ac.nz/massey/expertise/profile.cfm?stref=972450], Director of Sustainable Finance Cluster, Massey University, New Zealand & Director of Finance and Banking Network, AVSE Global

Duc Khuong Nguyen [https://www.nguyenduckhuong.org/], Acting Dean, EMLV Business School, France; President of ISAFE & AVSE Global

CO-CHAIRS

Sabri Boubaker [https://en.em-normandie.com/professors-directory/sabri-boubaker], EM Normandie Business School, France and Swansea University, UK.

Sirimon Treepongkaruna [https://scholar.google.com.au/citations?user=QmvPNUcAAAAJ&hl=en], Senior Research Fellow, National Research Council of Thailand & Sasin School of Management, Chulalongkorn University.

Suntharee Lhaopadchan, Faculty of Management Sciences, Kasetsart University, Sriracha Campus.

PAPER SUBMISSION

Authors are invited to submit their papers in PDF files, no later than 30 April 2024 15th May 2024 via the conference website: https://isafe2024.sciencesconf.org/ [https://isafe2024.sciencesconf.org/]  

Submitted manuscripts will be peer-reviewed. No submission fee is required. General inquiries regarding the call for papers should be directed to any of conference chairs.



IMPORTANT DATES

Submission deadline: 30 April 2024

Submission extended deadline: 15 May 2024

Notification of review results: As soon as possible starting from 10 May 2024 

Registration deadline: 31 May 2024

Conference event: 08–10 July 2024

PUBLICATION OPPORTUNITIES

Special issue of International Review of Economics and Finance [https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/international-review-of-economics-and-finance], titled “Climate Governance, Green Innovation, and Investment Policies” under the Guest-editorship of Prof. Sabri Boubaker, Assoc. Prof. Hung Do, Dr. Linh Pham, and Dr. Vu Trinh. Deadline for submission: July 31, 2024

In consultation with conference co-chairs and the Editors-in-Chief, authors of the best conference papers will be invited to submit their papers to fast track reviewing process for a regular issue at one of the following journals: Global Finance Journal [https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/global-finance-journal], International Review of

emails.body:
Four things you should know if you feel lonely in your search for true love

https://www.16personalities.com


** Is your longing for meaningful connections clashing with the realities of dating?
------------------------------------------------------------
https://www.16personalities.com/orders/niche/mediator/mediator-guide-to-healthy-dating/checkout
Buy now (https://www.16personalities.com/orders/niche/mediator/mediator-guide-to-healthy-dating/checkout)

People with the INFP personality type (Mediators) often experience the highs and lows of dating deeply. At times, your heart is full of hope for a partner – maybe even a soulmate – who sees and loves your authentic self. At other times, the cold loneliness of reality comes creeping in.

If you feel lost between your dreams and the practicalities of love, here are four things you should know:
1. According to our research, INFPs are the most likely personality type to say they often or very often feel lonely. These feelings may be partly driven by your desire to form profound bonds with people who not only share your values but also are willing to push beyond pleasantries and explore meaningful ideas and emotions.
2. INFPs are quick to lead with empathy – except when it comes to self-love. You may find it challenging to offer yourself the same level of compassion that you so readily give to others. But a healthy amount of self-love can set anyone up for success when navigating intimate relationships.
3. INFP personalities can use their rich imagination to visualize successful dating interactions, instead of negative scenarios that might not even happen. When you combine this ability with your empathy and curiosity, you can approach dating as a fun opportunity to connect with people on a deeper level.
4. The journey of romance for INFPs is one filled with deep introspection, intense emotions, and occasional bouts of loneliness. But by learning to live in alignment with your values in your love life, you can transcend any internal or external barrier to romantic connection and foster healthy relationships – with both yourself and that special someone.

All of these insights came from our brand new e-book, the Mediator Guide to Healthy Dating. Whether you’re looking for love or wondering how to avoid unhealthy patterns in your current relationship, this book can help you navigate love’s complexities and move toward greater self-love and relationship fulfillment. emails.subject: Improved Code Recognition, Enhanced Diagram Data, Bulk File Upload, and More
emails.body:
We're thrilled to share several exciting updates that have recently been rolled out!

We have recently rolled out several exciting updates!


** Improved Code Recognition
------------------------------------------------------------
This update brings initial support for source code recognition from images.

Code OCR allows you to capture and share code snippets in seconds, making it simpler to read, collaborate, and document your code in real-time. Just take a screenshot using the desktop app (https://mathpix.com/desktop-downloads) and get the code copied to your clipboard automatically:
Our search feature has also been optimized to recognize code snippets within academic papers, technical manuals, and other professional documents. A single keyword is all it takes to find the relevant document and navigate directly to the section where the code is located.


** Enhanced Chemistry Diagram Data
------------------------------------------------------------
A major improvement in this version is that the orientation of the rendered molecule is preserved, which is a significant enhancement over the previous version that sometimes provided SMILES in a different orientation. Here are some examples of how chemistry is now rendered in Snip:

New MOL, InChI, and InChi Key output formats enable searchability of chemical compounds in digital databases, making it easier for researchers and students to find specific molecules and explore corresponding research. As usual, you can click any row in the Export tab to get it copied to your clipboard.


** Customizable export options for Notes to DOCX / LaTeX / PDF
------------------------------------------------------------
Make sure that exported Notes match your desired aesthetic by choosing the document's font type and size before conversion. ​​In addition, we’ve added automatic language detection, so that your DOCX files open in MS Word without having your work look like a crime scene of red spelling error squiggles!

For a more streamlined experience, disable the configuration pop-up and set your default export preferences under Settings > Preferences.


** Bulk File Upload
------------------------------------------------------------
You can now select and upload multiple PDFs, Snips, and Notes simultaneously. This allows you to streamline your workflow with ease, saving you valuable time and effort every step of the way!

To use the new bulk upload feature, simply drag and drop multiple files into the app or click Upload to select them from your device.


** Better PDF processing for large files or slow connections
------------------------------------------------------------
Previously, the Snip app struggled to upload large PDFs with a slow internet connection. We’ve made PDF upload more robust, with automatic upload continuation on network errors. We also added the ability to manually continue PDF upload later if your upload was interrupted for any reason. We know that life (and internet outages) happen!


** Other Improvements and Bug Fixes
------------------------------------------------------------
* Added ability to preserve or remove equation numbering in PDFs
* Improved handwritten Japanese OCR
* Fixed incorrect grouping of fractional function arguments in Asciimath outputs
* Improved memory usage on iOS

As always, we're grateful for your continued support and feedback, which inspires us to keep improving. Stay tuned for more updates, and please don't hesitate to reach out with any suggestions or questions you might have!

Warm regards,
The Mathpix Team

emails.subject: Did you see this?
emails.body:
You're invited to Leadership by 16Personalities 🎉

https://www.16personalities.com

Do you want to lead teams that are more connected, effective, and happy at work?

We’ve quietly been working on something huge behind the scenes – and you’re seeing this email because you’re a 16Personalities newsletter subscriber and we thought you’d like to be the first to know.

We’re launching Leadership by 16Personalities (https://16personalities.substack.com/p/join-the-leadership-by-16personalities) – the ultimate Substack publication to help you master personality-driven leadership (a.k.a. become the leader everyone wants to work for). 🎉

What is Substack?

Substack is an online newsletter platform. We’ll use it to share exclusive leadership content directly with you (in your inbox). This will allow us to connect with you more personally and offer insights, updates, and stories that you won’t find on our website.

Join the waitlist (https://16personalities.substack.com/p/join-the-leadership-by-16personalities) today to become a free subscriber. Once we officially launch, you’ll have the option to upgrade to a paid subscription for access to more content.

What is Leadership by 16Personalities?

Every month, we’ll do a deep dive into a relevant leadership topic, to help you and your teams work better together.

This is your place to:
* Participate in monthly leadership challenges every 30 days (without adding to your already busy schedule – these only take a few minutes)
* Tap into the full potential of every person on your team (you don’t even need to know their personality type)
* Engage with like-minded leaders in exclusive discussions (network, network, network)

And that’s not all.

As a member of the 16Personalities community, you can join the waitlist first and, if you choose to become a paid subscriber, secure a special one-time promotional price that will never be offered again.

(This special price will be available once we officially launch – stay tuned!)

Interested? Click below to secure your spot on the Substack waitlist now.
Join the waitlist (https://16personalities.substack.com/p/join-the-leadership-by-16personalities)

Until next time,

The 16Personalities Team

P.S. Wondering if this is free or paid? The answer is – it’s up to you!

When you join the waitlist, you’ll be subscribed to Leadership by 16Personalities on Substack as a free subscriber, and you’ll automatically get access to occasional free articles and previews of premium content.

If you decide you’d like to read the full versions of all articles and participate in discussions with other leaders, you’ll be able to upgrade your subscription to a paid plan once we officially launch.

P.P.S. Leadership by 16Personalities is currently published in English only. Other languages may or may not become available in the future.

https://facebook.com/16Personalities https://instagram.com/16personalitiesofficial/

Copyright (C) 2011-2024 NERIS Analytics Limited. All rights reserved.
You are receiving this e-mail because you opted in at our website, https://www.16personalities.com.
Our mailing address is:
NERIS Analytics Limited

9 Hills Road

Cambridge, CB2 1GE

United Kingdom

emails.subject: ICBFS conference - 05-06 September 2024 - Catania - Italy
emails.body:
<<ICBFS_2024.png>> [https://icbfs2024.sciencesconf.org/?lang=en]



Only 5 days left until the deadline
CALL FOR PAPERS

The 2024 International Conference in Banking and Financial Studies

5-6 September 2024 (Sicily, Italy)

 Conference Venue and Hosting Institution

 University of Catania - Catania (Italy)
Conference dates



05 Sep 2024 - 06 Sep 2024

Location



University of Catania, Catania, Sicily, Italy

Conference website



https://icbfs2024.sciencesconf.org/ [https://icbfs2024.sciencesconf.org/]



THEME: Frontiers in Banking and Finance



Following the success of the 2023 edition held at Capua (CE), Italy, we invite submissions for the 2024 edition of the International Conference in Banking and Financial Studies, scheduled to be held on 05-06 September 2024 at the University of Catania (Sicily), Italy. This conference serves as a dynamic platform for scholars, researchers, practitioners, and policymakers to delve into the latest advancements, obstacles, and prospects within the realm of banking and finance. Through insightful debate and collaborative engagement, the conference endeavors to chart the course for navigating the complex landscape of contemporary financial systems.



TOPICS:

We welcome papers that delve into several pertinent topics, aiming to foster comprehensive discussions and shed light on the multifaceted nature of the banking and finance domain. These topics include, but are not limited to:

 * Accounting, auditing, and taxation
 * Asset allocation and valuation
 * Banking regulation and financial services
 * Behavioral and experimental finance/economics
 * Big data in finance, artificial intelligence, and cyber security
 * Climate finance and sustainability
 * Corporate finance, IPOs, SEOs, M&A, and crowdfunding
 * Corporate governance
 * Country funds, sovereign funds, and hedge funds
 * Debt issues
 * Digital finance, cryptocurrency finance, and blockchain
 * Emerging markets finance
 * Energy finance and environment Issues
 * Entrepreneurial finance, venture capital, and private equity
 * Ethical finance, green finance, ESG and CSR
 * Financial accounting and regulation
 * Financial crises, contagion, integration, and global risks interconnection
 * Financial engineering and derivatives
 * Foreign currency issue
 * Global imbalances & sustainability
 * Household finance, real estate finance, and microfinance
 * Market behavior efficiency
 * Multinational financial management
 * Portfolio management and optimization
 * Risk management and compliance
 * Small business finance



KEYNOTE SPEAKER: Prof. Steven Ongena, University of Zurich & the Swiss Finance Institute, Switzerland.



CO-CHAIRS:

 * Sabri Boubaker – EM Normandie Business School, France & Swansea University, UK
 * Sebastiano Mazzù – University of Catania, Italy
 * Vincenzo Verdoliva – University of Naples Parthenope, Italy



PUBLICATION OPPORTUNITIES: Articles must be presented at the conference. Among them, co-chairs will invite selected papers to be submitted and considered for publication. The submission to any of the supporting journals will be from October 15th to November 30th, 2024. Authors will be required to attach a “Response letter to the discussant” that shows all the changes made to their manuscript based on the discussant’s report to speed up the reviewing process. The papers will then go through a fast-track blind review process.

 * International Review of Financial Analysis
 * The Financial Review
 * Journal of Financial Research
 * Journal of International Financial Management and Accounting
 * Journal of Multinational Financial Management
 * Review of Corporate Finance
 * Bancaria


[https://s449q.mjt.lu/img2/s449q/c35049cc-8bdd-4859-9760-c16879bff29a/content]



TIMELINE AND SUBMISSION PROCESS: Papers and extended abstracts (in PDF version) should be submitted by June 30, 2024 (Early submissions are highly encouraged). Decisions will be made during the first week of July 2024.



IMPORTANT DATES:

Submission deadline: 30 June 2024

Notification of review results: 05 July 2024

Registration deadline: 15 August 2024

Conference event: 05-06 September 2024

Partners & organizers

 * EM Normandie Business School, France [https://www.em-normandie.com/]
 * Dipartimento di Economia e Impresa, Università di Catania [https://www.dei.unict.it/]
 * Dipartimento di Studi Aziendali e Quantitativi dell'Università degli Studi di Napoli Parthenope  [https://www.disaq.uniparthenope.it/]
 * International Society for the Advancement of Financial Economics (ISAFE) [http://www.isafesociety.org/]

emails.body:
The following email was sent to haitao Li from 28th International conference ELECTRONICS regarding A Vine-Copula Method for Outlier Identification in Photovoltaic Arrays.

You are receiving a copy of this notification because you are identified as an author of the submission. Any instructions in the message below are intended for the submitting author, haitao Li, and no action is required of you at this time.

Dear haitao Li,

 

After reviewing your submission, A Vine-Copula Method for Outlier Identification in Photovoltaic Arrays, the reviewers have recommended that your submission cannot be accepted for publication in its current form. However, we would like to encourage you to submit a revised version that addresses the reviewers' comments. Your revisions will be reviewed by a chair and may be sent out for another round of peer review.

Please note that resubmitting your work does not guarantee that it will be accepted.

The reviewers' comments are included at the bottom of this email. Please respond to each point in the reviewers' comments with "Track Changes" function (MS Word) and identify what changes you have made by 17/07/2024 at the latest. Example of a response letter is given at https://electronicsconf.ktu.edu/public/journals/2/templates/Response_to_Review_Comments.docx . If you find any of the reviewer's comments to be unjustified or inappropriate, please explain your perspective.

When you have completed your revisions, you can upload revised documents along with your response to the reviewers' comments at your submission dashboard. If you have been logged out, you can login again with the username lihaitao.

Please note that each article, monograph, handbook, etc., mentioned in the list of references must follow the Instructions for Authors. We'd like to ask you to verify DOIs to all the items in References list and assign their own DOI, if they are missing. 

If you have any questions, please contact me from your submission dashboard.

We look forward to receiving your revised submission.

 

Yours Sincerely,
Prof.  Darius Andriukaitis
Electronics Conference Organizing Committee
+370-37-300519 | http://electronicsconf.ktu.edu

The following comments were received from reviewers.

Reviewer 1:
Is the paper written in the right format?

Yes

Is the abstract appropriate and adequate of the work presented?

Yes

Does the introduction clearly state the background and motivation in terms understandable to the non-specialist?

Yes

Are the figures, tables and their captions clear and complete?

Must be improved

Are the equations clear and consistent?

Can be improved

Is the coverage of the topic sufficiently comprehensive and balanced?

Treatment somewhat unbalanced, but not seriously so

Are references appropriate to the presented work?

Must be improved

How would you rate the list of references?

Are they up-to-date? Did majority come from the journals?

Must be improved

How would you describe the technical depth of the paper?

Suitable only for an expert

How would you rate the technical novelty of the paper?

Somewhat novel

Is it clear from the paper what has been done and why?

Yes

Are the conclusions supported by the results? 

Yes

How would you rate the scientific quality of the paper?

Very good

How would you rate the novelty of the paper?

Sufficiently novel

How would you rate the originality of the paper?

Very good

How do you rate the English usage?

I am not qualified to assess the quality of English in this paper

How would you rate the overall organization of the paper?

Satisfactory

Did you detect plagiarism or self-plagiarism?

No

Reviewer’s comments for Author:

Paper is relevant and actual for photovoltaic research.
There are some light mistakes:
After eq1, there are no describing of variable h.
In fig 4 still remains chinese marks for voltage and temperature axis. Figure caption is not under figure.
Literature 15-24, 26 ,28 30-32, are not mentioned in text. Please verify if all references are really cited in the text.

 

Reviewer 2:
Is the paper written in the right format?

Yes

Is the abstract appropriate and adequate of the work presented?

Yes

emails.text: Start Daily Start Daily 每日荐读将于每个工作日为您奉上当天焦点资讯 出征！巴黎奥运会中国体育代表团今天成立，运动员405人！央视新闻报道，北京时间7月13日上午10点，巴黎奥运会中国体育代表团成立动员大会在北京举行。 代表团共由716人组成，其中运动员405人，包括男运动员136人、女运动员269人。 代表团运动员平均年龄25岁，其中有42位奥运冠军，223人为首次参加奥运会。一点资讯 马斯克同款！浙江14岁女孩确诊“天才病”：无法治愈科普世界   河南濮阳13岁尿毒症晚期男孩深夜捡废品引全网心疼，进展：正检查是否符合换肾条件潇湘晨报 汪峰还能坐住？森林北喊话已报案青春娱乐网   黄一鸣被骂哭，被举报后已停播，公司倒油，新女友住进王思聪豪宅一览vaas 什么都玉只会害了你！《黑神话》吧友发现蜘蛛精都是光着脚，玩家：这下更爱玩了！18183手游网   BW惊现“落坨翔子”？不开空调不能上厕所，二次元特种兵也是人啊！好兔 阅读更多故事反馈获取 Microsoft 资讯应用。此电子邮件是否已转发给你？ 在此处订阅。  退订 | 隐私声明Microsoft CorporationOne Microsoft WayRedmond, WA 98052

emails.subject:
Your submission has been accepted to 28th International conference
 ELECTRONICS
emails.body:
The following email was sent to haitao Li from 28th International conference ELECTRONICS regarding A Vine-Copula Method for Outlier Identification in Photovoltaic Arrays.

You are receiving a copy of this notification because you are identified as an author of the submission. Any instructions in the message below are intended for the submitting author, haitao Li, and no action is required of you at this time.

Dear haitao Li,

I am pleased to inform you that we have decided to accept your submission as an oral presentation to the 28th International Conference ELECTRONICS 2024 and for publication in the research journal "Elektronika ir Elektrotechnika" (ISSN: 1392-1215) without further revision. After careful review, we found your submission, A Vine-Copula Method for Outlier Identification in Photovoltaic Arrays, to meet requirements. 

The 28th International Conference ELECTRONICS 2024 will take place in Palanga, Lithuania, 23rd-25th of September, 2024.

At least one author of the paper has to be registered. Please do not forget to register to the Conference by completing the registration form at https://electronicsconf.ktu.edu/index.php/elc/registration-form Please complete the necessary fields in the registration form if Proforma invoice is needed. Please note that your registration becomes valid after your payment.

Regarding publication in the research journal "Elektronika ir Elektrotechnika", further Copyediting and Proofreading as well as a Publishing will be managed over journal’s website. We would like to ask you to upload your accepted paper as a new submission at http://eejournal.ktu.lt/

Please do these 6 things for successful submission:

1) you should agree on all points since system doesn’t allow to skip them.

2) write down the conference submission ID in the field “Comments for the Editor” which consists of one/two/three numbers.

3) upload the paper with the accepted corrections as an „Article Text“.

4) upload the paper with the visible corrections as an „Revised Article with Highlighted Corrections“.

5) download and sign the Authors guarantee form either in regular way and then scan it or sign with a valid digital signature. The form is available at http://eejournal.ktu.lt/public/users/elt/Authors_guarantee_form.pdf . Please note that it has to be uploaded as an „Authors Guarantee Form“.

6) upload the compressed graphic files as a „Compressed Graphic Files (*.zip, *.rar)“.

 

We would like to thank you for your interest.

If you have any questions, please contact me from your submission dashboard.

 

Yours Sincerely,
Prof.  Darius Andriukaitis
Electronics Conference Organizing Committee
+370-37-300519 | http://electronicsconf.ktu.edu

emails.subject: Are you ready to take your career to the next level?

emails.subject: Develop smarter with JetBrains tools
emails.body:
Hello XIAOXIAO,

Thank you for choosing JetBrains development tools!

We have prepared some useful information to help you apply the great functionalities of our tools to your daily development, and assist you to better manage your licenses.
Product Technical Support

We have prepared an online resource for each of our products to help you develop using our tools, including Tech support portal [ https://www.jetbrains.com/support ], Community Forums [ https://intellij-support.jetbrains.com/hc/en-us/community/topics/ ], Plug-in Repository [ https://plugins.jetbrains.com/ ], Webinars [ https://www.jetbrains.com/support/webinars/ ], Product demos [ https://www.youtube.com/user/JetBrainsTV ], and more. If you have any questions regarding our products, please reply to this email or submit your request [ https://www.jetbrains.com/support/ ] at the "Support Home" of the corresponding product.
License Management

With JetBrains Account system [ https://account.jetbrains.com/licenses/ ], you can manage all your licenses and purchase details under one account. If you have licenses in separate accounts, we can help you merge them. If you need any help, please feel free to reply to this email.

Learn how to deliver and activate IDE or .NET tool licenses [ https://www.jetbrains.com/store/post-purchase/ ]
Technological developments

JetBrains tools combine the most popular and modern technologies. We also make available a range of blogs, newsletters, tutorials and other learning resources on a regular basis, to help you adopt these technologies and effectively use them together with JetBrains tools. You can subscribe to:
- Monthly Newsletter [ https://www.jetbrains.com/newsletter/ ]: Have JetBrains Newsletter delivered directly to your inbox each month.
- Company Blog [ https://blog.jetbrains.com/ ]: Receive information about the most up-to-date JetBrains company news and specific product updates.


Yours truly,
The JetBrains Team
https://www.jetbrains.com
The Drive to Develop

1. Search for Abstracts: If you're looking for research papers on a specific topic, you can use the “searchAbstracts” function. You'll need to provide keywords related to your topic, and optionally, you can specify the sort order (like relevance or publication date), whether you want only peer-reviewed articles, and a date range.
2. Retrieve Full Text: Once you've found an interesting abstract, you can use the “getFullText” function to retrieve the full text of the paper. You'll need the URL for the PDF of the paper.
3. Ask Questions From a Specific Paper: If you have a specific question about a paper, you can use the “question” function. You'll need the URL for the PDF of the paper and your specific question.
4. Save Citations: If you want to save a citation to your Zotero reference manager, you can use the “saveCitation” function. You'll need the DOI of the article, your Zotero User ID, and your Zotero API Key.
5. Find Related Papers: To find papers related to a specific paper, you can use the “literatureMap” function. You'll need the ss_id of the paper and can specify a theme for the related papers you're interested in.
6. Get Paper Metadata: If you have a specific identifier for a paper (like DOI, PMID, etc.), you can use the “getPaperMetadata” function to find detailed information about that paper.

emails.subject: 潇潇, 文献鸟写作助手一系列更新
emails.body:
潇潇,

	文献鸟的“$this->_build_link_list("https://www.storkapp.cn/writeassistant/",
"写作助手")”（点击访问官网）可以有效地把中式英语变成地道专业的英语，甚至把不成句子的片段用专业英语表达出来。写作助手已经帮助过许多科研人员发表高分文章。在过去一段时间里，文献鸟的写作助手连续进行了三次更新，分别增加了自定义指令功能、句海探珍功能以及中文润色功能（目前所有更新功能已同步到Word插件中）。

	strtoupper("自定义指令功能")是写作助手的一次飞跃性升级，它能够根据我们的需求提供个性化的帮助。无论是扩写或缩写段落，撰写回复邮件，还是根据文本创作诗歌，只要脑洞够大，写作助手就能展现出它无限的可能性。

	strtoupper("句海探珍功能")如同一个宝库，蕴藏着无数精彩的文献实句，等待着您去发掘运用。无论是为写作找到支撑论据，还是为文章增色添彩，这一功能都能为您提供丰富的素材支持。

	strtoupper("中文润色功能")如同一位细致入微的编辑，帮您纠正语法错误、优化词汇表达。无论是撰写文章还是日常通过电子邮件进行沟通，这一功能都能适应您的需求。

	这些功能的更新丰富了写作助手的应用场景以及写作效率，给科研人带来了极大的便利。

	strtoupper("张然副研究员/主治医生")

	strtoupper("北京大学口腔医学院")

	“修改后语言更简洁；修改语言结构意思也更明确，有时候把自己想说说不清楚的能很智能的表达清楚，比较意外；语法、语病几乎得到修正；用词比较专业，对非母语者提示作用很强。”

	strtoupper("裴晓萌副研究员")

	strtoupper("香港理工大学")

	“记得我最初写文章手稿的时候为了句子更加准确，同时逻辑顺畅又有表达多样性，一句话来回修改多次也不尽人意，如果你也遇到同样的问题，快去试试文献鸟的写作助手，点石成金、纠正语法、神笔续写一定让你轻松又高效的完成一篇最地道、通畅的论文！”

	strtoupper("杜娟娟教授")

	strtoupper("清华大学")

	“以前写作总是因为选词和句式费半天脑子，写作助手可以给出相同意思的多个不同的句子，语言再也不显得那么单调啦，现在感觉写作都轻松了好多。”

	strtoupper("李日辉教授")

	strtoupper("澳门大学")

	“写作助手可以帮助科研人员提高写作水平。虽然我有丰富的写作经验，我还是使用写作助手来改善我的论文。”

	现在，让我们一起来回顾这些新增功能吧。

	strtoupper("自定义指令")

	自定义的指令在输入框的上方，由一系列图标组成，每个图标代表一个指令，在输入框中选中相应文字，并点击对应的指令，即可看到修改后的文字。

	点击图标右侧添加指令的按钮，便可以在指令框内输入指令，并根据您的习惯和需求选择对应的图标及颜色，用以区分不同图标。

	类似地，点击修改指令符号可以修改或者删除已有指令。

	我们可以使用自定义指令对文章进行扩写和缩写。

	或是润色文章标题。

	还可以使用自定义指令帮我们回复简单的审稿意见。

	我们可以根据不同的场合和情况修改、删除或新增对应的指令。不要被现有的指令所限制，写作助手的潜力无限。

	strtoupper("句海探珍")

	句海探珍功能可以为您找到浩瀚的文献中你想要的论据支撑以及表达方式。

	只需要将某个表达输入写作助手左侧栏，点击句海探珍就会找到他人文献中的类似表达。并且会标注出该表达来源文献的相关信息。

	我们还可以将句海探珍和点石成金进行结合，先使用句海探珍找到文献中我们需要的表达，再使用点石成金进行改写，便能得到想要的句子了。

	按照相同的思路，我们还可以结合神笔续写和句海功能，为续写的内容找到依据，同时也可以激发灵感。

	总体来说，句海探珍功能不仅限于提升文章的文采，更能在寻找论据、优化学术表达和激发创意等方面助您一臂之力。

	strtoupper("中文润色")

	目前，除了英文之外，写作助手还支持多种语言的润色处理，尤其是中文润色，这对我们中国人十分友好。

	它可以帮我们修改错误的语言表达，提高中文写作水平。

	也可以只针对语法问题进行修改。

	同时中文润色也能够应用于一些非正式的场合。例如，帮助你组织语言给老师发邮件。

	总体来说，中文润色通过对句子进行语法调整、用词优化等操作，不仅能让文章读起来更加地道，让读者产生共鸣，同时可适用的场合增多，是我们在科研写作中必不可少的小帮手！

	strtoupper("【写作助手Word插件更新】")

	现在 Word
插件和网页版的功能已经完全同步啦！包含了近期的几次更新：自定义指令、句海探珍和对中文文章的润色。

	有个别用户发现左边选中后，右侧反应很慢。现在增加了“自动拓展选中文字至整句”的选项。过去在用户鼠标点击文字的时候，或者选中部分句子的时候，写作助手会自动扩展到整句。这可能导致了这个延迟。现在，点击这个选项，就可以停止自动扩展。

	通过以上介绍，希望大家可以了解并掌握写作助手的功能以及应用技巧。这些新功能的推出，都是基于人工智能技术的最新成果，经过精细的训练和优化，以确保能够最大程度辅助科研生活。在未来，文献鸟的写作助手将继续致力于创新，不断为大家带来更多贴心、实用的功能，助您在写作的道路上越走越远。

	strtoupper("【如何使用】")

	写作助手是文献鸟Stork的高级功能，若想用它帮助您阅读文献需要购买此功能。当然我们也提供试用机会。注册/登录文献鸟（https://www.storkapp.cn）后，在关键词下方找到写作助手，就可以试用或者购买该功能。或者直接点击下方的阅读原文，就到写作助手的官方网站

emails.text: 潇潇, 文献鸟的“$this->_build_link_list("https://www.storkapp.cn/writeassistant/", "写作助手")”（点击访问官网）可以有效地把中式英语变成地道专业的英语，甚至把不成句子的片段用专业英语表达出来。写作助手已经帮助过许多科研人员发表高分文章。在过去一段时间里，文献鸟的写作助手连续进行了三次更新，分别增加了自定义指令功能、句海探珍功能以及中文润色功能（目前所有更新功能已同步到Word插件中）。 strtoupper("自定义指令功能")是写作助手的一次飞跃性升级，它能够根据我们的需求提供个性化的帮助。无论是扩写或缩写段落，撰写回复邮件，还是根据文本创作诗歌，只要脑洞够大，写作助手就能展现出它无限的可能性。 strtoupper("句海探珍功能")如同一个宝库，蕴藏着无数精彩的文献实句，等待着您去发掘运用。无论是为写作找到支撑论据，还是为文章增色添彩，这一功能都能为您提供丰富的素材支持。 strtoupper("中文润色功能")如同一位细致入微的编辑，帮您纠正语法错误、优化词汇表达。无论是撰写文章还是日常通过电子邮件进行沟通，这一功能都能适应您的需求。 这些功能的更新丰富了写作助手的应用场景以及写作效率，给科研人带来了极大的便利。 strtoupper("张然副研究员/主治医生") strtoupper("北京大学口腔医学院") “修改后语言更简洁；修改语言结构意思也更明确，有时候把自己想说说不清楚的能很智能的表达清楚，比较意外；语法、语病几乎得到修正；用词比较专业，对非母语者提示作用很强。” strtoupper("裴晓萌副研究员") strtoupper("香港理工大学") “记得我最初写文章手稿的时候为了句子更加准确，同时逻辑顺畅又有表达多样性，一句话来回修改多次也不尽人意，如果你也遇到同样的问题，快去试试文献鸟的写作助手，点石成金、纠正语法、神笔续写一定让你轻松又高效的完成一篇最地道、通畅的论文！” strtoupper("杜娟娟教授") strtoupper("清华大学") “以前写作总是因为选词和句式费半天脑子，写作助手可以给出相同意思的多个不同的句子，语言再也不显得那么单调啦，现在感觉写作都轻松了好多。” strtoupper("李日辉教授") strtoupper("澳门大学") “写作助手可以帮助科研人员提高写作水平。虽然我有丰富的写作经验，我还是使用写作助手来改善我的论文。” 现在，让我们一起来回顾这些新增功能吧。 strtoupper("自定义指令") 自定义的指令在输入框的上方，由一系列图标组成，每个图标代表一个指令，在输入框中选中相应文字，并点击对应的指令，即可看到修改后的文字。 点击图标右侧添加指令的按钮，便可以在指令框内输入指令，并根据您的习惯和需求选择对应的图标及颜色，用以区分不同图标。 类似地，点击修改指令符号可以修改或者删除已有指令。 我们可以使用自定义指令对文章进行扩写和缩写。 或是润色文章标题。 还可以使用自定义指令帮我们回复简单的审稿意见。 我们可以根据不同的场合和情况修改、删除或新增对应的指令。不要被现有的指令所限制，写作助手的潜力无限。 strtoupper("句海探珍") 句海探珍功能可以为您找到浩瀚的文献中你想要的论据支撑以及表达方式。 只需要将某个表达输入写作助手左侧栏，点击句海探珍就会找到他人文献中的类似表达。并且会标注出该表达来源文献的相关信息。 我们还可以将句海探珍和点石成金进行结合，先使用句海探珍找到文献中我们需要的表达，再使用点石成金进行改写，便能得到想要的句子了。 按照相同的思路，我们还可以结合神笔续写和句海功能，为续写的内容找到依据，同时也可以激发灵感。 总体来说，句海探珍功能不仅限于提升文章的文采，更能在寻找论据、优化学术表达和激发创意等方面助您一臂之力。 strtoupper("中文润色") 目前，除了英文之外，写作助手还支持多种语言的润色处理，尤其是中文润色，这对我们中国人十分友好。 它可以帮我们修改错误的语言表达，提高中文写作水平。 也可以只针对语法问题进行修改。 同时中文润色也能够应用于一些非正式的场合。例如，帮助你组织语言给老师发邮件。 总体来说，中文润色通过对句子进行语法调整、用词优化等操作，不仅能让文章读起来更加地道，让读者产生共鸣，同时可适用的场合增多，是我们在科研写作中必不可少的小帮手！ strtoupper("【写作助手Word插件更新】") 现在 Word 插件和网页版的功能已经完全同步啦！包含了近期的几次更新：自定义指令、句海探珍和对中文文章的润色。 有个别用户发现左边选中后，右侧反应很慢。现在增加了“自动拓展选中文字至整句”的选项。过去在用户鼠标点击文字的时候，或者选中部分句子的时候，写作助手会自动扩展到整句。这可能导致了这个延迟。现在，点击这个选项，就可以停止自动扩展。 通过以上介绍，希望大家可以了解并掌握写作助手的功能以及应用技巧。这些新功能的推出，都是基于人工智能技术的最新成果，经过精细的训练和优化，以确保能够最大程度辅助科研生活。在未来，文献鸟的写作助手将继续致力于创新，不断为大家带来更多贴心、实用的功能，助您在写作的道路上越走越远。 strtoupper("【如何使用】") 写作助手是文献鸟Stork的高级功能，若想用它帮助您阅读文献需要购买此功能。当然我们也提供试用机会。注册/登录文献鸟（https://www.storkapp.cn）后，在关键词下方找到写作助手，就可以试用或者购买该功能。或者直接点击下方的阅读原文，就到写作助手的官方网站 TSFS 2024 - 13-14 December 2024 - Monastir, Tunisia - Approaching
 deadline
emails.body:
<<ICBFS_2024.png>> [https://tsfs2024.sciencesconf.org/rg/?lang=en]



Only 01 week left until the deadline
CALL FOR PAPERS

The 11th Tunisian Society for Financial Studies Conference 

TSFS 2024

13-14 December 2024 (Monastir, Tunisia)
Dear colleagues and friends,

You are cordially invited to submit your research papers to the 11th Tunisian Society for Financial Studies (TSFS 2024), taking place on December 13-14, 2024, in Monastir, Tunisia, one of the world’s most popular tourist destinations. The conference will take place in person; however, we can exceptionally accommodate some online presentations upon request. Please feel free to submit your work, either full manuscripts or extended abstracts.

This meeting, organized by the Tunisian Society for Financial Studies in partnership with IHE Tunis, EM Normandie Business School (France), the Institut Supérieur de Finances et de Fiscalité de Sousse, the BESTMOD Research Center, and the International Society for the Advancement of Financial Economics (ISAFE) , aims to bring together academics, practitioners, and policymakers to share their research findings and discuss current and challenging issues in financial economics. The meeting is also an ideal occasion for rising/early career scholars to exchange research experiences and develop research projects with their international colleagues.

Conference dates

13 Dec 2024 - 14 Dec 2024

Location

Kuriat Palace Hotel, Monastir-Tunisia.

Conference website

https://tsfs2024.sciencesconf.org/

TOPICS:

We welcome papers that delve into several pertinent topics. These topics include, but are not limited to:
[https://s449q.mjt.lu/img2/s449q/8bb8cd02-4666-44aa-b7ff-8f8815e89b40/content]
KEYNOTE SPEAKERs: 

 * Pr. Arman Eshraghi - Cardiff Business School, United Kingdom.
 * Pr. Jean-François Gajewski - IAE Lyon School of Management, Université Jean Moulin Lyon 3, France.
 * Pr. Khaled Hussainey - Bangor Business School, United Kingdom.

STEERING COMMITTEE

 * Slaheddine Hallara (Tunis University, Tunisia)
 * Houssam Bouzgarrou (Sousse University, Tunisia)
 * Sabri Boubaker (EM Normandie Business School, France)
 * Imen Ghadhab (Sousse University, Tunisia)

CO-CHAIRS:

 * Houssam Bouzgarrou (Sousse University, Tunisia)
 * Imen Ghadhab (Sousse University, Tunisia)

JOURNALS SPECIAL ISSUES

Special issue of Journal of Forecasting [https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/journal/1099131X?gad_source=1&gclid=CjwKCAjwupGyBhBBEiwA0UcqaCvaWHVbee58shAWIy72DBDwlpHbrY14S2MgfNACnQ_RxuFJYfMtxhoC8CUQAvD_BwE&utm_campaign=R3MR425&utm_content=BusEconFinAcc&utm_medium=paidsearch&utm_source=google], titled “Forecasting carbon prices in an integrated market network” under the Guest-editorship of Assoc. Prof. Hung Do, Dr. Linh H. Nguyen, and Dr. Thomas Walther. Submission deadline: 28th February 2025. See call for papers [https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ceKt-OmroBEj29mW4IBLKQLiHJ97fsVE/view].

Special Issue of Journal of Economic Asymmetries [https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/the-journal-of-economic-asymmetries], titled “Asymmetries in Environmental Economics and Sustainable Finance” under the Guest-editorship of Prof. Md Akhtaruzzaman, Prof. Sabri Boubaker and Prof. Thai-Ha Le. Submission deadline: July 31st, 2025. See call for papers [https://tsfs2024.sciencesconf.org/data/pages/SI_Asymmetries_in_Environmental_Economics_and_Finance_31082024_special_issue_1.pdf].

Special issue of Development and Sustainability in Economics and Finance [https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/development-and-sustainability-in-economics-and-finance], titled “Innovations and Challenges in Sustainable Finance” under the Guest-editorship of Pr. Sabri Boubaker, Pr. Izidin El Kalak and Pr. Imen Ghadhab. Submission deadline: July 31st, 2025. See call for papers [https://tsfs2024.sciencesconf.org/data/pages/Development_and_sustainability_in_economics_and_finance_SI.pdf].

PUBLICATION OPPORTUNITIES: 

The Co-chairs of the conference will invite selected papers to be submitted and considered for publication in one of the following journals

 * International Review of Economics and Finance
 * Journal of Financial Reporting and Accounting
 * Journal of International Financial Management and Accounting
 * Journal of Risk Finance
 * Review of Accounting and Finance
 * Journal of Modern Finance
 * Journal of Development and Sustainability in Economics and Finance
 * Journal of Management and Prospective
 * Review of Corporate Finance
[https://s449q.mjt.lu/img2/s449q/98706525-b1e3-4e04-bef4-3ca07105d167/content]



TIMELINE AND SUBMISSION PROCESS: Full papers  extended abstracts (in PDF version) should be submitted by September 30, 2024. Decisions will be made no later than October 06, 2024.

Should you require more time to complete your submission or have any questions, please feel free to contact us.

IMPORTANT DATES:

Submission deadline: September 30, 2024.

潇潇, NIH的研究项目编号有何含义？
emails.body:
潇潇,

	美国国立卫生研究院（NIH）是全球最大的生物医学研究公共资助机构。在2023年，
NIH共计资助了近59000项研究基金，包括竞争性和非竞争性资助，总额高达349亿美元。

	如果我们能够访问这些研究项目的内容，不仅有助于了解领域前沿，还可以为自己申请项目基金提供参考和借鉴。

	通过文献鸟的美国国立卫生研究院（NIH）经费数据库，我们可以搜索从
1985 年至今近 40
年里成功申请到NIH经费的项目。下图是我们搜索到的结果信息。

	不过，大多人往往忽略了一个细节：看似无足轻重的项目编号，实则蕴含了重要信息。

	strtoupper("Lets go")

	strtoupper("项目编号有何含义？")

	在NIH的项目编号中，第一个字符表示基金的类型，前三个字符为活动代码，表示具体的资助类型和用途。

	NIH基金的主要类型和说明如下：

	strtoupper("National Institutes of Health")strtoupper("")

	strtoupper("R系列，通常用于研究项目")

	strtoupper("R01")：研究项目资助 -
最常见；用于成熟的研究项目；无金额限制。

	strtoupper("R03")：小额资助项目 -
用于短期项目；支持预实验、初步收集数据、对现有数据二次分析等。

	strtoupper("R21")：探索性/发展性研究资助 -
用于新的、探索性研究；为R01项目提供前期数据。

	strtoupper("R41/42")：小企业转让技术研究-推进研究成果的开发和商业化。

	strtoupper("R43/R44")：小企业创新研究

	Tips：如果您正在申请国家自然科学基金，不妨多看看领域内R01的项目；如果您想做一些具有大创新的研究，不妨看看R21的项目找寻灵感；如果您意向横向项目，可以多参考R41/42/43/44的项目。

	strtoupper("Stork")

	strtoupper("National Institutes of Health")strtoupper("")

	strtoupper("K系列，支持职业发展")

	strtoupper("K01")：指导下的研究科学家发展奖 -
支持和培养新进的研究人员，包括博士后和初级助理教授，通常用于非临床医生研究人员。

	strtoupper("K08")：指导下的临床科学家研究职业发展奖
-主要针对希望结合临床和研究工作的新进医生科学家。

	strtoupper("K99/R00")：独立之路奖 -
为非常有前途的博士后提供前几年的指导支持，帮助他们从博士后研究员过渡到独立研究者。

	Tips：K系列奖项主要针对的都是博士后或者青椒教师们，因此在内容、创新上和R系列会有所不同。此外，如果您关注临床研究，可以注意K08等的项目

	strtoupper("Stork")

	strtoupper("National Institutes of Health")strtoupper("")

	strtoupper("F系列，针对学生和博士后的奖学金")

	strtoupper("F30")：个人预博士奖学金（针对M. D./Ph.
D和其他双博士学位学生）

	strtoupper("F31")：个人预博士奖学金（适用于单一博士学位的研究生）

	strtoupper("F32")：个人博士后奖学金（适用于博士后研究人员）

	Tips：适合在读的研究生申请项目参考，当然，也可以看看年轻研究者的创造力~

	strtoupper("Stork")

	此外，还有T系列（培训）、P系列（项目计划/中心资助）和U系列（合作协议）等等。如果您在搜索结果中看到了比较小众的编号，可以在以下网页获取NIH项目活动代码的完整列表：

	$this->_build_link_list("https://grants.nih.gov/grants/funding/ac_search_results.htm",
"https://grants.nih.gov/grants/funding/ac_search_results.htm")

	strtoupper("总结")

	了解基金编号背后的含义不仅帮助我们更好地了解科研领域的最新进展，还能提高科研效率，为申请项目和制定研究计划提供宝贵的参考。如果您有申请基金全文的想法，提前了解该项目的资助类型也有助于您做相应的决策。利用好NIH经费数据库这个高级功能，让科学探索更加高效便捷！

	strtoupper("【如何使用】")

emails.text: 潇潇, 美国国立卫生研究院（NIH）是全球最大的生物医学研究公共资助机构。在2023年， NIH共计资助了近59000项研究基金，包括竞争性和非竞争性资助，总额高达349亿美元。 如果我们能够访问这些研究项目的内容，不仅有助于了解领域前沿，还可以为自己申请项目基金提供参考和借鉴。 通过文献鸟的美国国立卫生研究院（NIH）经费数据库，我们可以搜索从 1985 年至今近 40 年里成功申请到NIH经费的项目。下图是我们搜索到的结果信息。 不过，大多人往往忽略了一个细节：看似无足轻重的项目编号，实则蕴含了重要信息。 strtoupper("Lets go") strtoupper("项目编号有何含义？") 在NIH的项目编号中，第一个字符表示基金的类型，前三个字符为活动代码，表示具体的资助类型和用途。 NIH基金的主要类型和说明如下： strtoupper("National Institutes of Health")strtoupper("") strtoupper("R系列，通常用于研究项目") strtoupper("R01")：研究项目资助 - 最常见；用于成熟的研究项目；无金额限制。 strtoupper("R03")：小额资助项目 - 用于短期项目；支持预实验、初步收集数据、对现有数据二次分析等。 strtoupper("R21")：探索性/发展性研究资助 - 用于新的、探索性研究；为R01项目提供前期数据。 strtoupper("R41/42")：小企业转让技术研究-推进研究成果的开发和商业化。 strtoupper("R43/R44")：小企业创新研究 Tips：如果您正在申请国家自然科学基金，不妨多看看领域内R01的项目；如果您想做一些具有大创新的研究，不妨看看R21的项目找寻灵感；如果您意向横向项目，可以多参考R41/42/43/44的项目。 strtoupper("Stork") strtoupper("National Institutes of Health")strtoupper("") strtoupper("K系列，支持职业发展") strtoupper("K01")：指导下的研究科学家发展奖 - 支持和培养新进的研究人员，包括博士后和初级助理教授，通常用于非临床医生研究人员。 strtoupper("K08")：指导下的临床科学家研究职业发展奖 -主要针对希望结合临床和研究工作的新进医生科学家。 strtoupper("K99/R00")：独立之路奖 - 为非常有前途的博士后提供前几年的指导支持，帮助他们从博士后研究员过渡到独立研究者。 Tips：K系列奖项主要针对的都是博士后或者青椒教师们，因此在内容、创新上和R系列会有所不同。此外，如果您关注临床研究，可以注意K08等的项目 strtoupper("Stork") strtoupper("National Institutes of Health")strtoupper("") strtoupper("F系列，针对学生和博士后的奖学金") strtoupper("F30")：个人预博士奖学金（针对M. D./Ph. D和其他双博士学位学生） strtoupper("F31")：个人预博士奖学金（适用于单一博士学位的研究生） strtoupper("F32")：个人博士后奖学金（适用于博士后研究人员） Tips：适合在读的研究生申请项目参考，当然，也可以看看年轻研究者的创造力~ strtoupper("Stork") 此外，还有T系列（培训）、P系列（项目计划/中心资助）和U系列（合作协议）等等。如果您在搜索结果中看到了比较小众的编号，可以在以下网页获取NIH项目活动代码的完整列表： $this->_build_link_list("https://grants.nih.gov/grants/funding/ac_search_results.htm", "https://grants.nih.gov/grants/funding/ac_search_results.htm") strtoupper("总结") 了解基金编号背后的含义不仅帮助我们更好地了解科研领域的最新进展，还能提高科研效率，为申请项目和制定研究计划提供宝贵的参考。如果您有申请基金全文的想法，提前了解该项目的资助类型也有助于您做相应的决策。利用好NIH经费数据库这个高级功能，让科学探索更加高效便捷！ strtoupper("【如何使用】") $this->_build_link_list("https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/Im5N-lzAeXIx_3pPvftgaQ", "NIH经费数据库")是文献鸟Stork的高级功能，需要付费使用（可以免费试用）： 注册/登录文献鸟（https://www.storkapp.cn）后，在关键词下方找到美国国立卫生研究院经费数据库（中英版），就可以试用或者购买该功能。或者点击阅读原文直接进入NIH数据库的官网https://www.storkapp.cn/grant/ 对于短期需求，我们特别提供了按月订阅的服务选项，旨在灵活满足不同用户的多样需求。更为贴心的是，目前我们正赠送总价值为110元的代金券，这意味着您可以免费享受整整一个月的NIH数据库高级功能，无需任何额外花费。把握这次机会，让科研之路变得高效快捷。 文献鸟 Stork 团队 https://www.storkapp.cn 我们的微信公众号: 您收到这封信的原因是您是文献鸟用户。如果要删除您文献鸟账号，请到$this->_build_link_list("https://www.storkapp.cn/accountCenter/update_account.php?firsttime=1", "账户信息页面")，单击页面下方的删除账号并退出按钮。 如果不想收此类通知，请$this->_build_link_list("https://www.storkapp.cn/smart/unsubTutorial.php?id=329116&displayKey=579459124&what=unsubscribeBulkEmail", "单击这里")。 Unsubscribe: https://subscriptions.pstmrk.it/unsubscribe?m=1.gKS2aTXqJIRQSRpnAUOnBg.GI2twSwkiTPV7b54j8avpI6Xf6ps3gi496r3FKBjsilKE1f7ivBb-k0pYjgaYv5Xt2PD4nwSxLj1l6p8ErVQUGku7bmFW18zkuZZSHibyzPWjwREZWfJqe5jaCerL4xjQ0BZCu983fYg7byvohhSfkbf-Ba-blAeewK5eZR_TKYecnLBOQZL0sLUWDjcF2i8gY0mAuqtdEkTC4XiAxKMeNZkX9Px5c7XlfbB_DN3pG0dY1MEb1xe1kLtRponsslPewHD6RUCqAYEcuEdQfDtDUm4eUOMZAyljdol9eBMbLzkuoWP5pNXC0

emails.body:
Dear All,

The 28th International Conference ELECTRONICS 2024 has come and gone. We would like to thank you for your valuable contribution to the great success of Conference.

A big thank you to the Reviewers for constructive comments and suggestions, to the Invited Speakers and Participants that presented their work, to all of you that attended the sessions. Thank you all for coming to Lithuania and participating in ELECTRONICS 2024.

We hope that the conference has been all that you expected it to be and that you have taken the opportunity to make new friends and renew old acquaintances and to have discussion and exchange of many experiences, suggestions and opinions.

Thank you to all of the ELECTRONICS 2024 Sponsors! Without your support the event itself could not have been such a success.

I hope you'll always remember all the great memories we created.

P.S. The certificates of attendance are available at: https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fo/wqbdl32f177nbmx7gp5ah/AOosCVYoh6NaXCm7bxwVQSo?rlkey=yym9qrun9x94s636opfq20vpi&dl=0

Yours Sincerely,
ELECTRONICS Conference Organizing Committee
+370-37-300519 | http://electronicsconf.ktu.edu<http://electronicsconf.ktu.edu/>

If you can make a donation [mirror] to support our work at this time, we would be extremely grateful.Z-Library is one of the largest resources in the world, providing free access to unique books and scientific articles in many different languages since 2009. The main purpose of Z-Library's existence is to enhance the level of education of people around the world. ** ScholarAI: Your AI Academic Assistant
------------------------------------------------------------

As the semester ramps up we know deadlines are looming, research papers are piling up, and stress is increasing. But don't worry—ScholarAI is here to make your school year easier! ** What’s New with ScholarAI?
------------------------------------------------------------

Over the summer, we made several improvements to enhance your ScholarAI experience. From advanced models to team collaboration, here’s what you can look forward to this school year:

* Next-Gen AI Models: We’ve integrated the latest GPT-4o models to support smarter reasoning and precise information extraction across our platform.

Speed Up Literature Reviews:

emails.subject: Getting Started Resources for NVIDIA cuDNN
emails.body:
NVIDIA Logo ( https://www.nvidia.com )

NVIDIA Logo ( https://www.nvidia.com )

Welcome to the NVIDIA cuDNN developer community

Below are resources to get you started.

Installation
Support Matrix 
( https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/sdk/cudnn-support-matrix/index.html?ncid=em-prod-337416 )
: Platform and software version compatibility
Installation Guide 
( https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/sdk/cudnn-install/index.html?ncid=em-prod-337416 )
: Step-by-step instructions for installation and upgrade

Documentation
Developer Guide 
( https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/sdk/cudnn-developer-guide/index.html?ncid=em-prod-337416 )
: Overview of programming model, features and formats supported

cuDNN API 
( https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/sdk/cudnn-api/index.html?ncid=em-prod-337416 )
: Reference for cuDNN library datatypes and APIs

cuDNN Frontend ( https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend ):
Header-only library that wraps the cuDNN C backend library API.

Community
Developer Forum 
( https://forums.developer.nvidia.com/c/ai-deep-learning/libraries-sdk/cudnn/90?ncid=em-prod-337416 )
: Browse introductory “how-to” questions or discuss advanced
tips-and-tricks for your application with the community
Bug Reporting 
( https://developer.nvidia.com/nvidia_bug/add?ncid=em-prod-337416 )
: Help improve cuDNN by reporting bugs and filing enhancement
requests for the cuDNN team

Have feedback? Send us an email developercontact@nvidia.com.

You are receiving this email because you downloaded NVIDIA cuDNN.

NVIDIA Corporation, 2788 San Tomas Expressway Santa Clara, CA
95051.

emails.subject: Welcome to the NVIDIA Developer Program
emails.body:
NVIDIA logo ( https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/ ) 

---------------------------------------
Welcome to the NVIDIA Developer Program
---------------------------------------

You now have access to a repository of
tools, training, and programs built to assist you in building
your GPU-accelerated applications and skill development.

Get Started
-----------

Learning and Training

* NVIDIA Deep Learning Institute (DLI) 
( https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/training/?ncid=em-nurt-331245#cid=dl13_em-nurt_en-us )
: Advance your knowledge with learning materials to self-paced
and live training to educator programs 
( https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/training/educator-programs/?ncid=em-nurt-476092-vt33#cid=dev03_em-nurt_en-us )
.

* NVIDIA On-Demand 
( https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/on-demand/?ncid=em-nurt-148250-vt33#cid=dev03_em-nurt_en-us )
: Explore an extensive catalog of technical webinars, GTC
sessions, demos, research and more - all at your own pace

* Technical Documentation 
( https://docs.nvidia.com/?ncid=em-nurt-309589-vt33#cid=dev03_em-nurt_en-us )
: Read the latest technical information and documentation on
products, libraries, and APIs.

* Technical Blog 
( https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/?ncid=em-nurt-606040-vt33#cid=dev03_em-nurt_en-us )
: Get the most out of NVIDIA SDKs, application frameworks, and
development tools with deeply technical how-to blog posts.

Developer Tools

* SDKs 
( https://developer.nvidia.com/sdk-glossary ): Explore over 650+
NVIDIA SDKs and performance analysis tools for:

* Conversational AI 
( https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/deep-learning-ai/solutions/conversational-ai/?ncid=em-nurt-770955-vt33#cid=dev03_em-nurt_en-us )


* Deep Learning 
( https://developer.nvidia.com/deep-learning?ncid=em-nurt-61160#cid=dl13_em-nurt_en-us )


* Game Development 
( https://developer.nvidia.com/industries/game-development?ncid=em-nurt-549919-vt33#cid=dev03_em-nurt_en-us )


* High-Performance Computing 
( https://developer.nvidia.com/hpc?ncid=em-nurt-52609#cid=dl13_em-nurt_en-us )


* Networking 
( https://developer.nvidia.com/networking?ncid=em-nurt-792894-vt33#cid=dev03_em-nurt_en-us )


* Omniverse 
( https://developer.nvidia.com/nvidia-omniverse-developer-resource-center?ncid=em-nurt-437296-vt33#cid=dev03_em-nurt_en-us )


* Robotics 
( https://developer.nvidia.com/embedded-computing?ncid=em-nurt-23528#cid=dl13_em-nurt_en-us )


* NVIDIA GPU Catalog (NGC) 
( https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/gpu-cloud/?ncid=em-nurt-645824-vt33#cid=dev03_em-nurt_en-us )
: Access a repository of free GPU-optimized software for AI,
Machine Learning, and HPC.

* Found A Bug? 
( https://developer.nvidia.com/nvidia_bug/add?ncid=em-nurt-552028-vt33#cid=dev03_em-nurt_en-us )
 Report bugs directly to NVIDIA product engineers.

Community and Networking

* NVIDIA Forum 
( https://forums.developer.nvidia.com/?ncid=em-nurt-90266#cid=dl13_em-nurt_en-us )
 : Network with developers, GPU experts, and find solutions.

* NVIDIA Inception Program 
( https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/startups/?ncid=em-nurt-609343-vt33#cid=dev02_em-nurt_en-us )
: Evolve faster through access to technology and NVIDIA experts,
opportunities to connect with venture capitalists, and
co-marketing support to heighten your company’s visibility.

Access Member Portal

( https://developer.nvidia.com/nvidia-developer-program?ncid=em-nurt-420552-vt33#cid=dev02_em-nurt_en-us )

emails.subject: 潇潇, 新高级功能【智文】，5分钟帮您写出高质量论文
emails.body:
潇潇,

	$this->_build_link_list("https://www.storkapp.cn/aipaper/",
"点击试用智文")→

	strtoupper("你是否曾经坐在电脑前，头疼于撰写一篇即将投稿的研究论文？万事开头难，前言部分似乎总是最难。")

	——前言不仅要求你从广泛的视角介绍研究领域，还要逐步引导到具体的研究问题或假设。这时候你会想：如果有工具可以帮助我写前言多好啊！

	strtoupper("或")strtoupper("者你还没有经历投稿和发表这么大的压力，你只是一名从来没写过论文的大学生，某天课堂上老师布置了一篇课程论文作为结课作业。")

	——霎时间，感觉天都塌了！连知网都不常用的人怎么写出一篇完整的论文！这时，你一定在想：如果有工具可以帮助我写小论文多好啊！

	strtoupper("又或者，你根本还没有做研究的任何头绪，只有一些模糊的想法，急需一个知识渊博的人和你头脑风暴，帮助梳理思路。")

	——这时候你想：如果有工具可以根据我的想法写篇小摘要多好啊！

	现在，开挂神器——$this->_build_link_list("https://www.storkapp.cn/aipaper/",
"strtoupper("文献鸟的“智文”高级功能")")strtoupper("")来了！前言、摘要、小论文统统不在话下！与一位知识渊博的AI一起写论文是什么体验？我们一起来看看吧！

	strtoupper("01")

	strtoupper("写前言")

	strtoupper(" Info")

	在前言部分，我们需要阅读文献，回顾所在领域的历史和近况，还要从恰当的角度提出该研究的意义和重要性。文献鸟的【智文】可以帮助你查阅文献并写出前言，并支持中文和英文。

	选择“论文前言”，并在新页面的输入框内标题和其他材料（如关键词，小标题，方法，结果，你所希望的结构等）。这里我们以“大学生考试期间的焦虑水平”为主题，并对前言提出相应的要求。接着点击
“开始写”。

	以下就是【智文】帮我们写的前言。

	strtoupper("I.
")从字数上，大概2000字左右的前言，非常接近我们投稿时的前言字数，这意味着我们可以在里面获得足够多的信息；

	strtoupper("II.
")结构上非常完整，包括最初的引入、文献综述、研究意义和问题提出等多个部分；

	strtoupper("III.
")内容上既有概括性和总结性的语句，也有相应的论据介绍和具体的研究方法。绝不会让文章显得假大空。

	例如“一项针对波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那大一学生的研究发现，超过60%的学生报告经历中等到严重程度的考试焦虑(Kusturica,
2019)。” 

	“研究将使用西方考试焦虑量表(Westside Test Anxiety
Scale)(AHMAD box-sizing: border-box;">strtoupper("IV.")
整篇前言里包含着大量的参考文献，
这使得文章更加严谨可信。

	你还可以点击参考文献的标题跳转到该文献的在线页面进行阅读和下载。

	strtoupper("02")

	strtoupper("写小论文")

	strtoupper(" Info")

	不是所有情形下我们都需要写长篇论文，某些课程作业也会要求针对某个主题写一篇短小精悍的小论文。文献鸟的【智文】写出来的小论文会包含论文的完整结构（背景、方法、结果、讨论等），篇幅一般较短。支持中文和英文。

	选择“小论文”，并在新页面的输入框内标题和其他材料（如关键词，小标题，方法，结果，你所希望的结构等）。这里我们给出“女大学生阅读言情小说对恋爱观的影响”的标题。接着点击
“开始写”让【智文】自由发挥。

	下图就是【智文】帮我们写出的小论文，3000字左右的长度符合小论文的一般要求，结构也十分完整，除了该有的前言、文献综述、方法、结果、讨论和参考文献等部分，还十分贴心地帮我们写了摘要部分。

	strtoupper("03")

	strtoupper("写摘要")

	strtoupper(" Info")

	摘要有两种用法。一种是你已经有文章的内容，要写出摘要；这种情况下【智文】会总结您输入的内容，帮您总结并写出摘要。另一种是您有创新想法，但是无人讨论；这时您只需输入简单的想法或关键词，它就能将其具体化为详细的摘要。它就像一个随时可用的知识渊博的讨论伙伴，帮助你进行头脑风暴和想法完善。支持中文和英文。

	选择“摘要”，并在输入框输入相应的信息，针对以上第一种情况，除了标题外，可以告诉【智文】一些详细信息，例如被试数量、实验范式、主要结果等。这里我们以“人类与宠物狗之间的互动，一项超扫描研究”为例，并增加“我们在这项研究中有32对人狗参与者。结果显示在互动条件下PFC的脑间一致性增加。”信息。点击“开始写”。

	我们可以看到智文帮我们生成了一篇完整的摘要。

	针对第二种想要头脑风暴的情况，你可以输入简短的信息看看【智文】会给你带来什么灵感。

	退出“智文”再重新进入，输入同样的标题，“智文”还可以给你不同的答案，你可以多次输入同样的标题获得尽可能多的信息来帮助你找到灵感。下图就是“气候与明朝的灭亡”这个标题的另一篇摘要。

	strtoupper("⚠️ Caution")

	strtoupper("结果仅供大家拓展思路使用，内容还需自己进行核实。")

	strtoupper("04")

	strtoupper("如何写新文章及查看历史？")

	点击左上角的“写新文章”，即可回到初始页面重新选择相应的功能。点击左下角对应的历史文章，可以快速看到先前生成的内容，而不必等待加载。

	strtoupper("05")

	strtoupper("如何复制论文信息？")

	您可以鼠标选中部分字段使用快捷键复制，也可以点击右下角的“复制”一键复制所有信息。

	strtoupper("06")

	strtoupper("如何切换英文样例")

	网页默认显示中文样例，可通过点击“英文样例”进行切换。使用英文输入生成的前言、小论文和摘要默认也是英文的。

	strtoupper("【用户评价】")

	strtoupper("崔旭博士")

	strtoupper("斯坦福大学")

	“现在我写论文的时候离不开【智文】了。我总是让它帮我写初版的前言，然后根据我的建议，再让它写第二版第三版等。在这个过程中，它总能给我一些意外的惊喜:找到我过去不知道的文献和提供新的角度。”

	strtoupper("戴薇")

	strtoupper("首都医科大学")

	“【智文】是论文写作的好助手，可以帮助我在开始动笔前快速整理文章思路和大纲，提供多角度的引导，协助我快速理清文章的思路和结构，帮助我更全面地思考论文的内容。”

	strtoupper("纪健主治医师")

	strtoupper("北京儿童医院")

	“我觉得这个程序特别实用，尤其是参考文献的检索。”

	strtoupper("许传强博士")

	strtoupper("沈阳农业大学")

	“输入了我们科研小组正在撰写的文章英文关键词进行测试，结果让我眼前一亮!结果列出的内容非常具有参考价值!且与研究内容的匹配准确度非常高!”

	strtoupper("黄耿博士")

	strtoupper("衡阳师范学院")

	“作为首批【智文】的体验者，必须得承认它给了我很大的帮助。智文提供了写作者所需要的完整框架，引用的文献全部可靠真实，按照这个框架思路并结合文献鸟的其他写作工具，能够非常高效地解决了写论文“万事开头难”的难题。智文已成为我在论文写作中不可多得的助手。”

	strtoupper("【如何使用】")

	【智文】是文献鸟新推出的高级功能，需要付费使用（strtoupper("注册用户在购买前可以免费尝试10
篇）")：

	注册/登录文献鸟（https://www.storkapp.cn）后，在关键词下方找到智文，就可以试用或者购买该功能。或者直接点击下方的阅读原文，进入智文的官网https://www.storkapp.cn/aipaper/

")内容上既有概括性和总结性的语句，也有相应的论据介绍和具体的研究方法。绝不会让文章显得假大空。 例如“一项针对波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那大一学生的研究发现，超过60%的学生报告经历中等到严重程度的考试焦虑(Kusturica, 2019)。” “研究将使用西方考试焦虑量表(Westside Test Anxiety Scale)(AHMAD box-sizing: border-box;">strtoupper("IV.") 整篇前言里包含着大量的参考文献， 这使得文章更加严谨可信。 你还可以点击参考文献的标题跳转到该文献的在线页面进行阅读和下载。 strtoupper("02") strtoupper("写小论文") strtoupper(" Info") 不是所有情形下我们都需要写长篇论文，某些课程作业也会要求针对某个主题写一篇短小精悍的小论文。文献鸟的【智文】写出来的小论文会包含论文的完整结构（背景、方法、结果、讨论等），篇幅一般较短。支持中文和英文。 选择“小论文”，并在新页面的输入框内标题和其他材料（如关键词，小标题，方法，结果，你所希望的结构等）。这里我们给出“女大学生阅读言情小说对恋爱观的影响”的标题。接着点击 “开始写”让【智文】自由发挥。 下图就是【智文】帮我们写出的小论文，3000字左右的长度符合小论文的一般要求，结构也十分完整，除了该有的前言、文献综述、方法、结果、讨论和参考文献等部分，还十分贴心地帮我们写了摘要部分。 strtoupper("03") strtoupper("写摘要") strtoupper(" Info") 摘要有两种用法。一种是你已经有文章的内容，要写出摘要；这种情况下【智文】会总结您输入的内容，帮您总结并写出摘要。另一种是您有创新想法，但是无人讨论；这时您只需输入简单的想法或关键词，它就能将其具体化为详细的摘要。它就像一个随时可用的知识渊博的讨论伙伴，帮助你进行头脑风暴和想法完善。支持中文和英文。 选择“摘要”，并在输入框输入相应的信息，针对以上第一种情况，除了标题外，可以告诉【智文】一些详细信息，例如被试数量、实验范式、主要结果等。这里我们以“人类与宠物狗之间的互动，一项超扫描研究”为例，并增加“我们在这项研究中有32对人狗参与者。结果显示在互动条件下PFC的脑间一致性增加。”信息。点击“开始写”。 我们可以看到智文帮我们生成了一篇完整的摘要。 针对第二种想要头脑风暴的情况，你可以输入简短的信息看看【智文】会给你带来什么灵感。 退出“智文”再重新进入，输入同样的标题，“智文”还可以给你不同的答案，你可以多次输入同样的标题获得尽可能多的信息来帮助你找到灵感。下图就是“气候与明朝的灭亡”这个标题的另一篇摘要。 strtoupper("⚠️ Caution") strtoupper("结果仅供大家拓展思路使用，内容还需自己进行核实。") strtoupper("04") strtoupper("如何写新文章及查看历史？") 点击左上角的“写新文章”，即可回到初始页面重新选择相应的功能。点击左下角对应的历史文章，可以快速看到先前生成的内容，而不必等待加载。 strtoupper("05") strtoupper("如何复制论文信息？") 您可以鼠标选中部分字段使用快捷键复制，也可以点击右下角的“复制”一键复制所有信息。 strtoupper("06") strtoupper("如何切换英文样例") 网页默认显示中文样例，可通过点击“英文样例”进行切换。使用英文输入生成的前言、小论文和摘要默认也是英文的。 strtoupper("【用户评价】") strtoupper("崔旭博士") strtoupper("斯坦福大学") “现在我写论文的时候离不开【智文】了。我总是让它帮我写初版的前言，然后根据我的建议，再让它写第二版第三版等。在这个过程中，它总能给我一些意外的惊喜:找到我过去不知道的文献和提供新的角度。” strtoupper("戴薇") strtoupper("首都医科大学") “【智文】是论文写作的好助手，可以帮助我在开始动笔前快速整理文章思路和大纲，提供多角度的引导，协助我快速理清文章的思路和结构，帮助我更全面地思考论文的内容。” strtoupper("纪健主治医师") strtoupper("北京儿童医院") “我觉得这个程序特别实用，尤其是参考文献的检索。” strtoupper("许传强博士") strtoupper("沈阳农业大学") “输入了我们科研小组正在撰写的文章英文关键词进行测试，结果让我眼前一亮!结果列出的内容非常具有参考价值!且与研究内容的匹配准确度非常高!” strtoupper("黄耿博士") strtoupper("衡阳师范学院") “作为
