emails.subject: PDF Conversion is now supported in the Snipping Tool!
emails.body:
You can now convert PDFs to LaTeX, DOCX, and other formats right from your desktop. Plus, other exciting Snipping Tool updates!

You can watch a demo of the new features on YouTube (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WId6S1rrhZ8) or Vimeo (https://vimeo.com/1017202706) .


** PDF Conversion in Snipping Tool Desktop Apps (MacOS, Windows, and Linux)
------------------------------------------------------------
PDF conversion is now available in all Snip desktop apps! Just like in Snip Web (https://snip.mathpix.com) , it’s possible to upload multiple files and choose from a variety of formats to convert them into (DOCX, LaTeX, HTML, Markdown, and Mathpix Markdown).

How to use:
1. Open the desktop app and navigate to the new Convert PDF tab.
2. Upload your PDFs by dragging and dropping them or using the upload button.
3. Select the format you wish to convert your PDFs to.
4. Click Convert & Download to export your converted files as a .zip file directly to your device.

Click the Open in Snip Web icon to the right of each PDF name to open it directly in our web app (https://snip.mathpix.com) , where you can view, read, edit, and search through your documents.

Haven’t installed our desktop apps yet? Download them now (https://mathpix.com/desktop-downloads) — available for macOS, Windows, and Linux.


** Improved App Navigation, New Upload Image(s) Option
------------------------------------------------------------
In addition to adding support for PDF processing, we have also improved our app navigation.

At the top left of the app window, you will now see (from left to right): create Snip from screenshot, create Snip from image, create Snip from drawing, create Snip from text, Snip Gallery view, and the new Convert PDF option. Note that the create Snip from image feature is a new option for MacOS users (already available on Windows/Linux) that allows you to upload one or multiple images from your file system instead of screenshotting them.

Another new navigational option you will find at the top right of your app–the ability to open anything in Snip Web (https://snip.mathpix.com) . Clicking this button while in Gallery view will open the Snip Web homepage, and clicking it while viewing a Snip will open the Snip viewer in the web app. This is useful for getting Snips quickly into your Notes or if you want to view or edit your Snips in a larger window.


** More Detailed Snips Gallery View
------------------------------------------------------------
We have also added more details and ways to view your Snips in Gallery view. You can now choose to view only original images, only rendered images, or both when scrolling your Snip Gallery. In addition, we have standardized the size of each Snip to make scrolling easier. You can also view your total Snip count at the top.

You can also now see the exact accuracy for each Snip, as well as an option to open any Snip in Snip Web (https://snip.mathpix.com) . The last new feature of Gallery view is the ability to delete Snips as you scroll, rather than having to open an individual Snip in order to delete it.


** Other updates and bug fixes
------------------------------------------------------------
* Fixed a bug where users were automatically logged out and received a "Missing access token" error.
* Added copy buttons to code blocks and enabled text selection to rendered images.
* Fixed a bug that prevented taking screenshots on macOS Sequoia.
* Fixed a bug where Snip editing mode displayed low image quality on external monitors.

As always, thank you for trusting Mathpix to be part of your workflow! Feel free to email us anytime with questions, feedback, or feature requests at support@mathpix.com (mailto:support@mathpix.com) .

Warm regards,
The Mathpix Team

###Get Ready: ScholarAI Copilot Is About To Get Even Better! 


The ScholarAI Copilot is about to launch some incredible new features and upgrades designed to make your research process smoother, faster, and smarter than ever. 

 

Here’s a sneak peek at what’s coming:


✨ **A Refined Experience**
--------------------------


We're elevating the ScholarAI Copilot experience with:

 


- **UI Refresh**: A sleeker, more intuitive interface to make your research journey even smoother. 
- **Conversational Search**: Ask questions naturally and get tailored responses. 
- **Improved Project Management**: Organize, save, and access your projects with ease. 
- **New Dashboard View**: Get a clearer overview of your projects and research progress. 
- **Account Self-Management**: Enhanced control over your data, including GDPR-compliant deletion options.


🔥 **Exciting New Features**
---------------------------


But we’re not just polishing up what’s already great – we’re bringing in **brand-new tools** to take your research to the next level:

 


- **Response Translation:** Set your preferred language in your profile settings and have ScholarAI respond with accurate translations.  
- **Live PDF Interaction**: Imagine asking questions directly to your PDFs and watching citations highlight in real-time. Even works with handwritten or messy PDFs! 
- **PDF Highlighting & Citation Tools**: Highlight, translate, paraphrase, and cite directly within PDFs. It’s like working with a live document. 
- **Experiments Tab**: Get early access to innovative features we’re concepting. Be the first to try new tools and give feedback!


🚀 **What’s Next?**
------------------


We’re already looking ahead with exciting updates that will further expand your research capabilities, including:

 


- **Batch PDF Uploads**: For those with a large collection of documents, we’re working on a feature to help you analyze multiple PDFs at once. 
- **Long-Form Writing & Drafting Tools**: ScholarAI will soon support in-depth writing, helping you create structured drafts and long-form content.


###**Be Among the First to Try It All! 👀**

Want early access? Join the waiting list today to be the first to experience ScholarAI’s enhanced capabilities and new features.

[ Join The Waitlist](https://forms.gle/SYs3WsyFJf3y6Vq57 "Waitlist Form")


Stay tuned for the full release next week, where we’ll dive into all the details. Until then, join the waitlist to secure your spot and get ready to see how ScholarAI Copilot is redefining research.

 

Happy researching,
The ScholarAI Team

emails.text: 黄煜 南京邮电大学/教职工/碳中和先进技术研究院       ------------------ Original ------------------ From:  "学报编辑部"<lwk_bhj@163.com>; Date:  Wed, Nov 20, 2024 07:45 PM To:  "huangyu"<huangyu@njupt.edu.cn>; Subject:  太阳能学报 待出版论文一校核改通知   您好，您的文章即将在我刊2024年第45卷发表，附件是您即将发表的文章，请根据以下各项要求认真校改，校对截止时间是11月23日，请务必不晚于23日按此邮件返回： 0、本次校对是出版之前作者的最后一次校对，也是作者最后一次勘误的机会，务请特别仔细！如出版后再发现有错误无法修改并责任自负。校对内容批注在PDF中，按此邮件返回校对稿（只返回PDF文档，Word文档的英文已请专家润色完善，请回复确认是否同意修改，如不同意请在PDF中批注如何修改），返回稿件请不要修改文件名。 1、请认真通读全文，对作者、单位、基金项目、文中所有字（错字、别字）、句（是否通顺、有歧义、标点符号使用正确与否）、数据（中英文摘要要与正文及结论的所有数据需一致）、公式、符号（大、小写、正斜体、上下标等格式需全文一致，一个符号只能表示一个物理量，对于重复使用的符号需替换修改）、图表以及图中的刻度或说明文字、全部英文等进行逐一勘误，如出版后再发现数据、作者信息等任何论文内容的错误，后果由作者自负。 2.核对所有参考文献，需按顺序在文中引用标注，列表中所有参考文献的格式（包括作者、文献名称、刊别、期刊名称、年份、期卷号、页码、专利、标准）等务必按本刊规范要求书写、补全年、卷期号、起止页码。 3、对于核对有问题的地方，在需要修改处加批注，标出修改后的正确内容。 4、英文摘要已终审，请全文核对，对于不认可或者表述与文中内容不符之处请批注修改。 5、无论是否有修改，请务必回复此邮件。 -- Best regards 学报编辑部

Finals season is **here**, and we know how much there is to tackle—research papers, exams, group projects, and everything in between. **ScholarAI is here to make studying smarter, faster, and stress-free**.

 

Whether you're diving into dense PDFs, drafting essays, or organizing your notes, our tools are designed to help you stay on top of your game. And we’ve got some **tips, tricks, and powerful features** to make sure you get the most out of ScholarAI this finals season.


[ View ScholarAI Study Guide 🤝](https://scholarai.notion.site/Studying-for-Finals-with-ScholarAI-15164448094080b3a016d9348af8ed9b?pvs=4 "ScholarAI Study Guide")


###**🧠****Smart Study Techniques**


**Chat With Your PDFs**: Upload your lecture notes, articles, or textbooks, and ask ScholarAI specific questions to get instant answers or summaries.

 


- ***Example***: “What are the main takeaways from this chapter on neural networks?” 
 

**Literature Mapping**: Connect the dots between research papers and explore how topics are related—all in one conversation.

 


- ***Example***: “What are the foundational papers on climate policy?” 
 

**Personalized Writing Assistant**: Draft essays, reports, or study guides with ease using ScholarAI’s tailored writing support.

 


- ***Example***: “Help me draft an essay introduction on the effects of social media on mental health.”


[ View More Best Practices ✍️](https://scholarai.notion.site/Studying-for-Finals-with-ScholarAI-15164448094080b3a016d9348af8ed9b?pvs=4 "ScholarAI Study Guide")


###**✨ Finals Tips & Tricks**


**Create Study Materials**: Generate flash cards, study guides, or practice tests based on your final exam material. 

 


- ***Example**:* "Can you generate a study guide over the French Revolution with flash cards for me to practice with?" 
 

**Simulated Q&A**: Generate potential exam questions and test yourself on key concepts.

 


- ***Example**:* "What are three possible exam questions on Aristotle’s views on virtue ethics?" 
 

**Exam Topic Predictions**: Use Literature Mapping to explore trends and anticipate likely exam topics.

 


- ***Example***: "What are the most frequently discussed issues in global governance based on this literature?"

Start using Copilot > ( http://github.com/copilot?utm_source=github&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2025q2-em-ww-Copilot-Free-GA-Transactional-Email ) *Copilot settings* GitHub Copilot will show code suggestions that match public code ( https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/using-github-copilot/finding-public-code-that-matches-github-copilot-suggestions?utm_source=github&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2025q2-em-ww-Copilot-Free-GA-Transactional-Email ) , including code references in the VS Code and github.com experience. GitHub and affiliates may use your data for product improvement. You can adjust both data use and public matching code suggestion settings in your Copilot Settings ( https://github.com/settings/copilot?utm_source=github&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2025q2-em-ww-Copilot-Free-GA-Transactional-Email ). emails.subject: Invited Speaker offer for your research related to "Photovoltaics"
emails.body:
Dear Colleague,

I am writing to you as organizing committee member of 7th International Conference on Photonics Research  (INTERPHOTONICS) which will be held on April 8-14, 2025 in Blue Lagoon, Fethiye / Mugla-TURKEY
I am writing to ask whether you would be willing to present a talk at the congress as an Invited speaker.  Invited talks will be 30 minutes long, including a 10-minute question-answer session. 

We have not yet established on which day your talk would be scheduled; should you accept this invitation, there is some flexibility that we can use to accommodate your own scheduling preferences. 

In appreciation of your agreement to provide an invited talk INTERPHOTONICS would waive 100% of the plain registration fee* of the congress (please see the legend below). 


I do very much hope that you will be able to accept this invitation. 

  

 Prof. Dr. Ersin Kayahan  



Linkedin: Ersin Kayahan | LinkedIn



Google Scholar: ‪Ersin Kayahan‬ - ‪Google Scholar‬

e-mail: ersin.kayahan@kocaeli.edu.tr 






Unsubscribe/Remove

Homepage: INTERPHOTONICS 2025




Congress Venue: INTERPHOTONICS 2025




To see the list of invited speakers: INTERPHOTONICS 2025








Legend: Plain registration fee* is fee without accommodation, airport transfers or social program extras.



If you have recently changed your research area, we have also openings in other topics

If you prefer to bring your graduate students with you forposter presentation, 100% registration fee waiver also applies to them.














THIS IS A FACE TO FACE EVENT. WE DO NOT HAVE ONLINE SESSIONS.

Dear Colleague,

I am writing to you as organizing committee member of 7th International Conference on Photonics Research  (INTERPHOTONICS) which will be held on April 8-14, 2025 in Blue Lagoon, Fethiye / Mugla-TURKEY
I am writing to ask whether you would be willing to present a talk at the congress as an Invited speaker.  Invited talks will be 30 minutes long, including a 10-minute question-answer session. 

We have not yet established on which day your talk would be scheduled; should you accept this invitation, there is some flexibility that we can use to accommodate your own scheduling preferences. 

In appreciation of your agreement to provide an invited talk INTERPHOTONICS would waive 100% of the plain registration fee* of the congress (please see the legend below). 


I do very much hope that you will be able to accept this invitation. 

  

 Prof. Dr. Ersin Kayahan  



Linkedin: Ersin Kayahan | LinkedIn



Google Scholar: ‪Ersin Kayahan‬ - ‪Google Scholar‬

e-mail: ersin.kayahan@kocaeli.edu.tr 






Unsubscribe/Remove

Homepage: INTERPHOTONICS 2025




Congress Venue: INTERPHOTONICS 2025




To see the list of invited speakers: INTERPHOTONICS 2025








Legend: Plain registration fee* is fee without accommodation, airport transfers or social program extras.



If you have recently changed your research area, we have also openings in other topics

If you prefer to bring your graduate students with you forposter presentation, 100% registration fee waiver also applies to them.














THIS IS A FACE TO FACE EVENT. WE DO NOT HAVE ONLINE SESSIONS.

emails.subject: 潇潇, 2024年文献鸟15次更新回顾
emails.body:
潇潇,

	2025年的到来，意味着文献鸟已经陪伴大家走过了又一个年头。这一年里，我们和无数科研人一起度过了忙碌的日子，也见证了大家的努力与成长。非常感谢大家的支持！

	作为科研人的贴心助手，我们没有停下脚步，而是不断倾听用户的声音，优化已有功能，推出新的工具，只为让科研路上多一些便利，少一些烦恼。

	接下来，让我们一起回顾一下，2024年文献鸟为您带来了哪些亮眼更新吧！✨

	strtoupper("智文")

	在2024年，文献鸟推出了智文高级功能，它可以根据用户给出的信息进行科学论文的写作，为你的论文提供诸多借鉴，还附带真实存在的参考文献。如果以前写论文像在黑暗中摸索，有了智文，你就像打开了一盏明灯，写作效率自然飞速提升。

	我想了解原文
→$this->_build_link_list("https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/e4ekG1wM8rrlusFIl6cM8g",
"【智文】5分钟帮您写出高质量论文")

	strtoupper("写作助手")

	过去的一年里，文献鸟的写作助手（包括网页版和
Word
插件）进行了三次更新，分别增加了自定义指令功能、句海探珍功能以及中文润色功能。

	1

	strtoupper("自定义指定功能")

	
自定义指令功能是写作助手的一次飞跃性升级，它能够根据我们的需求提供个性化的帮助。无论是扩写或缩写段落，撰写回复邮件，还是根据文本创作诗歌，只要脑洞够大，写作助手都可以帮助你对文字随意操控。

	我想了解原文 →
$this->_build_link_list("https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/LT4jpHoKahqtwKN2jn4YHQ",
"【写作助手重大更新】自定义指令，创意无限")

	2

	strtoupper("句海探珍功能")

	句海探珍功能如同一个宝库，蕴藏着无数精彩的文献原句，等待着您去发掘运用。无论是为写作找到支撑论据，还是为文章增色添彩，这一功能都能为您提供丰富的素材支持。

	我想了解原文 →
$this->_build_link_list("https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/oh2gHdc3H1_Xt_u1FmEhlg",
"【写作助手升级：句海探珍功能上线】——精准引用，助力论文熠熠生辉")

	3

	strtoupper("中文润色功能")

	中文润色功能如同一位细致入微的编辑，帮您纠正语法错误、优化词汇表达。无论是撰写文章还是日常通过电子邮件进行沟通，这一功能都能适应您的需求。

	我想了解原文 →

emails.subject: ISAFE 2025 conference - 23-25 June 2025 -Beijing- China
emails.body:
<<ISAFE2025>> [https://isafe2025.sciencesconf.org/?lang=en]



CALL FOR PAPERS

THE THIRD ANNUAL MEETING OF

THE INTERNATIONAL SOCIETY FOR THE ADVANCEMENT OF FINANCIAL ECONOMICS ISAFE 2025

23 - 25 JUNE 2025 ǀ BEIJING - CHINA

Hosting Institution

Beijing International Studies University
Conference dates

23 June -25 June 2025

Location

Gubei Water Town Resort, Miyun District, Beijing, China

Conference website

https://isafe2025.sciencesconf.org/ [https://isafe2025.sciencesconf.org/]

 

TOPICS:

We welcome papers that delve into several pertinent topics, aiming to foster comprehensive discussions and shed light on the multifaceted nature of the banking and finance domain. These topics include, but are not limited to:

 * AI and finance
 * Asset allocation and valuation
 * Central banking and monetary policy
 * Corporate finance and governance
 * Country funds and hedge funds
 * Emerging markets finance
 * Empirical assets pricing
 * Financial accounting, law, and regulation
 * Financial crises and contagion
 * Financial econometrics
 * Financial engineering and derivatives
 * Financial intermediation, institutions & services
 * Financial markets and market microstructure
 * FinTech: Revealing Potential and Challenges
 * Foreign currency issues
 * International finance and capital markets
 * IPOs, SEOs, M&As & Divestitures
 * Market behavior efficiency
 * Multinational financial management
 * Personal finance and household finance
 * Portfolio management and optimization;
 * Quantitative finance and financial econometrics
 * Real estate finance
 * Risk management
 * Small business and entrepreneurial finance
 * Sustainable finance, ethics, and CSR

 

KEYNOTE SPEAKER: Prof. Peter Gabor Szilagyi, EDHEC Business School, France & Prof. Arman Eshraghi, Cardiff University, United Kingdom.

 

CO-CHAIRS:

 * Sabri Boubaker, EM Normandie Business School, France & Swansea University, UK & ISAFE
 * Zhenya Liu, School of Finance, Renmin University of China, China
 * Wei Li, Business School at Business School, Beijing International Studies University, China

PUBLICATION OPPORTUNITIES: 

 * The International Journal of Finance & Economics 
 * Journal of Economics and Business
 * International Review of Economics & Finance
 * Journal of Forecasting
 * Journal of International Financial Management & Accounting
 * Journal of International Financial Markets, Institutions and Money



TIMELINE AND SUBMISSION PROCESS: 

Papers and extended abstracts (in PDF version) should be submitted by April 30, 2025 (Early submissions are highly encouraged). Decisions will be made each Monday until 05 May 2025

 

IMPORTANT DATES:

 * Submission deadline: 30 April 2025
 * Notification of review results: Each Monday until 05 May 2025
 * Registration deadline: 31 May 2025
 * Conference event: 23-25 June 2025

 

PARTNERS & ORGANIZERS

 * International Society for the Advancement of Financial Economics (ISAFE)
 * Beijing International Studies University
 * EM Normandie Business School
 * Association of Vietnamese Scientists and Experts (AVSE Global)
 * China CYTS Tours Holding Co., LTD

emails.subject: Invited Speaker offer for your research related to "Photovoltaics"
emails.body:
Dear Colleague,

I am writing to you as organizing committee member of 7th International Conference on Photonics Research  (INTERPHOTONICS) which will be held on April 8-14, 2025 in Blue Lagoon, Fethiye / Mugla-TURKEY
I am writing to ask whether you would be willing to present a talk at the congress as an Invited speaker.  Invited talks will be 30 minutes long, including a 10-minute question-answer session. 

We have not yet established on which day your talk would be scheduled; should you accept this invitation, there is some flexibility that we can use to accommodate your own scheduling preferences. 

In appreciation of your agreement to provide an invited talk INTERPHOTONICS would waive 100% of the plain registration fee* of the congress (please see the legend below). 


I do very much hope that you will be able to accept this invitation. 

  

 Prof. Dr. Ersin Kayahan  



Linkedin: Ersin Kayahan | LinkedIn



Google Scholar: ‪Ersin Kayahan‬ - ‪Google Scholar‬

e-mail: ersin.kayahan@kocaeli.edu.tr 






Unsubscribe/Remove

Homepage: INTERPHOTONICS 2025




Congress Venue: INTERPHOTONICS 2025




To see the list of invited speakers: INTERPHOTONICS 2025








Legend: Plain registration fee* is fee without accommodation, airport transfers or social program extras.



If you have recently changed your research area, we have also openings in other topics

If you prefer to bring your graduate students with you forposter presentation, 100% registration fee waiver also applies to them.














THIS IS A FACE TO FACE EVENT. WE DO NOT HAVE ONLINE SESSIONS.

emails.subject: Final Opportunity to Be an Invited Speaker at INTERPHOTONICS2025
emails.body:
Dear Colleague,

I am writing to you as organizing committee member of 7th International Conference on Photonics Research  (INTERPHOTONICS) which will be held on April 8-14, 2025 in Blue Lagoon, Fethiye / Mugla-TURKEY
I am writing to ask whether you would be willing to present a talk at the congress as an Invited speaker.  Invited talks will be 30 minutes long, including a 10-minute question-answer session. 

We have not yet established on which day your talk would be scheduled; should you accept this invitation, there is some flexibility that we can use to accommodate your own scheduling preferences. 

In appreciation of your agreement to provide an invited talk INTERPHOTONICS would waive 100% of the plain registration fee* of the congress (please see the legend below). 


I do very much hope that you will be able to accept this invitation. 

Please choose the topic of your talk from this list: INTERPHOTONICS 2025  (Please submit your abstract by 28 February,2025)

  

 Prof. Dr. Ersin Kayahan  



Linkedin: Ersin Kayahan | LinkedIn



Google Scholar: ‪Ersin Kayahan‬ - ‪Google Scholar‬

e-mail: ersin.kayahan@kocaeli.edu.tr 






Unsubscribe/Remove

Homepage: INTERPHOTONICS 2025




Congress Venue: INTERPHOTONICS 2025




To see the list of invited speakers: INTERPHOTONICS 2025








Legend: Plain registration fee* is fee without accommodation, airport transfers or social program extras.




If you prefer to bring your graduate students with you forposter presentation, 100% registration fee waiver also applies to them.













THIS IS A FACE TO FACE EVENT. WE DO NOT HAVE ONLINE SESSIONS.

Welcome to our “Alpha Ideas Series” where we share basic techniques or methodologies for you to try on the BRAIN platform.

*Idea*
In financial analysis, a company's leverage, represented by its liability-to-asset ratio, is a key indicator of its financial risk. Higher leverage, while often seen as a risk, indicates that the company has borrowed money to finance its operations and growth. However debt or liabilities is also considered a cheaper form of capital compared to equity financing, thus higher liabilities may potentially boost future profitability.

*Hypothesis*
Comparatively higher liabilities may indicate that the company has higher leverage and may have higher returns in the future.

*Implementation*
Compare liabilities among companies.

liabilities

"Read now" | | | | | | Unified Wi-Fi Driver › Boosting In-Vehicle Connectivity ... › FRDM-IMX93 Development Board ... › Smart Home › Matter › Wireless Wednesday › NXP Smarter World Blog › FRDM Development Board for MCX N94/N54 FRDM-MCXN947 are compact and scalable development boards for rapid prototyping of MCX N94 and N54 MCUs. They offer industry standard headers for easy access to the MCU’s I/Os, integrated open-standard serial interfaces, external flash memory and an on-board MCU-Link debugger. New Products TJA1445 The TJA1445 CAN FD transceiver with partial networking sleep mode, is part of the TJA144x transceiver family that implements CAN FD as defined in ISO11898-2:2024 parameter sets A-B. TJA1446 The TJA1446 CAN FD transceiver with partial networking sleep mode, is part of the TJA144x transceiver family that implements CAN FD as defined in ISO11898-2:2024 parameter sets A-B. TJA1121 TJA1121 adds MACsec to NXP’s 1000BASE-T1 Automotive Ethernet PHY portfolio. It addresses the security concerns for future networks and provides an efficient HW based solution for MACsec at 1 Gbps line rate. TJA1120 TJA1120, NXP’s 1000BASE-T1 PHY, scales automotive ethernet speed grade up to the 1 Gbps. The device comes in compact package HVQFN36 (6 x 6 mm) for space constraint use cases. ** Meet Cinder, new flamethrowing character. You can get it for free
------------------------------------------------------------
We introduce new Bastion character and a community challenge. If you successfully complete it together with other players, every player will get Cinder for free. It means no silver, no gold, no real money. Forever. Completely free.



** What is the challenge?
------------------------------------------------------------

Everything in your hands. You have 11 days to make it happen. What should be done:

emails.subject: 速递！最新SCI期刊、出版社动态！
emails.text: @media only screen and (max-width: 600px) { .inner-body { width: 100% !important; } .footer { width: 100% !important; } } @media only screen and (max-width: 500px) { .button { width: 100% !important; } } LetPub专业SCI论文编辑 速递！最新SCI期刊、出版社动态（投稿必看） 本期我们为您带来最新的期刊和出版社动态，帮助您及时了解可能影响投稿和出版的重大变动！从编辑辞职到期刊撤回、开放获取改革等，本文汇总了以下几条重要资讯，确保您在投稿前充分了解最新动向。 一、哪些期刊被剔除、哪些仍在“on hold”？ WoS（Web of Science）每月都会更新核心数据库（SCIE、SSCI、AHCI、ESCI）收录的期刊变动情况。 根据WoS最新更新，多个期刊出现了变动，包括被撤除和“on hold”状态期刊。以下是近期的具体情况： 注释： Editorial 除名：该期刊已被重新评估，但不符合一项或多项质量标准，因此从WoS核心数据库中删除。 Production 除名：由于未收到出版商的内容，期刊已从WoS核心数据库中删除。 Cease：该期刊已停止出版，因此不再包含在WoS核心数据库中。 二、这些期刊编辑集体辞职，或将影响审稿速度！ 最近，多个知名SCI期刊编辑委员会因对出版社管理改革的强烈不满而集体辞职，可能会影响期刊的审稿速度和稿件质量。具体事件如下： 医学2区SCI期刊主编辞职，新创非营利性期刊 2024年底，医学2区SCI期刊《Journal of Clinical Immunology》的多位（副）主编因Springer出版社要求将期刊转为完全开放获取（OA）并增加稿件数量而辞职。今年1月起，该期刊已成为完全OA期刊。 离职的编辑们创办了一个新的非营利期刊《Journal of Human Immunity》，新期刊的文章处理费（APC）将约为3500美元（约2.5万元），比《Journal of Clinical Immunology》的$4990（约3.6万元） 出版费用要便宜。（详情见此文） 地球科学2区SCI期刊编辑集体辞职，因不满期刊管理改革 本月，比利时国际沉积学会（IAS）拥有，并与Wiley公司签订合同出版的SCI期刊《Sedimentology》（地球科学-2区），其主编和多位副主编因反对IAS学会对期刊管理的改革而集体辞职。离职编辑认为，改革将转向由Wiley主导、失去内部编辑支持，这将极大地损害期刊的未来。 学会方则表示，IAS拥有该期刊并任命所有编辑，编辑均为无偿工作，且没有受到出版社的干预。（详情见此文） Elsevier改革引发地球科学1区SCI期刊编辑辞职潮 2024年底，爱思唯尔对地球科学1区SCI期刊《Journal of Human Evolution》的编辑团队做出一系列改革，包括取消对编辑工作的支持，并在未与编辑沟通的情况下引入AI工具进行稿件修改。这一系列改革引发了大规模辞职，可能会影响期刊审稿效率。（详情见此文） Elsevier改革引发医学1区期刊编辑集体辞职，因出版商单方面决定更换编辑 去年底，出版商Karger单方面决定更换《Psychotherapy and Psychosomatics》（IF16.3、医学1区）期刊的编辑委员会，未提前与编辑团队协商，导致大部分编辑集体辞职。 离职编辑批评出版社的出版问题导致文章延迟发布，以及出版社提议采用不符合期刊定位的策略，例如特别专题号和自动化工具选择审稿人。更有编辑指出“底线不是期刊的优秀质量，而是金钱。” 对此，出版社则表示正常的编辑过渡可能被部分社区成员误解，正计划任命新的编辑委员会领导，共同为期刊制定新的发展方向。（详情见此文） 三、Springer Nature去年撤回了2923篇论文，这三本期刊占榜首！ Springer Nature旗下的3000多本期刊在2024年共撤回了2923篇论文，其中41%的撤回论文是OA文章。撤稿较多的期刊如下： 《Environmental Science and Pollution Research》 撤回大量论文，因存在“可疑引用、拗口短语和未披露的AI使用”等问题。该期刊在2024年02月发布的预警名单中因“引用操纵、论文工厂”被中国科学院预警，在2024年6月失去了影响因子，2024年10月22日正式被SCIE期刊列表Editorial除名。 《Scientific Reports》（综合性期刊-2区） 因涉及“拗口文章”和“有偿作者身份”的问题而撤回大量文章。 《Applied Nanoscience》 撤回了34篇问题丛生的特刊论文，该期刊已在2023年3月20日被剔除出SCIE目录。 （详情见此文） 四、已发Nature！中国深圳这所高校发现新的超导体？ 2月17日发表在影响因子50.5 、中国科学院分区综合性期刊1区Top期刊《Nature》的一篇论文《Ambient-pressure superconductivity onset above 40 K in (La,Pr)3Ni2O7 films》发现：镍酸盐能够在45K（-228°C）的较高温度下无阻力导电，并且不需要高压条件，这一“非常规超导体”的发现已经引起了物理学家的高度关注。 该研究由中国深圳的南方科技大学物理学家完成，他们通过实验观察到镍酸盐在常压下展现超导性，并排斥磁场。镍酸盐的发现有望帮助物理学家进一步理解高温超导体的工作原理，并最终设计出在常规条件下能正常工作的超导材料，这将推动例如核磁共振成像等技术的广泛应用和成本降低。研究人员希望未来能进一步提高镍酸盐的临界温度，使其在更高温度下实现超导性。（详情见此文） 五、柳叶刀旗下SCI：我们的寿命不再更长 2月18日发表在25.4分、中国科学院医学1区Top期刊《The Lancet Public Health》的论文《Changing life expectancy in European countries 1990–2021: a subanalysis of causes and risk factors from the Global Burden of Disease Study 2021》发现：许多国家老年人的预期寿命仍在提高，这表明我们尚未达到自然寿命的上限。但2011年以来，欧洲各国预期寿命增长放缓，英国情况尤为严重。 这意味着，我们可能无法再像父母或祖父母那样享受更长寿的生活，甚至可能面临寿命缩短的风险。至于原因，2011-2019年，心血管疾病导致的死亡率成为预期寿命增长放缓的主要原因；2019-2021年，新冠疫情则是预期寿命下降的直接推手。（详情见此文） emails.subject:
Kiln AI Update v0.12.1: Powerful Evaluation Toolkit & Distill Sonnet 3.7
 Thinking
emails.body:
Hi Kiln Early Adopters 👋,
You are getting this email because you subscribed to updates about the Kiln AI Github project.
New App Update: Kiln v0.12.1 with Evaluations
Our new update includes our biggest feature to date: Evals.
Kiln now includes a comprehensive evaluation toolkit. With it you can build powerful SOTA evals, check eval correlation to human preferences, synthetically generate an eval dataset, and use analysis tools to find the optimal way to run your task. It will automatically build an eval for any Kiln task, and includes templates for common eval use cases (bias, toxicity, jailbreaking, etc). 
Check out the Evals Docs + Walkthrough Video [ https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/15d5a516-1b5f-4614-8b49-09b85b17ed43?j=eyJ1IjoiNWNvMXE1In0.U5GlQwxzrLb2-3yE3jvR06Bd-rYcHY2DfUMdE7HS86A ]
Other new features in V0.12.1:
Support for distilling (fine-tuning) an open model from Sonnet 3.7 Thinking
New Built-In Models: Sonnet 3.7, Dolphin 2.9 8x22B, and Grok
New ARM builds for Linux
Improved logging (thanks to @leonardmq)
Download v0.12.1 Now [ https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/a4cf7d8f-c70d-4c74-aa1c-92ef8954fb70?j=eyJ1IjoiNWNvMXE1In0.U5GlQwxzrLb2-3yE3jvR06Bd-rYcHY2DfUMdE7HS86A ] 
Kiln News & Community:
Kiln Reaches 3K GitHub Stars and 10K Downloads: Thanks for the incredible support (we’re not even at V1 yet)! Please continue to share the project with people who might enjoy it, and add a star on Github if you haven’t already.
Join Our Discord Community [ https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/6ec151dd-5952-4255-b6da-d3dac85f2e5b?j=eyJ1IjoiNWNvMXE1In0.U5GlQwxzrLb2-3yE3jvR06Bd-rYcHY2DfUMdE7HS86A ]: Please join to ask questions about Kiln. Feedback on evals and ideas on what we should add next are greatly encouraged!
Thanks for all your support!
Steve - Kiln Maintainer - steve@getkiln.ai [ mailto:steve@getkiln.ai ]

emails.body:
Hello Quant!

您已收到成为BRAIN顾问的邀请, 但我们尚未收到您的申请表。再次向您发出邀请，请您完成申请表的填写，正式启动这段精彩的旅程！

注意：如您已填写并且确认workday上无剩余task，请截图并回复此邮件。
WHY BRAIN CONSULTANT?

1.解锁BRAIN完全版本的功能：进入真正的量化研究世界，享受近14万数据集、10个国家和地区的数据源，可视化Alpha表现分析，多Alpha组合，并获取BRAIN API，利用Python构建自己的高效回测框架。

2. 获得免费专属学习资源：成为顾问后，您将有机会参加我们专属的英才候选人计划和研究小组当中，解锁顾问论坛的权限。更有机会参加我们在各地举办的专属线下workshop，参与顾问专属的全球性竞赛，赢取丰厚奖金。您还会分配到一个专属的导师，解答您在量化研究中的问题。

3. 赚取报酬、构建个人P&L，获得经历证明于潜在职业机会：成为顾问后，提交Alpha可以获得基础津贴、季度津贴、推荐奖励、比赛奖金等报酬，满足一定条件后还可以获得BRAIN的经历证明，为求职和出国加分。

只需5-10分钟，您即可完成申请，请务必仔细阅读附件申请注意事项，以免返工影响申请进度。
我们期待您的加入，一起在量化金融的世界中大放异彩。

祝好

WQ BRAIN CHINA

emails.subject:
Kiln v0.13.1 Release: Vertex, Azure, QwQ, Gemma, Hugging Face, Anthropic,
 LiteLLM, Import CSV, and More!
emails.body:
View this post on the web at https://kilnai.substack.com/p/kiln-v0131-release-vertex-azure-qwq

Hi Kiln Early Adopters 👋,
You are getting this email because you subscribed to updates about the Kiln AI Github project.
I didn't expect this release to be so feature packed when we started, but things kept piling up in a good way. Lots of goodies here to explore:
New AI Providers
You can now connect and use the following providers in Kiln:
Gemini API
Vertex AI
Hugging Face
Anthropic
Azure OpenAI
Together.ai
This is on top of our existing providers: Ollama, OpenAI, Groq, Fireworks, OpenRouter, AWS Bedrock, and any OpenAI compatible endpoint.
New Built-in Models
We have all the hip new models, each one tested to work with Kiln features like structured output and synthetic data generation:
Gemma 3 (27B, 12B, 4B, 1B): Impressive new weight-available models from Google
QwQ 32B: Reasoning you can run locally, from Qwen
o1 & o3-mini: Not new, but now generally available without an invite
Phi 4 (Mini + 5.6B): New Phi models from Microsoft
New Serverless Fine Tuning: Together.ai
We added support for fine-tuning models on Together.ai [ https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/9c39cfd2-05f6-4359-a7f5-a65afcda3238?j=eyJ1IjoiNWNvMXE1In0.U5GlQwxzrLb2-3yE3jvR06Bd-rYcHY2DfUMdE7HS86A ]. Like Fireworks and OpenAI, they support "serverless" fine-tuning: no managing tuning GPUs or long-running inference servers. Hit "tune", then pay by token when it's inference time. It all scales to zero cost when you aren't using it which makes it great for rapid experimentation.
With Together you can easily fine-tune six models: Llama 3.2 1B/3B, Llama 3.1 8B/70B, Qwen 2.5 14B/72B.
Import CSV Files into your Kiln Dataset
Already have a dataset? The new CSV import feature makes it easy to load it into Kiln for fine-tuning and evals. Check out the docs [ https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/869e5cf7-642e-468b-a404-22fb88d99613?j=eyJ1IjoiNWNvMXE1In0.U5GlQwxzrLb2-3yE3jvR06Bd-rYcHY2DfUMdE7HS86A ].
Thanks to @leonardmq [ https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/d0fc6f67-3583-48df-9d85-1a8a775b2d4e?j=eyJ1IjoiNWNvMXE1In0.U5GlQwxzrLb2-3yE3jvR06Bd-rYcHY2DfUMdE7HS86A ] for contributing this!
Weights & Biases Integration
We now support Weights & Biases [ https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/8e6c58e6-b111-4dc9-84a7-f6b91306c53e?j=eyJ1IjoiNWNvMXE1In0.U5GlQwxzrLb2-3yE3jvR06Bd-rYcHY2DfUMdE7HS86A ], an open tool for tracking AI experiments metrics like training-loss and val-loss, etc. Bring your own API key, or host your own instance.
Migration to LiteLLM for Inference
We moved to LiteLLM [ https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/c4c1a830-7b87-4fc5-b101-32fef33b7030?j=eyJ1IjoiNWNvMXE1In0.U5GlQwxzrLb2-3yE3jvR06Bd-rYcHY2DfUMdE7HS86A ] for inference, from a mix of OpenAI+Langchain. LiteLLM has been great, allowing us to quickly add new providers, and create reusable tests across all models. I'm very happy to be done with Langchain 😂.
Fun fact: Kiln has 2,557 test cases and 92% test coverage.
On top of unit tests, we have online tests which test every built-in model against every feature to ensure things work smoothly.
Even with tests, swapping out the core inference engine in a project this size can cause bugs. Please report any issues you see in Github issues.
Python Libraries
Kiln isn't just an app. Our open source python library, kiln_ai [ https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/3412d4cd-bb03-4a39-84ce-ca73bd2faa32?j=eyJ1IjoiNWNvMXE1In0.U5GlQwxzrLb2-3yE3jvR06Bd-rYcHY2DfUMdE7HS86A ], supports essentially all the features you can see in the UI. For this update, library updates include:
All features above are available in the python library
New docs for connecting AI providers + custom models from code
Python 3.13 support, and ready for 3.14
See the library docs [ https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/45080ca3-cfd1-4e28-9f48-e036110f51d5?j=eyJ1IjoiNWNvMXE1In0.U5GlQwxzrLb2-3yE3jvR06Bd-rYcHY2DfUMdE7HS86A ] for details.
And More
There are lots of small quality-of-life improvements that make Kiln easier to use:
Allow editing titles/descriptions throughout the UI
Add UI for deleting items, including: evals, tasks, runs, custom prompts, projects
Bug fixes
Try it out, and as always, please give feedback on Discord [ https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/77616866-c8b1-494f-885b-36123ae4f10d?j=eyJ1IjoiNWNvMXE1In0.U5GlQwxzrLb2-3yE3jvR06Bd-rYcHY2DfUMdE7HS86A ].
Thanks for all your support! 
Steve - The Kiln Maintainer

Unsubscribe https://substack..tvnoE0ntSxkuj

Dear Dr. Zhao,

The open access journal Energies (ISSN 1996-1073, IF 3.0) is pleased to announce a new Special Issue entitled "Advances in Artificial Intelligence for Photovoltaic Research and Applications". Dr. Hubert Seigneur and Dr. Kristopher Davis are serving as Guest Editors for this issue. The submission deadline is 30 September 2025 and papers may be submitted immediately or at any point until 30 September 2025, as papers will be published on an ongoing basis. For more information on this Special Issue and submission guidelines, please visit the following page: https://www.mdpi.com/si/energies/8E91429348.

MDPI offers professional article preparation services (language and figure editing) completed in just 1 day: https://www.mdpi.com/authors/english.

Kind regards,

Fiona Liu

https://isafe2025.sciencesconf.org/ [https://isafe2025.sciencesconf.org/]

 

TIMELINE AND SUBMISSION PROCESS: 

Papers and extended abstracts (in PDF version) should be submitted by April 30, 2025 (Early submissions are highly encouraged). Decisions will be made each Monday until 05 May 2025

IMPORTANT DATES:

Submission deadline: 30 April 2025 (Early submissions are highly encouraged)

Notification of review results: Each Monday until 05 May 2025

Registration deadline: 31 May 2025

Conference event: 23-25 June 2025

 

TOPICS:

We welcome papers that delve into several pertinent topics, aiming to foster comprehensive discussions and shed light on the multifaceted nature of the banking and finance domain. These topics include, but are not limited to:

 * AI and finance
 * Asset allocation and valuation
 * Central banking and monetary policy
 * Corporate finance and governance
 * Country funds and hedge funds
 * Emerging markets finance
 * Empirical assets pricing
 * Financial accounting, law, and regulation
 * Financial crises and contagion
 * Financial econometrics
 * Financial engineering and derivatives
 * Financial intermediation, institutions & services
 * Financial markets and market microstructure
 * FinTech: Revealing Potential and Challenges
 * Foreign currency issues
 * International finance and capital markets
 * IPOs, SEOs, M&As & Divestitures
 * Market behavior efficiency
 * Multinational financial management
 * Personal finance and household finance
 * Portfolio management and optimization;
 * Quantitative finance and financial econometrics
 * Real estate finance
 * Risk management
 * Small business and entrepreneurial finance
 * Sustainable finance, ethics, and CSR

 

KEYNOTE SPEAKER: Prof. Peter Gabor Szilagyi, EDHEC Business School, France & Prof. Arman Eshraghi, Cardiff University, United Kingdom.

 

MEET THE EDITORS SESSION:

 * Jonathan Batten: Professor of Finance, RMIT University, Melbourne, Australia & Editor-in-chief of Finance Research Letters.
 * Sabri Boubaker: Professor of Finance, EM Normandie Business School, France & Editor-in-chief of the Journal of International Financial Management & Accounting.
 * Arman Eshraghi: Professor of Finance and Investment, Deputy Head of Section for Research, Impact and Innovation, Cardiff Business School, United Kingdom & Editor of the International Review of Economic and Finance.
 * Peter Gabor Szilagyi: Professor of Finance at EDHEC Business School, Paris & Editor-in-Chief-in-chief of the Journal of International Financial Markets, Institutions and Money.

 

 CO-CHAIRS:

 * Sabri Boubaker, EM Normandie Business School, France & ISAFE
 * Zhenya Liu, School of Finance, Renmin University of China, China
 * Wei Li, Business School at Business School, Beijing International Studies University, China

 * The International Journal of Finance & Economics 
 * Journal of Economics and Business

 * Journal of Forecasting
 * Journal of International Financial Management & Accounting
 * Journal of International Financial Markets, Institutions and Money

Kiln v0.14: Over 60 new fine-tuneable models - Qwen, Llama, Deepseek, QwQ &
 more
emails.body:
View this post on the web at https://kilnai.substack.com/p/kiln-v014-over-60-new-fine-tuneable

Hi Kiln Early Adopters 👋,
You are getting this email because you subscribed to updates about the Kiln AI Github project.
Over 60 new fine-tuneable models
Kiln v0.14.0 added over 60 new models which you can easily fine-tune in Kiln. These include:
Qwen 2.5: sizes from 0.5B to 72B
Llama 2, 3.1, 3.2, 3.3: sizes from 1B to 405B
Deepseek V3 and R1 models
And more: QwQ, Qwen Coder, Dolphin, DS Coder, and more. See the full list here [ https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/1245687b-3ba3-46bc-9e2d-4b351c8028cc?j=eyJ1IjoiNWNvMXE1In0.U5GlQwxzrLb2-3yE3jvR06Bd-rYcHY2DfUMdE7HS86A ].
To use the new models, update Kiln to v0.14.0 and add a Fireworks API key. You’ll then see the new models in the fine-tune UI.
Auto-scaling On-demand Inference Servers
Kiln now supports on-demand server deployments for custom fine-tuned models. We've aimed to keep the developer experience as simple as possible while also keeping costs low. 
Idle servers automatically turn off after 5 minutes of inactivity to save costs. Idle deployments will automatically start up a new server when you call them. There's no manual server management needed.
On-demand auto-scaling is currently supported for Fireworks, and we'll look at adding more providers soon.
Kiln News & Updates
Kiln now has over 3,000 stars on Github!
New Kiln demo video [ https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/cd068dd1-be6b-4052-9c6f-932dc7ba64f6?j=eyJ1IjoiNWNvMXE1In0.U5GlQwxzrLb2-3yE3jvR06Bd-rYcHY2DfUMdE7HS86A ]
New Kiln homepage [ https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/22e72eaa-beaa-4fcc-910c-267d4f6fb2a3?j=eyJ1IjoiNWNvMXE1In0.U5GlQwxzrLb2-3yE3jvR06Bd-rYcHY2DfUMdE7HS86A ]
New article/guide: Fine-tuning for prompt engineers [ https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/f8bea703-0e6e-47f3-af9d-3f9cc1db05a9?j=eyJ1IjoiNWNvMXE1In0.U5GlQwxzrLb2-3yE3jvR06Bd-rYcHY2DfUMdE7HS86A ]
Try it out! Please give any feedback on Discord [ https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/caa72241-2907-42cd-af42-3e64f292d34c?j=eyJ1IjoiNWNvMXE1In0.U5GlQwxzrLb2-3yE3jvR06Bd-rYcHY2DfUMdE7HS86A ].
Thanks for all your support,
Steve - The Kiln Maintainer

emails.subject:
ICBFS 2025 conference - 11-12 September 2025 - Milan-Piacenza,
 Italy
emails.body:
<<ISAFE2025>> [https://icbfs2025.sciencesconf.org/]



CALL FOR PAPERS

 

The 2025 International Conference in Banking and Financial Studies

 

11-12 September 2025

 

 Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore, Piacenza, Milan, Italy
Conference dates

11- 12 September 2025

Location

Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore (Piacenza), Italy

Conference website

https://icbfs2025.sciencesconf.org/ [https://icbfs2025.sciencesconf.org/]

 

TIMELINE AND SUBMISSION PROCESS

Papers and extended abstracts should be submitted by June 30, 2025 (Early submissions are highly encouraged) by attaching to the email both title page and full paper without authors’ details.  Decisions will be provided during the first week of July 2025.

 

IMPORTANT DATES

Submission deadline: 30 June 2025

Notification of review results: 05 July 2025

Registration deadline: 16 August 2025

Conference event: 11-12 September 2025

 

TOPICS

We welcome papers that delve into several pertinent topics, aiming to foster comprehensive discussions and shed light on the multifaceted nature of the banking and finance domain. These topics include, but are not limited to:

 * Accounting, auditing, and taxation
 * Asset allocation and valuation
 * Banking regulation and financial services
 * Behavioral and experimental finance/economics
 * Big data in finance, artificial intelligence, and cyber security
 * Climate finance and sustainability
 * Corporate finance, IPOs, SEOs, M&A, and crowdfunding
 * Corporate governance
 * Country funds, sovereign funds, and hedge funds
 * Debt issues
 * Digital finance, cryptocurrency finance, and blockchain
 * Emerging markets finance
 * Energy finance and environment Issues
 * Entrepreneurial finance, venture capital, and private equity
 * Ethical finance, green finance, ESG and CSR
 * Financial accounting and regulation
 * Financial crises, contagion, integration, and global risks interconnection
 * Financial engineering and derivatives
 * Foreign currency issue
 * Global imbalances & sustainability
 * Household finance, real estate finance, and microfinance
 * Market behavior efficiency
 * Multinational financial management
 * Portfolio management and optimization
 * Risk management and compliance
 * Small business finance

 

KEYNOTE SPEAKERS

 * Thorsten Beck, The European University Institute, Florence, Italy
 * Hans Degryse, KU Leuven’s Department of Accountancy, Finance, and Insurance, Belgium
 * Brian Lucey, Trinity Business School, Trinity College Dublin, Ireland

 

 CO-CHAIRS

 * Sabri Boubaker, EM Normandie Business School, France & Swansea University, UK
 * Matteo Cotugno, Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore, Italy
 * Stefano Monferrà, Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore, Italy
 * Vincenzo Verdoliva, University of Naples Parthenope, Italy

PUBLICATION OPPORTUNITIES

 * Journal of International Financial Management & Accounting
 * Journal of International Financial Markets, Institutions and Money
 * Journal of International Accounting, Auditing and Taxation
 * Financial Review



PARTNERS & ORGANIZERS

 * Universita Cattolica del Sacro Cuore
 * EM Normandie Business School
 * International Society for the Advancement of Financial Economics (ISAFE)
 * Italia Domani
 * MUR 
 * Finanziato dell'Unione Europea 
 * National Recovery and Resilience Plan, NRRP
 * Department of Economic and Social Sciences, DiSES



This e-mail has been sent to 2645471525@qq.com, click here to unsubscribe https://s449q.mjt.lu/unsub2?hl=en&m=AVMAAGoIQjIAAc3jqA4AAemNBjUAAYCtNCUAnp_HAClZhgBoB1JE2H-Sa3JIQ5yh7otNu0FsVAAmT7k&b=726afe42&e=979e4a32&x=F-E4nkp-xgOIpaXSSNCt8hnOfUeodsP9yFgLoyVa0h0.

emails.subject: Call for Paper Reminder: [Energies] (IF: 3.0, ISSN: 1996-1073)— Special Issue "Advances in Artificial Intelligence for Photovoltaic Research and Applications"
emails.body:
Dear Dr. Zhao,

We contacted you on DATE, regarding a Special Issue entitled "Advances in Artificial Intelligence for Photovoltaic Research and Applications", to be published in the journal Energies (ISSN 1996-1073, IF 3.0). Dr. Hubert Seigneur, Dr. Kristopher Davis are serving as Guest Editors for this issue. Based on your expertise in this field, we think you could make an excellent contribution.

INTRODUCTION[...]

For further reading, please follow the link to the Special Issue Website at: https://www.mdpi.com/si/energies/8E91429348

The submission deadline is 30 September 2025. You may send your manuscript now or up until the deadline. Submitted papers should not be under consideration for publication elsewhere. We also encourage authors to send a short abstract or tentative title to the Editorial Office in advance (energies@mdpi.com).

Please submit your decision on the invitation here http://susy.mdpi.com/special_issue/backend_cfp_decision/200625/MjY0NTQ3MTUyNUBxcS5jb20=/c687db9cacf754d5a8131743ef1d4ff16e249d5b1866423c255f73f948abfdcf.

Energies is fully open access. Open access (unlimited and free access by readers) increases publicity and promotes more frequent citations, as indicated by several studies. Open access is supported by the authors and their institutes. An Article Processing Charge (APC) of 2600 CHF currently applies to all papers accepted after peer review. You may be entitled to a discount if you have previously received a discount code from MDPI or if your institution is a participating member in MDPI’s Institutional Open Access Program (IOAP). For more information, please visit: http://www.mdpi.com/about/ioap.

For further details on the submission process, please see the instructions for authors at the journal website (http://www.mdpi.com/journal/energies/instructions).

MDPI offers professional article preparation services (language and figure editing) completed in just 1 day: https://www.mdpi.com/authors/english.

We also invite you to post an early version of your paper on our free preprint platform, Preprints, allowing you to receive feedback from your peers and make your early results citable. For more information or to submit your preprint, visit https://www.preprints.org/about#works.

We look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards,

Fiona Liu
Special Issue Editor

Energies (ISSN 1996-1073; http://www.mdpi.com/journal/energies) is a journal published by MDPI, Basel, Switzerland. Energies maintains rigorous peer-review and a rapid publication process. emails.subject: Your Grok account will be archived soon
emails.body:
Hi Xiaoxiao Zhang,

You haven't used Grok for a while and so your account will be archived soon.

Archiving destroys your personal information (to protect you!) but keeps your learning and institution data so you haven't lost everything if you come back.

👉 To avoid your account being archived, you can log back in and consent to the latest version of our privacy policy.

⚠️ You can delete your account (or ask for us to do it) to remove *all* your data. This can't be reversed so be careful!

✅ If you ignore this email, your account will be archived in about a week.

Archiving deletes your name and hashes your email address(es). Hashing is used to store and check information securely. 

If you log into an archived account, we will ask you to give us your name and email address again.

See our privacy policy to understand exactly which information we will remove or keep when your account is archived.

Hope to see you again! 👋

The Grok Academy Team
support@groklearning.com

emails.subject: 【重要通知】BRAIN 6月 重要更新和比赛福利说明会
emails.body:
Dear All,

BRAIN 6月份有多项重要更新和比赛福利，为了更好的帮助大家了解这些更新，我们将在明天举办两场说明会。

各位顾问根据个人时间选择一场参加即可， 本次说明会将签到并计入Community Score。

时间一：2025年5月29日 周四 12：30 – 13：30


  *   接入链接： https://worldquant.zoom.us/j/97998732869?pwd=soQgNM9BojFOKaYb5fHEr54bLELN0x.1
  *   网络研讨会编号: 979 9873 2869
  *   密码： 977637


时间二：2025年5月29日 周四 20：30 – 21：30


  *   接入链接：https://worldquant.zoom.us/j/99319940879?pwd=Gl1aaEO0GiNo53GSh9qKsbJ1zqkx23.1
  *   网络研讨会编号: 993 1994 0879
  *   密码： 997942





说明会概览



  *   Regular Alpha 福利: 6月新增PPAC 排行榜，除日常的Base Payment外，PPAC 排行榜根据after - cost OS score的提升排名，USA/ASI/EUR/GLB/Other Region 的每个排行榜前10名将额外获得150-500 USD的奖励，可重复获得多个排行榜的奖励。
  *   Super Alpha福利：6月Super Alpha Competition 2025比赛期间，所有非IQC顾问/有条件顾问将限时解锁Super Alpha权限，并且可以使用全球其它顾问的Alpha，相当于GM的Super Alpha权限。除每日的1-60 USD Base Payment外，有机会获得总计50K USD的比赛奖金。
  *   BRAIN Lab 发布：BRAIN Lab是2025年平台的重要更新，目前正在向GM灰度测试，计划将于6月份向所有用户开放权限。通过BRAIN Lab，顾问可以更好的探索Alpha和数据的值，更深入的研究Alpha的底层数据和运行结果。
  *   BRAIN AI Researcher 全职招聘：需要有AI，LLM相关工作经验，地点北京/上海
  *   其它近期更新
     *   截止至3月底的Combined Performance Score和Value Factor已经更新，VF低于0.5的同学近期将收到我们第二期提升计划的邀请。部分顾问也已经开始获得weight，可在Consultant 排行榜中查看。
     *   3-4月Base Payment已经发送（账单金额大于10USD，并且4月30日前已经填写银行卡成为full consultant），请登录Workday确认invoice以确保收到付款
     *   ASI 将需要强制打开Max Trade设定，以更贴近真实的市场交易环境，该设定为Off将无法回测ASI的任何alpha。
     *   Community Score持续更新，该分数包含论坛、推荐、参会等组成部分，等权后Normalize计算得分。
     *   6月Global Opportunity Webinar 已经开放注册，该会议为顾问全球月度会议，并将计入Community Score，请确保用BRAIN平台邮箱注册并参加该会议以获得记分。
     *   PPAC 2.5倍Theme将在6月1日结束，Theme将帮助你提高Quality Score并有可能获得更高的Base Payment

明天见！


[WQ Brain AI Horizontal Rev-01]

WQ BRAIN China Mainland Team
MainlandChina@worldquantbrain.com<mailto:MainlandChina@worldquantbrain.com>

Hi

SAC 2025 is now live and you have been enrolled into the competition. You can start building up your score by submitting USA/ASI/EUR/GLB Region Delay 1 SuperAlphas using component Alphas from only one category assigned to you in the respective week. *You have been assigned* *Group 2 (G2)* ( https://support.worldquantbrain.com/hc/en-us/articles/32416028514583-What-are-the-weekly-categories-during-Super-Alpha-Competition-SAC-2025 ) *for this competition.*

We are thrilled to announce that there will also be weekly rankings, which will allow eligible top performers to potentially earn additional stipend amounts, based on their rank within each category of SuperAlphas at the end of each week (Monday 12AM EST to Sunday 11:59 PM EST)

The details of the one-time stipend for the weekly rankings are as follows:
1st Place: US$ 300
2nd Place: US$ 200
3rd Place: US$ 100

*Please refer to the official guidelines ( https://platform.worldquantbrain.com/competition/SAC2025 ) for applicable rules and restrictions

We encourage you to take full advantage of these opportunities and look forward to seeing the innovative solutions you come up with each week.

Power your quant performance!
WorldQuant BRAIN

To view this email as a webpage, [click here](https://connect.ieee.org/v/NzU2LUdQSC04OTkAAAGa0F53ZVBjygtPadyLszaDWu9bDgyxTMBvnglS8QBOYfxlC3DH2g9ffJsquijGWDpr2sJxlD0=).

Your Path to IEEE

[JOIN NOW](https://www.ieee.org/membership/join?utm_source=Learn More About IEEE&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=learnmore&utm_id=entry&utm_content=checkin2)

[AI Through Our Ages](https://transmitter.ieee.org/ai-autonomous-technologies-2025/?utm_source=Learn More About IEEE&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=learnmore&utm_id=entry&utm_content=checkin2)

AI is seamlessly blending into our lives, solving humanity’s greatest challenges. From enhancing education and career growth to caring for loved ones, AI drives meaningful change across the human lifespan. Discover AI's impact on every generation with insights from IEEE Impact Creators on IEEE Transmitter™.

[Learn more!](https://transmitter.ieee.org/ai-autonomous-technologies-2025/?utm_source=Learn More About IEEE&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=learnmore&utm_id=entry&utm_content=checkin2)

Member Benefits

[Join IEEE at a Reduced Rate](https://www.ieee.org/membership/join?utm_source=Learn More About IEEE&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=learnmore&utm_id=entry&utm_content=checkin2)

IEEE offers discounted membership rates for individuals in [developing nations](https://www.ieee.org/membership/join/emember-countries?utm_source=Learn More About IEEE&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=learnmore&utm_id=entry&utm_content=checkin2) and low-income economies, making it easier than ever to access world-class resources, networking, and career opportunities. Whether you're a student, researcher, or professional, IEEE connects you to a global community and tools to help you thrive.

[Explore membership options and join today >](https://www.ieee.org/membership/join?utm_source=Learn More About IEEE&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=learnmore&utm_id=entry&utm_content=checkin2)

[Free eBook for IEEE Members: This & That – Volume 1: Ruminations of an Engineering Mind](https://ieeeusa.org/product/this-and-that-volume-1/?utm_source=Learn More About IEEE&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=learnmore&utm_id=entry&utm_content=checkin2)

Did you know IEEE members get a free eBook every month? This month’s pick, This & That – Volume 1: Ruminations of an Engineering Mind is a witty and insightful collection of essays from IEEE-USA’s award-winning author Russ Harrison. It’s a light, engaging read that blends humor with professional wisdom—perfect for your next coffee break.

[Explore more FREE eBooks](https://ieeeusa.org/product/this-and-that-volume-1/?utm_source=Learn More About IEEE&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=learnmore&utm_id=entry&utm_content=checkin2)

[Find Opportunities with IEEE Volunteering](https://volunteer.ieee.org/?utm_source=Learn More About IEEE&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=learnmore&utm_id=entry&utm_content=checkin2)

Ready to take your IEEE experience to the next level? The IEEE Volunteering Platform is your gateway to meaningful volunteer opportunities tailored to your skills, passions, and goals. Whether you want to grow your professional network, sharpen your leadership abilities, or give back to the global engineering community, this platform has it all!

[Learn more >](https://volunteer.ieee.org/?utm_source=Learn More About IEEE&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=learnmore&utm_id=entry&utm_content=checkin2)

Tech Trends

[Say Hello to Our Robot of the Month: Astrobee!](https://robotsguide.com/robots/astrobee?utm_source=Learn More About IEEE&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=learnmore&utm_id=entry&utm_content=checkin2)

Meet Astrobee, a free-flying robot designed for the International Space Station (ISS). It autonomously navigates the ISS, performing useful tasks for astronauts.

[Watch Astrobee in action >](https://robotsguide.com/robots/astrobee?utm_source=Learn More About IEEE&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=learnmore&utm_id=entry&utm_content=checkin2)

[Vulcan Bots Outpace Humans in Amazon Warehouses](https://spectrum.ieee.org/amazon-stowing-robots?utm_source=Learn More About IEEE&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=learnmore&utm_id=entry&utm_content=checkin2)

Amazon's Vulcan robots are transforming warehouse efficiency with advanced touch technology, optimizing the stowing process to handle 80% of items at a rate of 300 per hour. This innovation is setting new standards in robotic automation and warehouse management.

[Read more >](https://spectrum.ieee.org/amazon-stowing-robots?utm_source=Learn More About IEEE&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=learnmore&utm_id=entry&utm_content=checkin2)

Ready to level up your skills? For a limited

emails.subject: Only 5 Days to Deadline - The 2025 International Conference in Banking and Financial Studies (ICBFS 2025)
emails.sender: "the International Society for the Advancement of Financial Economics (ISAFE)" <conference.isafe@9446084.brevosend.com>
emails.body:
**CALL FOR PAPERS**

 

**The 2025 International Conference in Banking and Financial Studies**

 

**11-12 September 2025**

 

** Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore, Piacenza, Milan, Italy**


**Conference dates**

11- 12 September 2025

 

**Location**

Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore (Piacenza), Italy

 

**Conference website**

[https://gnc2s.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeFuBmo3EEaqwZvrGXpUH/R9HuRp8ZnYhk](https://gnc2s.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeG13EwsBPl0QflA0W84X/MMABMZ5dkP81)

 

**TIMELINE AND SUBMISSION PROCESS**

Papers and extended abstracts should be submitted by June 30, 2025 (Early submissions are highly encouraged) by attaching to the email both title page and full paper without authors’ details.  Decisions will be provided during the first week of July 2025.

 

**IMPORTANT DATES**

Submission deadline: 30 June 2025

Notification of review results: 05 July 2025

Registration deadline: 16 August 2025

Conference event: 11-12 September 2025

 

**TOPICS**

We welcome papers that delve into several pertinent topics, aiming to foster comprehensive discussions and shed light on the multifaceted nature of the banking and finance domain. These topics include, but are not limited to:


- Accounting, auditing, and taxation 
- Asset allocation and valuation 
- Banking regulation and financial services 
- Behavioral and experimental finance/economics 
- Big data in finance, artificial intelligence, and cyber security 
- Climate finance and sustainability 
- Corporate finance, IPOs, SEOs, M&A, and crowdfunding 
- Corporate governance 
- Country funds, sovereign funds, and hedge funds 
- Debt issues 
- Digital finance, cryptocurrency finance, and blockchain 
- Emerging markets finance 
- Energy finance and environment Issues 
- Entrepreneurial finance, venture capital, and private equity 
- Ethical finance, green finance, ESG and CSR 
- Financial accounting and regulation 
- Financial crises, contagion, integration, and global risks interconnection 
- Financial engineering and derivatives 
- Foreign currency issue 
- Global imbalances & sustainability 
- Household finance, real estate finance, and microfinance 
- Market behavior efficiency 
- Multinational financial management 
- Portfolio management and optimization 
- Risk management and compliance 
- Small business finance
  
**KEYNOTE SPEAKERS**

emails.subject: SuperNet: built for messy scans, tricky tables, and complex layouts
emails.body:
Snip now delivers significantly more accurate results while reducing costs, all without requiring you to change anything.


** What SuperNet brings to Snip
------------------------------------------------------------
Our most advanced layout model, SuperNet, now powers Snip behind the scenes — dramatically improving how it handles complex documents. Expect better structure recognition, cleaner output, and fewer errors when working with irregular layouts and noisy inputs.

1. Improved table recognition, including support for vertical tables, rotated cells, and diagonally split cells.

This table includes rotated and angled text — SuperNet accurately detects, aligns, and extracts the data while preserving structure:
2. More robust processing of low-quality scans and imperfect PDFs.

Snip can now extract clean content from documents with blur, skew, uneven lighting, or compression artifacts — preserving structure even when the source is messy.

Here’s an example of how a low-quality scan is accurately converted into usable output:
3. Improved detection and formatting of code and pseudocode.

Snip is better at distinguishing code from surrounding text and formatting it clearly, so indentation, symbols, and structure are preserved. Whether it’s a printed page or part of a dense PDF, you get clean, ready-to-use output.
See the full breakdown of SuperNet improvements in our changelog (https://mathpix.com/docs/convert/changelog#april-16%2C-2025) .


** Twice the included pages in Pro plan, and lower overage pricing
------------------------------------------------------------
* Snip Pro users now get 1,000 pages/month included (up from 500)

* Extra PDF is now priced at just $0.0035 per page (previously $0.01 — a 65% drop!)

These changes align with our updated PDF API pricing and make it easier to work with large documents without worrying about going over your limit.

When does this take effect?
The new limits and pricing will apply starting July 8, 2025.

Not on Pro yet? Update your plan here (https://accounts.mathpix.com/subscription) .


** Using the API? Check out our new Python client
------------------------------------------------------------
We’ve released mpxpy, our new Python client for the Mathpix Document Conversion APIs — built for developers and technical users who want more control. With mpxpy, you can:
* Process PDFs with multiple output formats (JSON, Markdown, DOCX, LaTeX, and more)
* Extract text, math, and structure from images
* Convert Mathpix Markdown (MMD) to standard formats like PDF, DOCX, HTML and Markdown
* Use a wide range of input types — including PDF, DOCX, PPTX, and EPUB

To get started, install the client:
pip install mpxpy
Here’s a simple example that converts a PDF to Markdown:
from mpxpy.mathpix_client import MathpixClient

client = MathpixClient(
app_id="your-app-id",
app_key="your-app-key"
)

pdf = client.pdf_new(
url="https://cdn.mathpix.com/examples/cs229-notes1.pdf",
convert_to_md=True
)

pdf.wait_until_complete(timeout=60)
print(pdf.to_md_text())
You’ll need an API account to use this — you can sign up here (https://console.mathpix.com/) .
For full details and setup instructions, check out the mpxpy documentation (https://github.com/Mathpix/mpxpy) .


** Other updates and bugfixes
------------------------------------------------------------
* Correctly recognizes the Chinese pause comma symbol (、) instead of misinterpreting it as a full-width comma
* Added support for LaTeX commands \diagbox, \slashbox, and \backslashbox for better recognition of split table cells
* Fixed drag-and-drop issues in Safari
* Improved keyboard navigation across the Snip web app

Thanks for using Mathpix — we hope these updates make your work easier.

Have questions? Don’t hesitate to reach out to our support team (mailto:support@mathpix.com) .

	“论文写完了，接下来投哪？”

	“被拒了好多次，还有哪些期刊可以投啊？！”

	原来写完文章才是投稿的开始：期刊太多，看不过来；影响因子、分区、审稿周期，各种指标一团乱麻；找准一个既合适又有希望接收的期刊，简直比重写一遍文章还要难！

	strtoupper("1．期刊搜索")

	进入“智能选刊”高级功能，默认选择期刊推荐板块，在下方输入标题、摘要及关键词，即可点击【推荐期刊】让文献鸟帮你搜索文章可投期刊。

Instant inference via Cerebras, Kimi K2, & every model on HuggingFace
emails.body:
Hello!
 

Nick from the Cline team here. 

Cline is quickly becoming the best place to test the latest models as soon as they're released. Here are some of my favorites we've recently added:
 

**Cerebras - 2500 tokens per second** - We've added Cerebras as a provider, giving you access to **Qwen3-32B** with 64k context at speeds that feel instant. For context, this is **40x faster** than Sonnet-4. You can also use **Qwen3-235B-A22B**. [**Try it free with Cerebras.**](https://giq5o.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2nfsTSQvpVwlInwXywVLK9ur/b74SXCHP3Dbd)

Quick note: we're hosting a hackathon with Cerebras next Saturday to explore what's possible with instant inference. [RSVP here](https://giq5o.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2nfuMRxR8UVzkqIrn6rq6trN/G9mulKSwD8Ki).


*This video is not sped up (!)*


**Kimi K2** - We’ve been observing Kimi K2’s real-world performance in Cline. One thing really stands out: diff edit failure rates **match Sonnet-4** at 4% and outperform Gemini 2.5 Pro (10%). [More details](https://giq5o.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2nfwFRTwRT5ECsfBbHEKtdnt/OAxTRlPaHrIL) on what we’re seeing with Kimi K2. 


**Qwen3-coder** - Alibaba just released their latest open source model, which is outperforming Kimi 2 on Artificial Analysis. We're seeing an interesting trend where open source models are converging on the performance of their closed source counterparts.


**HuggingFace playground** - Every text-generation model (6,140 models!) on HuggingFace is now accessible in Cline. If it's on HF, you can use it in Cline. 🤗
 

More to come soon :)
 

*-Nick*

emails.subject: 新旗舰GLM-4.5发布｜国产模型综合第一，全球开源模型SOTA！
emails.body:
亲爱的智谱大模型开放平台用户，


我们重磅发布新一代旗舰模型 GLM-4.5 系列，现已上线 BigModel.cn。

  • 这是智谱专为智能体应用打造的基础模型，GLM-4.5 国产综合评测第一，性能媲美全球最强旗舰模型。
  • 参数效率翻倍，高速版最高可达 100 Tokens / 秒；定价远低于主流模型，并依旧提供可完全免费调用的版本。
  • 真实体验胜于榜单，代码智能体场景人工实测国内最佳。支持一键兼容 Claude Code 框架。👉 立即体验


🚀 GLM-4.5 核心亮点一览：

  • 综合性能SOTA：首次在单个模型中实现了推理、代码、智能体等多能力原生融合，在最具有代表性的12个评测基准中，GLM-4.5 的综合能力取得了全球模型第三、国产模型第一，开源模型第一。

  • 更高的参数效率：GLM-4.5 系列采用混合专家（MoE）架构，与业内其他相同参数规模的 MoE 架构模型相比，GLM-4.5 系列模型在多项标准基准测试中表现得更为出色。

  • 更擅长开发：GLM-4.5系列在工具调用、网页浏览、软件工程、前端编程领域进行了优化，可以接入 Claude Code、Roo Code 等代码智能体中使用，也可以通过工具调用接口支持任意的智能体应用。
  • 支持混合推理双模式：可在两种工作模式灵活切换，包括用于复杂推理和工具使用的思考模式，以及用于即时响应的非思考模式。
  • 高速、低成本：API 调用价格低至输入 0.8 元 / 百万Tokens、输出 2 元 / 百万Tokens；高速版生成速度超过 100 Tokens / 秒。

了解更多


🎉 上新狂欢特惠：

  • 全系列5折：即日起至 8 月 31 日，GLM-4.5 全系列模型限时 5 折！
  • 折扣续航：活动期间调用并累计消耗达标，即享后续 3 个月全平台智谱模型

emails.subject: Cline Teams is here + exciting model updates (GLM-4.5, free Horizon-Alpha)
emails.body:
Hello!

Saoud from Cline here. I'm excited to share a couple updates that make Cline even more powerful for you and your team.


**Cline Teams Dashboard** - We've just launched our Teams dashboard to make it easier for organizations to use Cline together. Free for teams up to 10 users. Here's what you get:


- **Form Your Organization & Invite Members** - Set up your workspace and onboard your team in minutes 
- **Granular Access Control & Credit Sharing** - Define roles (admin/member) and share credits across your organization 
- **Comprehensive Usage Insights** - Track model usage, token consumption, and spending by team member 
- **Hassle-Free Account Switching** - Toggle between personal and organization accounts seamlessly 
 

[**Try Cline Teams!**](https://giq5o.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2nfsTSQvpVwlInwXywVLK9ur/PsgPGAPDjToC)


**Open-source models closing the gap** - We've noticed a significant improvement diff edits and tool-calling success rates in open-source models -- traditionally weak areas. Two standouts just landed in Cline:
 

**GLM-4.5 from zAI** - An agent-focused model designed for coding and tool use with a 128k context window and just $0.60/$2.20 per million tokens.

 

**Qwen3-Coder** - Shows impressive real-world performance with just 5.5% diff edit failure rate, approaching Claude 4 Sonnet's 4% while costing a fraction of the price.

**Horizon-Alpha** - this new stealth model is free to use via OpenRouter (the last stealth model ended up being GPT-4.1)


Today we're also glad to share that we've raised $32m in Seed + A funding to keep building Cline. Thank you for being part of this journey -- Cline would be nothing without its incredible community.

 

This funding helps us expand our enterprise features, bring Cline to JetBrains and other IDEs, and continue making Cline the most powerful open-source coding agent.
 

Read our [funding announcement blog](https://giq5o.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2nfuMRxR8UVzkqIrn6rq6trN/81TGfn4F0-Xr) and check out the [official announcement](https://giq5o.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2nfwFRTwRT5ECsfBbHEKtdnt/VbqYUs0appo7).

 

-*Saoud*
Founder & CEO,

emails.body:
Opportunity to Attend IQC Global Finals in Singapore​!

( https://www.worldquant.com/brain/iqc/ )

Dear Xiaoxiao,

We are thrilled to announce that the *Global Finals of the 2025 International Quant Championship (IQC)* will take place on *September 29 and 30* in *Singapore*.

This exclusive event will feature presentations from the IQC finalists, inspiring talks by internal and external speakers, and opportunities to meet various members of the BRAIN and WorldQuant teams in person. It’s a unique chance to network with top talent and further immerse yourself in the world of quantitative finance.

As a valued consultant, we are offering you the opportunity to apply for a spot to attend this prestigious event. Selected consultants will represent the global consultant community at IQC as ambassadors, sharing their experiences and insights to inspire and engage our broader community.

Please note that seats are limited, and applications will be reviewed based on your submission.

*Selected participants will be eligible to receive:* **

* Reimbursement for economy-class flights (if applicable)
* Hotel accommodation and meals during the event
* Assistance with visa arrangements (if required)

To apply, please complete the application form and upload your resume via link below by *August 10, 2025*. ** The selected consultants will be informed of our decision on or about *August 14, 2025*. Please note that if you do not receive a communication around that time, you were not selected from the eligible applicants.  As a reminder, WorldQuant reserves the sole right and discretion to select the consultants to attend the IQC Global Finals.

Apply Now ( https://www.surveymonkey.com/r/PVQ3LSS )

We look forward to reviewing your application and potentially welcoming you to Singapore for this exciting event.

Best regards,
WorldQuant BRAIN

emails.text: Opportunity to Attend IQC Global Finals in Singapore​! ( https://www.worldquant.com/brain/iqc/ ) Dear Xiaoxiao, We are thrilled to announce that the *Global Finals of the 2025 International Quant Championship (IQC)* will take place on *September 29 and 30* in *Singapore*. This exclusive event will feature presentations from the IQC finalists, inspiring talks by internal and external speakers, and opportunities to meet various members of the BRAIN and WorldQuant teams in person. It’s a unique chance to network with top talent and further immerse yourself in the world of quantitative finance. As a valued consultant, we are offering you the opportunity to apply for a spot to attend this prestigious event. Selected consultants will represent the global consultant community at IQC as ambassadors, sharing their experiences and insights to inspire and engage our broader community. Computer Science and Technology
计算机科学与技术

Artiᴄlе Ѕսbmission

   - Publіcаtіon type: Gold Open Аccеss
   - ΡuЬlication duration: from 6 to 17 weeks
   - Length limit: about 4-12 pages


   - Language requirement: Chinese or English
   - Initial rеvіеw result: 3 days
   - Peer revіeԝ results: within 3-4 weeks

*Computer Science and Technology* ѕerᴠes as a leading international јournаl
for researchers in the field of computer science and technology and its
related interdisciplines. The ϳoսrnal remains open for general sսbmissiοns,
providing a continuous оppоrtunitу for researchers to share their findings.
Should you be ready to ѕuЬmit your manսscriрt, kindly forward it to us via
email or utilize our ᴡeЬsite for the sսЬmission process:
http://www.cscitech.org <http://www.cscitech.org/index/ww4pID>


Jοіn the Еԁitorial Вoаrd/Rеviеᴡer Team
As the joսrnаl continues to thrive, we are extending an invitation to new
researchers to become part of our Eԁitоrial Boаrԁ/Rеvіеwer Team, presenting
them with an exclusіνe οррοrtunity to be involved in ϳoսrnal activities.
Jοіn us through this lіnκ: http://www.cscitech.org/bsi/ww4pID


A List of Recommended Αrtіcles
Listed here are the puЬliѕhed аrtіcles in Computer Science and Technology
and they may be related to your research interests.
Тіtle: *Distributed Archival Aᴄᴄeѕѕ Technology Based on Erasable Bloom
Filters*
Αutһor(s): Luo Chunqi, Liu Xu, Xiao Pengcheng, Zhu Zhousen, Liao Xuehua,
Keywords: Erasable Bloom Filter; Cross-domain Distributed Storage;
Electronic Records Management
Тitlе: *Improved Support Vector Machine Personal Credit Rating Model*
Αutһor(s): Xiaoli Liu, Cheng Li, Tianshan Wang
Keywords: Personal Credit Assessment; Support Vector Machine; Quadric
XGBOOST
Contact us: If you would like to discuss anything, please reply to this
email directly.

Below is the аЬstrаct of which the topic is interesting: To improve the
operational efficiency and reliability of photovoltaic power stations, this
рaреr introduces a novel approach to detect outliers in photovoltaic arrays
using a Vine-Copula method. The procedure is divided into two distinct
phases. Initially, it identifies deviations in the direct current (DC)
component of the photovoltaic (PV) system. The following phase extends this
by pinpointing irregularities in the DC voltage of the array. To model the
interconnection between the PV current, irradiance, and temperature, the
Vine-Copula is employed in this process. The optimisation of this function
is based on the Akaike information criterion. Subsequently, a conditional
probability model for the PV current is developed along with a formula to
determine the quantile of this probability. This interval is then employed
as the primary metric for detecting and eliminating current deviations.
After refining the current data, a similar approach is taken to address
voltage irregularities. The results of the simulation tests indicate that
this prοpοѕed method is more effective, showing lower error rates and
higher accuracy in detecting outliers, compared to other methods.

Тіtle: *Distributed Archival Aᴄᴄeѕѕ Technology Based on Erasable Bloom Filters* Αutһor(s): Luo Chunqi, Liu Xu, Xiao Pengcheng, Zhu Zhousen, Liao Xuehua, Keywords: Erasable Bloom Filter; Cross-domain Distributed Storage; Electronic Records Management Тitlе: *Improved Support Vector Machine Personal Credit Rating Model* Αutһor(s): Xiaoli Liu, Cheng Li, Tianshan Wang Keywords: Personal Credit Assessment; Support Vector Machine; Quadric XGBOOST Contact us: If you would like to discuss anything, please reply to this email directly. Below is the аЬstrаct of which the topic is interesting: To improve the operational efficiency and reliability of photovoltaic power stations, this рaреr introduces a novel approach to detect outliers in photovoltaic arrays using a Vine-Copula method. The procedure is divided into two distinct phases. Initially, it identifies deviations in the direct current (DC) component of the photovoltaic (PV) system. The following phase extends this by pinpointing irregularities in the DC voltage of the array. To model the interconnection between the PV current, irradiance, and temperature, the Vine-Copula is employed in this process. The optimisation of this function is based on the Akaike information criterion. Subsequently, a conditional probability model for the PV current is developed along with a formula to determine the quantile of this probability. This interval is then employed as the primary metric for detecting and eliminating current deviations. After refining the current data, a similar approach is taken to address voltage irregularities. The results of the simulation tests indicate that this prοpοѕed method is more effective, showing lower error rates and higher accuracy in detecting outliers, compared to other methods.

emails.body:
Invitation to Submit to Contemporary Mathematics (IF 2.5, Q1) – Exclusive 30% APC Discount

    
 
 
 

Dear Authors,

We are delighted to share that Contemporary Mathematics (https://ojs.wiserpub.com/index.php/CM/) has achieved a new Impact Factor of 2.5 (Web of Science), securing its position in Q1 rankings:

Top 21/483 in Mathematics
Top 39/343 in Mathematics, Applied

This milestone reflects the strong support from our academic community. We warmly invite you and your colleagues to submit your outstanding work.

Limited-Time Submission Discount

Discount APC: 1,750 SGD (30% reduction; original fee: 2,500 SGD)
Discount Code: HJCM750
Submission Deadline: 30 September 2025
Note: This offer cannot be combined with other discounts.

Submission Options

Submit via E-mail: Send your manuscript to cm2@wiser.pub (discount will be automatically obtained)
Online Submission System: submit via https://ojs.wiserpub.com/index.php/CM/about/submissions. "Please include the discount code "HJCM750" in the comment box and email your manuscript ID + disocount code to cm2@wiser.pub"

Efficient Publication Timeline

First decision: Within 15 working days of APC confirmation
Online publication: Within 5 working days of payment receipt

We sincerely appreciate your support and look forward to your submissions. For inquiries or to discuss potential contributions, please contact us directly.

Kind regards,

Mason Ho
Publishing Manager
Editorial Group 2, Contemporary Mathematics
Universal Wiser Publisher (UWP)
Email: cm2@wiser.pub
Address: 12 Woodlands Square, #05-71, Singapore 737715
