emails.sender: "the International Society for the Advancement of Financial Economics (ISAFE)" <conference.isafe@9446084.brevosend.com>
emails.body:
**CALL FOR PAPERS**

 

**the 12th Tunisian Society for Financial Studies (TSFS2025)**

 

**19-20 December 2025**

 

** Monastir, Tunisia**


**Conference dates**

19-20 December 2025

 

**Location**

[Monastir, Tunisia](https://gnc2s.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeG13EwsBPl0QflA0W84X/tmMttchxq2FL)

 

**Conference website**

[https://gnc2s.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeFuBmo3EEaqwZvrGXpUH/SZiiPE874V3Z](https://gnc2s.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeG7uh5h8av9ulaSkUQen/Fe730xYNshWT) 

 

**TIMELINE AND SUBMISSION PROCESS**

Papers and extended abstracts (in PDF version) should be submitted by September 30, 2025 (Early submissions are highly encouraged). Decisions will be made on average one week after the submission.

 

**IMPORTANT DATES**

- Submission deadline: September 30, 2025
- Notification of review results: October 5, 2025
- Registration deadline: November 07, 2025
- Conference dates: 19-20 December 2025

 

**KEYNOTE SPEAKERS**


- **Prof. Emanuele Bajo,** University of Bologna Business School, Italy. Executive Editor of the Journal of Economics and Business, Elsevier. 
- **Prof. Stergios Leventis**, the International Hellenic University (IHU), Greece. Editor-in-Chief of the Journal of International Accounting, Auditing and Taxation (JIAAT), Associate Editor of the British Accounting Review (BAR), and sits on the editorial boards of several leading peer-reviewed journals, actively shaping global accounting research. 
- **Prof. Silvio Vismara,** University of Bergamo, Italy, and IMT School for Advanced Studies Lucca, Italy. Editor of Entrepreneurship Theory and Practice and Journal of Technology Transfer; Executive Editor of Review of Corporate Finance. 
 

**TOPICS**

We welcome papers that delve into several pertinent topics, aiming to foster comprehensive discussions and shed light on the multifaceted nature of the banking and finance domain. These topics include, but are not limited to:


- Accounting 
- Alternative Finance 
- Asset Pricing 
- Bank Lending 
- Bank Management 
- Behavioral Finance 
- Big Data 
- Blockchains and Cryptocurrencies 
- Commodities Markets 
- Contemporary Issues in Banking 
- Corporate Finance and Governance 
- Data Mining in Finance 
- Emerging Markets 
- Energy 
- Entrepreneurship and Ethics

- Environmental Economics 
- Exchange Rates and Interest Rates 
- Financial Economics 
- Financial Entrepreneurship 
- Financial Integration 
- Financial Markets 
- Financial Modelling and Forecasting 
- Financial Policy and Regulation 
- Firm Performance 
- Green Economy 
- Green Finance 
- IFRS reports 
- Insurance 
- International Finance 
- Islamic Banking and Finance

- Macroeconomic Policy 
- Management Market 
- Microstructure Mergers and Acquisition 
- Portfolio Management 
- Risk Management 
- Strategic Management 
- Sustainable Finance 
- Theoretical and Applied Finance 
- Quantitative Finance 
- Virtual Finance 
- Virtual networks


**STEERING COMMITTEE**


- Sabri Boubaker (EM Normandie Business School, France) 
- Slaheddine Hellara (Tunis University, Tunisia)
  
**CO-CHAIRS**


- Houssam Bouzgarrou (Sousse University, Tunisia) 
- Imen Ghadhab (Sousse University, Tunisia) 
**PUBLICATION OPPORTUNITIES**


- [Journal of International Financial Management & Accounting](https://gnc2s.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeGEm9EW5m5JOrPlUSjF3/DdgCRsZRShzT) 
- [Journal of Financial Reporting and Accounting](https://gnc2s.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeGLdbNL2xFSsxF4ER1pJ/X1jrEoN3l_pA)

emails.subject:
Introducing Kiln Tools & MCP, Step-by-Step AI Project Guide & Why We
 Wrote 2000 LLM Test Cases
emails.body:
New Tools & MCP support, comprehensive model testing suite, and step-by-step AI project guides to accelerate your AI development

Kiln Logo ( https://getkiln.ai )

*Tools & MCP*

We're thrilled to launch Tools & MCP support for Kiln AI. You can now connect tools to Kiln tasks to enhance their capabilities.

To go with the release, we're publishing a new video "Tools 101: Intro to Tool Calling and MCP". It's an easy-to-follow guide to help get teams up to speed on tools. It covers:

* Context management: how to prevent tools from overwhelming your context window.
* Parallel vs Serial tool calling: mixing tool call methods for performance and complex multi-step tasks
* Selecting tool-optimized models
* Demos of popular tools: web search, web scraping, Python interpreter, and more

Watch the video ( https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qh0FIrLMrII ) or read the tools docs ( https://docs.kiln.tech/docs/tools-and-mcp ).

Tools 101 Video ( https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qh0FIrLMrII )

*Step-by-Step AI Project: Video Guide*

Does starting an AI project from scratch seem daunting? In this video guide we walk through every step, from initial prompt to ensuring ongoing quality with evals. The entire project we build is open-source and available on GitHub.

Step-by-Step AI Project Video Guide ( https://youtu.be/f1JU3wIxExE )

*Why We Wrote 2000 AI Model Test Cases*

Picking the right model for a task isn't easy. Does it support tool calling? What's the most reliable way to get JSON output? What format does it use for reasoning tokens?

Kiln has added a comprehensive suite of over 2000 model capabilities tests to remove the guesswork from model selection.

Read our blog post on the testing methodology ( https://kiln.tech/blog/i_wrote_2000_llm_test_cases_so_you_dont_have_to ) , or check out the Kiln Model Library ( https://kiln.tech/model_library ) with the results.

*Kiln v0.20.1 App Release*

Our new release adds many important features:

* Tools & MCP
* New AI Providers: Cerebras, Docker, SiliconFlow.cn
* New Models: GPT-5, GPT OSS, GLM, Qwen 3 2507, MiniMax, Hunyuan, Pangu Pro, and more
* Much more: Linux installer, improved UI, improved fine-tuning...

Download Kiln ( https://getkiln.ai/download )

*How to Get Help (or Help Out)*

We're an open-source project and we really appreciate community feedback and support! Some ways you can help:
• Share Kiln ( https://kiln.tech ) with friends and co-workers
• Star our repo on GitHub ( https://github.com/Kiln-AI/Kiln ) or help by filing/fixing issues
• Join our Discord ( https://kiln.tech/discord ) and give feedback

Thanks for all your support!
Steve - The Kiln Maintainer
steve@kiln.tech

emails.subject: Improved table rendering in Snipping Tool, figure label recognition, 2FA support, and more!
emails.body:
We’ve dramatically improved our rendering of large tables in the Snipping Tool desktop apps, and added accurate recognition of figure labels in PDFs containing charts, diagrams, and tables. We’ve also enhanced our security features by adding the option to enable two-factor authentication (2FA) when logging in to your Mathpix account.


** Improved rendering for large tables in Snipping Tool desktop apps
------------------------------------------------------------
This year we released our new model, SuperNet (https://mathpix.com/blog/supernet) , which brought significant improvements to our OCR capability on large tables. However, the Snipping Tool (https://mathpix.com/snipping-tool) previously displayed these tables in a way that required excessive scrolling to see the full results.

To improve the experience, we now have smarter rendering for large tables in the Snipping Tool, making readability much better:
Not yet using the Snipping Tool on desktop? Download it today (https://mathpix.com/desktop-downloads) on Mac, Windows, or Linux and start saving time!


** Linking of figure labels to figures in PDFs
------------------------------------------------------------
In a recent SuperNet improvement (SuperNet-105 (https://mathpix.com/blog/figure-labels) ), we added support for recognition of figure labels in PDFs. This significantly improves results when processing PDFs that are figure heavy. In the Mathpix Markdown (MMD) output, figure labels will link to their corresponding figure, whether it is a chart, diagram, or table.

For example, if you uploaded the famous Attention Is All You Need paper PDF (excerpt below):
You would get this MMD result (for the excerpt):
\begin{figure}
\includegraphics[width=\textwidth]{https://cdn.mathpix.com/cropped/2025_08_15_c876efce4b15ced94aa5g-03.jpg?height=1137&width=785⊤_left_y=243⊤_left_x=674}
\captionsetup{labelformat=empty}
\caption{Figure 1: The Transformer - model architecture.}
\end{figure}

The Transformer follows this overall architecture using stacked self-attention and point-wise, fully connected layers for both the encoder and decoder, shown in the left and right halves of Figure 1, respectively.
Please note that figure label linking is only available for PDF processing. If you take a Snip of an individual figure and label, we will ignore the figure if it cannot be OCRed and just return the text in the label.


** 2FA now supported for all Mathpix accounts
------------------------------------------------------------
Anyone with a Mathpix account can now enable an additional security feature: two-factor authentication (2FA) (https://mathpix.com/blog/two-factor-authentication) . 2FA adds an extra layer of protection to your Mathpix account. You can choose between sending an email verification code or using a 3rd-party authenticator app. Please note that using a 3rd-party auth app is the more secure option and our recommended method.

To enable 2FA, navigate to the Security (https://accounts.mathpix.com/security) tab under Personal Settings on the Mathpix Accounts website. From there, you can choose between receiving a verification code via email, or adding Mathpix to your authenticator app.
Please note that if you enable 2FA on your account, you will need to update to the latest desktop and mobile versions of the app in order to login.


** Other improvements
------------------------------------------------------------
* Significant improvements to our recognition of Tamil, Bengali, and Gujarati languages
* Improvements to handwritten Chinese and Japanese text
* Bug fixes in our code block rendering
* Improved chemistry rendering with more consistent font sizes for atom labels
* Improved internal chemical representation; now returning more accurate Daylight SMILES, and added CXSMILES in SVG’s


** Want to rep Mathpix on your campus?
------------------------------------------------------------
We're piloting the Mathpix Campus Ambassador Program this fall semester!

If you're a STEM student who loves sharing useful tools, helping fellow students save time, and being part of a community that cares about moving scientific progress forward, this is for you.

As an ambassador, you’ll get a free Mathpix Pro account, Mathpix gear, access to beta features, and the chance to host events, create content, and help shape the future of Mathpix.

Apply here (https://forms.gle/Us8Kn6QS6GrBcSnz5) for the first-ever pilot Mathpix Campus Ambassador cohort!


** We'd love to hear from you!
------------------------------------------------------------
If you have any questions or feedback, please don’t hesitate to reach out to our Support Team (mailto:support@mathpix.com)  or respond directly to this email.
As always, thank you for choosing Mathpix. We have a lot of exciting things planned and we look forward to seeing the great things you will create with our tools!

Please share your projects with us on socials:
@mathpixa

emails.subject: Your Path to IEEE: Tap Into Member-Only Innovation
emails.body:
To view this email as a webpage, [click here](https://connect.ieee.org/v/NzU2LUdQSC04OTkAAAGc7RjzUJ0TZZq68hmI86SU8V52TazS95WmjVvAA3wJWeeg_FRzrdneGSvllxa4xFfeyYm1hRo=).

Your Path to IEEE

[JOIN NOW](https://www.ieee.org/membership/join?utm_source=mkto&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=learnmore&utm_id=checkin&utm_content=sept-nov25)

Hello! This newsletter provides an introduction to the professional benefits and resources available through IEEE. You will find a mix of free content you can access today and exclusive content available only to members.

Access Tech Content

[IEEE & Pixar Collaborate for the RenderMan Art Challenge](https://spectrum.ieee.org/ieee-renderman-tech-milestone?utm_source=mkto&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=learnmore&utm_id=checkin&utm_content=sept-nov25)

The RenderMan SciTech Art Challenge, powered by IEEE and Pixar, drew nearly 200 entries in 2024! Artists and engineers showcased stunning Computer-Generated Imagery (CGI) techniques. You can read about the collaboration, but as an IEEE member, you could be part of a community that makes these global events possible. The 2025 challenge is approaching, and it continues to inspire the next generation of digital creators.

[Read more >](https://spectrum.ieee.org/ieee-renderman-tech-milestone?utm_source=mkto&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=learnmore&utm_id=checkin&utm_content=sept-nov25)

[Transforming Cybersecurity with AI](https://ieeeusa.org/product/transforming-cybersecurity-with-ai-a-revolutionary-approach/?utm_source=mkto&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=learnmore&utm_id=checkin&utm_content=sept-nov25)

AI isn't just enhancing cybersecurity—it’s redefining it. This exclusive eBook explores why integrating AI into security frameworks is now essential to protect digital assets. As an IEEE member, you get free access to a full library of career-boosting ebooks. Download this free resource to discover how innovation meets necessity in the future of cyber defense.

[Download today >](https://ieeeusa.org/product/transforming-cybersecurity-with-ai-a-revolutionary-approach/?utm_source=mkto&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=learnmore&utm_id=checkin&utm_content=sept-nov25)

Unlock Exclusive Benefits

[New Courses: Data Privacy and Cybersecurity](https://iln.ieee.org/Public/ContentDetails.aspx?utm_source=mkto&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=learnmore&utm_id=checkin&utm_content=sept-nov25&id=B92B38F09CFF447296148E4493A6C35C)

In our digital world, data privacy and cybersecurity are critical. IEEE offers a variety of eLearning courses to help you master these essential skills. Save 20% on select courses today! If you join, you'll save even more with the exclusive member pricing.

[Start learning today >](https://iln.ieee.org/Public/ContentDetails.aspx?utm_source=mkto&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=learnmore&utm_id=checkin&utm_content=sept-nov25&id=B92B38F09CFF447296148E4493A6C35C)

[Code. Compete. Conquer. IEEEXtreme 19.0 Awaits!](https://ieeextreme.org/?utm_source=mkto&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=learnmore&utm_id=checkin&utm_content=sept-nov25)

Ready to code your way to glory? Compete in IEEEXtreme 19.0, a worldwide 24-hour student coding showdown and IEEE's largest simultaneously attended event! Win prizes, earn certificates, and compete globally. This exclusive competition is only open to IEEE Student members. Take your skills to the next level by joining a community of global talent.

[Learn more >](https://ieeextreme.org/?utm_source=mkto&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=learnmore&utm_id=checkin&utm_content=sept-nov25)

[Project Echo: The Satellite That Echoed Across History](https://ieeetv.ieee.org/hidden/video/ieee-milestones-project-echo?utm_source=mkto&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=learnmore&utm_id=checkin&utm_content=sept-nov25)

Launched in 1960, Project Echo was the world’s first passive communications satellite. This IEEE Milestones video celebrates its legacy, groundbreaking technology, and the brilliant minds behind a mission that reshaped global communication. This is just one of many award-winning videos available in the exclusive IEEE.tv library that you can access as a member.

[Explore the legacy >](https://ieeetv.ieee.org/hidden/video/ieee-milestones-project-echo?utm_source=mkto&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=learnmore&utm_id=checkin&utm_content=sept-nov25)

Join a Global Community

[Celebrate Your Impact on IEEE Day](https://ieeeday.org/?utm_source=mkto&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=learnmore&utm_id=checkin&utm_content=sept-nov25)

Every year on the first Tuesday of October, we celebrate IEEE Day, commemorating the historic moment when engineers first gathered to share their technical ideas. It’s a day of collaboration and a chance for our members to engage with the global community. Becoming a member allows you to participate in and lead these local and global events.

[Learn more >](https://ieeeday.org/?utm_source=mkto&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=learnmore&utm_id=checkin&utm_content=sept-n

emails.subject: GitHub Copilot: What’s in your free plan 🤖
emails.body:
Welcome to GitHub Copilot.
Here’s how to get started.

You now have access to GitHub Copilot in VS Code and github.com for free as part of your GitHub user account—and
that includes support for models from OpenAI and Anthropic.

Ask Copilot how to get started >: https://github.com/copilot

What’s included

  - 2,000 intelligent code completions a month. Get context-aware code suggestions that draw context from your GitHub projects and VS Code workspace.
  - 50 Copilot Chat messages a month. Ask Copilot for help understanding code, refactoring something, or debugging an issue.
  - Choose your AI model. Pick between Claude 3.5 Sonnet or OpenAI GPT-4o.
  - Make changes to multiple files with Copilot Edits. Tackle changes across multiple files with Copilot Edits.
  - Support for the Copilot Extensions ecosystem. Access third-party agents designed for tasks such as querying Stack Overflow or searching the web with Perplexity.
  - Choose where you build. Enjoy support in VS Code and across GitHub.

So, what will you build?

P.S. - Not sure where to start? Try these Copilot Chat prompts >: https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/example-prompts-for-github-copilot-chat

Copilot Settings

GitHub Copilot will show code suggestions that match public code including code references in the VS Code and github.com experience: https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/using-github-copilot/finding-public-code-that-matches-github-copilot-suggestions
GitHub and affiliates may use your data for product improvement. You can adjust both data use and public matching code suggestion settings in your Copilot Settings: https://github.com/settings/copilot.

Privacy policy: https://docs.github.com/articles/github-privacy-statement
Terms of use: https://github.com/customer-terms/github-copilot-product-specific-terms
Contact us: https://github.com/contact

emails.subject:
Introducing Kiln Search Tools: Build a RAG system in 3 minutes (plus
 Synthetic Data Gen V3)
emails.body:
Build a state-of-the-art AI Search/RAG system in just 3 minutes with our new drag-and-drop builder.

Kiln Logo ( https://kiln.tech )

*Search Tools, Documents & RAG*

We're excited to launch our biggest project ever: Kiln Search Tools ( https://docs.kiln.tech/docs/documents-and-search-rag ). Simply drag and drop your documents into Kiln to build state-of-the-art RAG systems (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) that enhance your AI tasks with custom search capabilities.

Highlights include:

* *Easy to get started* : just drop in documents, select a template configuration, and you're up and running in a few minutes. We offer several one-click templates for state-of-the-art RAG pipelines.
* *Highly customizable* : advanced users can customize all aspects of the RAG pipeline to find the ideal RAG system for their data. This includes the document extractor, chunking strategy, embedding model/dimension, and search index (vector/full-text/hybrid).
* *Wide Filetype Support* : Search across PDFs, images, videos, audio, HTML, and more using multi-modal document extraction
* *Document Library* : Manage documents, tag document sets, preview extractions, and sync across your team — all from an easy-to-use UI.
* *Team Collaboration* : Documents can be shared with your team via Kiln’s Git-based collaboration
* *Deep Kiln Integrations* : Works with Kiln's evals, dataset, AI providers, tool calling, and more

Check out the docs & search documentation ( https://docs.kiln.tech/docs/documents-and-search-rag ) for everything you need to get started.

This is just the start! RAG is a complex problem with many design choices. Kiln will keep adding more options, keeping it easy for those new to AI, while giving powerful options to those who want to go deep on optimization. If you have feature requests, please let us know on our Discord ( https://kiln.tech/discord ).

Rag-and-drop ( https://docs.kiln.tech/docs/documents-and-search-rag )

*Synthetic Data Generation V3*

We also just launched a new update to Synthetic Data Generation! The V3 update makes several improvements to our data gen system:

* New step-by-step guidance on the synthetic data generation process
* More curation options: preview model outputs before saving

Invitation to join the Editorial Board of Journal of Electrical and
 Electronic Engineering
emails.body:
Journal of Electrical and Electronic Engineering
e-ISSN: 2329-1605p-ISSN: 2329-1613
Dear Li, HT; Song, WQ; Zhao, L; Guo, S...; Huang, L,
With over 300 open-access journals representing various disciplines, this
platform offers a global outlet for sharing your research endeavors. For
the past ten years, these over 180 journals have consistently contributed
to scholarly discourse.
Covering various topics in electrical and electronic engineering, Journal
of Electrical and Electronic Engineering (e-ISSN: 2329-1605) is a global
journal published on this platform.
Joining as Editorial Board Members/Reviewers
Having been deeply impressed by your published article "A Vine-Copula
Method for Outlier Identification in Photovoltaic Arrays", we are happy to
make an invitation to you to apply to join our Editorial Committee/Reviewer
Team. It is expected that if you could join as our team member, you would
play a significant part in maintaining the journal's quality.
You can refer to the following link to know more about us:
http://www.joeaeeng.com/jy/wrsTC0
The quality of the Editorial Board/Reviewer Team largely embodies the
quality of the Journal. Listed below are several of the Editorial Board
Members and Reviewers of *Journal of Electrical and Electronic Engineering*.
Assist. Prof. Hashim Elshafie
Department of Computer Engineering, College of Computer Science, King
Khalid University, Abha, Saudi Arabia
Prof. Hsin-Yuan Chen
Center for Digital Technology Research and Innovation, Zhejiang University,
Hangzhou, China
Assoc. Prof. Tripuresh Joshi
Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering, Tula's Institute,
Dehradun, India
Dr. Huajiang Peng
College of Electronics and Information Engineering, Sichuan University,
Chengdu, China
Prof. Wenping Ge
Department of Elecrical Engineering, Xinjiang University, Urumqi, China
Dr. Ayodeji Olanite
Department of Electrical Engineering, University of Oklahoma, Norman,
United States
Aԁvantagеs of Becoming a Member of the Editorial Board/Reviewer Team

   1. Accumulating rich scientific experience.
   2. Get a Certificate in acknowledgment of the contributions made by you
   to our journal.
   3. Allowing your name to be shown on the official website of our journal.
   4. Having access to up-to-date academic findings and keeping yourself up
   to date with progress in your research area.
   5. Get connected with more peers in your field.

Title of your published paper is A Vine-Copula Method for Outlier
Identification in Photovoltaic Arrays and the abstract: To improve the
operational efficiency and reliability of photovoltaic power stations, this
paper introduces a novel approach to detect outliers in photovoltaic arrays
using a Vine-Copula method. The procedure is divided into two distinct
phases. Initially, it identifies deviations in the direct current (DC)
component of the photovoltaic (PV) system. The following phase extends this
by pinpointing irregularities in the DC voltage of the array. To model the
interconnection between the PV current, irradiance, and temperature, the
Vine-Copula is employed in this process. The optimisation of this function
is based on the Akaike information criterion. Subsequently, a conditional
probability model for the PV current is developed along with a formula to
determine the quantile of this probability. This interval is then employed
as the primary metric for detecting and eliminating current deviations.
After refining the current data, a similar approach is taken to address
voltage irregularities. The results of the simulation tests indicate that
this proposed method is more effective, showing lower error rates and
higher accuracy in detecting outliers, compared to other methods.
We really hope you can join us. Please kindly let us know your idea.
Assistant from Editorial Office of *Journal of Electrical and Electronic
Engineering*
Prefer not to receive future marketing? Unsubscribe
<http://www.joeaeeng.com/us/wrsTC0>

emails.subject: Why can “right” decisions turn out to be so wrong?
emails.body:
https://www.16personalities.com/auth/login?email=2645471525@qq.com&utm_source=campaign&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=smart-people&utm_content=logo

Have you ever made a decision that felt right in the moment, but proved wrong later on?

Maybe you thought it through, analyzed it from every angle, and convinced yourself it was the best choice – only to realize afterward that your thinking had led you astray.

That’s the paradox of intelligence: the same mental habits that guide us can also blind us.

Under pressure, the very patterns that make us strong thinkers can turn into hidden fallacies.

Every personality type has its own version of this – a core strength that doubles as a blind spot. And when that happens, it doesn’t just shape how we think, but the choices we make.

Read about your type below – then stick around for the others, too. You might recognize your partner’s habits, see why that colleague gets under your skin, or finally understand the choices your best friend keeps making.


** Analysts
------------------------------------------------------------
https://www.16personalities.com/personality-types?utm_source=campaign&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=smart-people&utm_content=analysts#analysts

INTJ (Architect): Your ability to envision long-term strategies can make the ideal (read flawless and theoretical) plan more appealing than the imperfect one that actually works. When a vision is so clear in your mind, it’s easy to let your intelligence convince you it must be right. But reality often has other plans.

INTP (Logician): Your gift for seeing endless variables can turn every decision into an equation that never quite resolves. You can argue both sides so convincingly that action stalls – while someone else has already tried, failed, adjusted, and succeeded before you’ve finished calculating.

ENTJ (Commander): Because answers appear so clearly to you, it can be baffling when others can’t see them. That clarity can lead you to design systems that assume others will execute at your level – and frustration follows when they can’t keep pace with your mental leaps.

ENTP (Debater): Your ability to see every angle means you can build an airtight case for almost anything – staying in a relationship you’ve outgrown, defending a job that drains you, or pursuing an idea long past its expiration date. Sometimes, your clever reasoning can override what your instincts already know: it’s time to move on.


** Diplomats
------------------------------------------------------------
https://www.16personalities.com/personality-types?utm_source=campaign&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=smart-people&utm_content=diplomats#diplomats

INFJ (Advocate): Your gift for spotting patterns can become a trap when you start treating possibilities as certainties. You sense where things are headed, so you make choices based on that imagined future – walking away from something good because you’re sure it will sour, or holding onto something bad because you see its potential. Intuition is powerful, but it isn’t infallible.

INFP (Mediator): Your talent for building meaningful frameworks can sometimes become a way to rationalize what you already want. You’ll find the one perspective or principle that makes a heart-driven choice look perfectly logical. The risk isn’t poor reasoning – it’s using your reasoning to disguise what’s really just a gut decision.

ENFJ (Protagonist): Your ability to see people’s potential is one of your greatest strengths – but it can also lead you astray. You may make decisions based on who someone could become rather than who they are right now. A hire, a relationship, an investment in growth – all can disappoint if you bet too heavily on the future version instead of the present one.

ENFP (Campaigner): Your gift for finding meaning and connections everywhere can sometimes lead you off course. You notice patterns, coincidences, and synchronicities and take them as signs of what’s “meant to be.” But seeing meaning doesn’t always mean you’ve found direction – sometimes it’s just your imagination running ahead of the evidence.


** Sentinels
------------------------------------------------------------
https://www.16personalities.com/personality-types?utm_source=campaign&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=smart-people&utm_content=sentinels#sentinels

ISTJ (Logistician): Your excellent memory for what has failed before can sometimes work against you. When a new opportunity resembles a past mistake, you may dismiss it outright – even if circumstances have changed. What once was risky might now be worth pursuing.

ISFJ (Defender): Your desire to maintain harmony often leads you to put others first. You can rationalize self-sacrifice as the sensible choice, but neglecting your own needs eventually undermines the very people you’re trying to support. Sometimes caring for yourself is the smarter way to care for others.

Lead Our Journal as Editor-in-Chief
Dear Li, HT; Song, WQ; Zhao, L; Guo, S...; Huang, L,
Spanning a wide array of disciplines, the platform offers researchers a global platform through its 300+ open-access journals to share their research. Over 115 journals have upheld a decade of steady publication, showcasing their dedication to knowledge dissemination.
Covering various topics in electrical and electronic engineering, Journal of Electrical and Electronic Engineering (e-ISSN: 2329-1605) is a global journal published on this platform.
 
Apply to Be the Editor-in-Chief
Your research paper "A Vine-Copula Method for Outlier Identification in Photovoltaic Arrays" has left a deep impression on us, so we’d like to invite you to apply to become the Editor-in-Chief. We believe that to have you as our team member will definitely bеnеfіt the scientific community.

Introducing Kiln Agent Builder (plus Local RAG!)
emails.body:
Build agentic systems in as little as 5 minutes. Also new: Local RAG which doesn't require third party services.

Kiln Logo ( https://kiln.tech )

*Kiln Agent Builder*
Kiln now supports building agentic systems! You can build agent systems with subtasks, tools and memory. All in under 5 minutes.

For example, you can build a team of agents to write blog posts with:

* A writer agent that composes content
* A web-researcher agent that searches the web and summarizes results
* A review agent to check the quality of the content
* A coordinator to orchestrate the team

The terms "agent" and "agentic" are often overloaded. The good news is that Kiln supports everything you need for powerful agents. Learn more about each agentic skill in our docs:

* Tool Use ( https://docs.kiln.tech/docs/agents#tool-use )
* Multi-Actor Interaction (aka subtasks) ( https://docs.kiln.tech/docs/agents#multi-actor-interaction-aka-subtasks )
* Goal Directed, Autonomous Looping & Reasoning ( https://docs.kiln.tech/docs/agents#goal-directed-autonomy-and-reasoning )
* State & Memory ( https://docs.kiln.tech/docs/agents#state-and-memory )

*Context Management Made Easy*
Context management is the process of curating the model's context (chat history) to ensure it has the right data, at the right time, in the right level of detail to get the job done.

Dividing your tasks into subtasks with Kiln's new subtask feature makes context management easy. Each subtask can focus within its own context, then compress/summarize for the parent task. This can make the system faster, cheaper and higher quality. See our docs on context management ( https://docs.kiln.tech/docs/agents#context-management ) for more details.

Context Management ( https://docs.kiln.tech/docs/agents#context-management )

*Local Search Tools (RAG)*
When we added RAG (Retrieval-augmented generation) last release, one of the top requests was to be able to build a RAG system completely locally, privately, without any third party services. Well, now you can! We've added a range of open-weight and local models in our new release:

* *Extraction models* (vision models which convert documents into text for RAG indexing): Qwen 2.5VL 3B/7B/32B/72B, Qwen 3VL and GLM 4.5 Vision
* *Embedding models* : Qwen 3 embedding 0.6B/4B/8B, Embed Gemma 300M, Nomic Embed 1.5, ModernBert, M2 Bert, E5, BAAI/bge, and more

*Deploying Kiln RAG into Production*
We've published a new guide and code for deploying RAG Search Tools built in Kiln, into production. You have several options including our MCP server and custom LlamaIndex deployments.

Deploying a Kiln RAG Search Tool ( https://docs.kiln.tech/docs/documents-and-search-rag#deploying-your-rag )

*Kiln v0.22.0 App Release*
Download the new v0.22.0 app release to get the features above, plus new models like Sonnet 4.5, GLM 4.6, GLM 4.5 Vision, Mistral Medium 3.1, Qwen 3 VL, Qwen 2.5 VL.

Download Kiln ( https://kiln.tech/download )

*Get Help or Contribute*
We're an open-source project and we really appreciate community feedback and support! Some ways you can help:

* Share Kiln ( https://kiln.tech/ ) with friends and co-workers
* Star our repo on GitHub ( https://github.com/Kiln-AI/Kiln ) or help by filing/fixing issues ( https://github.com/Kiln-AI/Kiln/issues )
* Join our Discord ( https://kiln.tech/discord ) for feedback or help

Thanks for all your support!
Steve - Kiln Maintainer
steve@kiln.tech

You are receiving this email because you subscribed to updates about the Kiln AI GitHub project ( https://github.com/Kiln-AI/Kiln ). You can unsubscribe with the link below if you no longer wish to receive email from us.

emails.subject: Why INFP leaders disappear when teams need them most
emails.body:
https://www.16personalities.com/auth/login?email=2645471525@qq.com&utm_source=campaign&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=leadership-challenges-infp&utm_content=logo


** Why INFP leaders disappear when teams need them most
------------------------------------------------------------

As an INFP (Mediator) (https://www.16personalities.com/auth/login?email=2645471525@qq.com&utm_source=campaign&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=leadership-challenges-infp&utm_content=intro) , you bring deep empathy and authentic values to leadership. You create space for people to be themselves and build cultures where meaning matters.

But when leadership demands decisions, confrontation, or speed, your greatest strengths can turn into trapdoors. You retreat inward right when your team needs you most.

Here are five challenges INFP leaders might face – see if you recognize yourself.

https://www.16personalities.com/auth/login?email=2645471525@qq.com&utm_source=campaign&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=leadership-challenges-infp&utm_content=scene

1. Rehearsing the conversation so thoroughly that you never actually have it

You’ve imagined how the difficult conversation could go at least seven different ways. You’ve considered their feelings, your feelings, the perfect phrasing that won’t hurt anyone.

Meanwhile, the problem you needed to address three weeks ago has gotten worse.

Your team isn’t wondering if you’ve thought about it enough – they’re wondering if you even noticed. All that careful consideration becomes avoidance masking as thoughtfulness.

2. Giving so much weight to tiny moments that you miss what people actually mean

Someone was short with you in a meeting, so you spend the afternoon analyzing what you did wrong. You read entire narratives into small interactions – a delayed email response, a facial expression, the way someone said “fine.”

But while you’re building elaborate stories about what things might mean, you’re missing what people are actually trying to tell you directly. Your sensitivity creates clarity in some moments and total distortion in others.

3. Caring so deeply about everyone’s potential that you can’t see who they are now

You see what people could become with the right support, the right environment, or the right opportunity.

It’s a beautiful quality – until it prevents you from making necessary decisions. You might keep someone in a role they’re struggling with because you believe in their future growth. Or you avoid hard conversations because you don’t want to damage someone’s confidence.

But leading people where they could be instead of where they are doesn’t help anyone grow. It just delays reality.

4. Searching for the choice that honors every value until you’ve honored none of them

Your internal value system is intricate and deeply felt. When a decision conflicts with even one of those values, it feels wrong. So you wait, hoping a perfect option will appear that satisfies everything you believe in.

But leadership rarely offers pristine choices. Sometimes the decision that respects your team’s autonomy conflicts with your commitment to their well-being. Sometimes being kind means being direct.

The perfect choice you’re waiting for doesn’t exist, and the delay is its own decision.

5. Withdrawing to process when your team needs you to be present

When things get tense or complicated, your instinct is to retreat inward and think it through. It’s how you make sense of complex situations.

The problem? Your team interprets your absence as disapproval, avoidance, or abandonment. They don’t know you’re carefully considering the situation – they just know you went quiet right when things got hard.

Leading means sometimes processing out loud, even when you haven’t figured everything out yet.

Assist. Prof. Jayeshkumar Chelabhai PrajapatiDepartment of Electronics and
Communication Engineering, Government Engineering College-Patan, Patan,
India
Peer Reviewers of *JEEE*
Gurpurneet KaurDepartment of Electronics and Communication Engineering,
Guru Nanak Dev Engineering College, Ludhiana, Ludhiana, India
Assist. Prof. Pravin PatilDepartment of Electronics and Telecommunication
Engineering, D.N.Patel College of Engineering, Shahada, India
Assist. Prof. Snehal GaikwadDepartment of Electronics and Telecommunication
Engineering, Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Technological University, Raigad, India
Assist. Prof. Thangavel MuruganDepartment of Information Systems and
Security, United Arab Emirates University, Al Ain, United Arab Emirates

Detailed abstract of your article (A Vine-Copula Method for Outlier
Identification in Photovoltaic Arrays): To improve the operational
efficiency and reliability of photovoltaic power stations, this paper
introduces a novel approach to detect outliers in photovoltaic arrays using
a Vine-Copula method. The procedure is divided into two distinct phases.
Initially, it identifies deviations in the direct current (DC) component of
the photovoltaic (PV) system. The following phase extends this by
pinpointing irregularities in the DC voltage of the array. To model the
interconnection between the PV current, irradiance, and temperature, the
Vine-Copula is employed in this process. The optimisation of this function
is based on the Akaike information criterion. Subsequently, a conditional
probability model for the PV current is developed along with a formula to
determine the quantile of this probability. This interval is then employed
as the primary metric for detecting and eliminating current deviations.
After refining the current data, a similar approach is taken to address
voltage irregularities. The results of the simulation tests indicate that
this proposed method is more effective, showing lower error rates and
higher accuracy in detecting outliers, compared to other methods.

emails.subject:
New in Kiln: RAG Q&A Evals, Tool Use Evals, Reranking, Semantic
 Chunking, a MCP server, and more
emails.body:
Evaluating RAG just got easier—generate reference-answer datasets in minutes, plus reranking & semantic chunking

Kiln Logo ( https://kiln.tech )

Hi everyone 👋 — We just added some powerful features to Kiln!

*RAG Evals: Built with Synthetic Q&A Data From Your Docs*
Evaluating RAG or agents using RAG is tricky. An LLM-as-judge doesn't have the knowledge from your documents, so it can't evaluate if a response is correct. But giving the judge access to RAG biases the evaluation.

The solution: reference-answer evals. The judge compares results to a known correct answer. Building these datasets used to be a long manual process… until now.

Kiln now builds Q&A datasets for evals by iterating over your document store. The process is fully interactive and takes just a few minutes to generate hundreds of reference answers from your documents. Use it to evaluate RAG accuracy end-to-end, including whether your agent calls RAG at the right times with quality queries. Learn more in our docs ( https://docs.kiln.tech/docs/evaluations/evaluate-rag-accuracy-q-and-a-evals )

*Tool Use Evals: The Right Tool At the Right Time*

It doesn't matter how well a tool works if it isn't invoked when needed. Kiln now includes a new eval for tool use that checks:

* A tool is called when needed
* A tool isn’t called when it shouldn’t be
* The parameters passed to the tool are correct

Appropriate Tool Use Eval Docs ( https://docs.kiln.tech/docs/evaluations/evaluate-appropriate-tool-use )

*RAG Reranking*

RAG reranking refines your search output by sorting and trimming it, so the LLM sees only the most relevant information.

To add reranking in Kiln, select a reranking option when creating a new search tool:

*RAG Semantic Chunking*

Semantic chunking splits your documents into chunks by meaning rather than length. This improves retrieval accuracy and ensures relevant content is returned to LLMs.

To use semantic chunking in Kiln, select a semantic chunking method when creating a search tool:

*Kiln MCP Server: Agents and RAG*

You can now deploy Kiln agents and RAG search tools as a MCP server, letting you integrate Kiln projects into other AI tools. *Learn More* ( https://docs.kiln.tech/docs/tools-and-mcp#kiln-mcp-server )

*Kiln v0.23.0 App Release*

Our new v0.23.0 app release includes all the features above, plus:

* *All of the feature above*
* *Visual Schema Builder* : define complex tool schemas in an interactive UI
* *New Models* : MiniMax M2, Kimi K2 Thinking, Qwen3 VL
* *And more* : embedding models on OpenRouter, fixed Vertex fine-tuning bug, more deterministic OpenRouter routing, and dozens of other improvements

Download Kiln ( https://kiln.tech/download )

emails.subject: Help build cline-bench + new models to try in Cline
emails.body:
+ hooks & Cline is the 2nd fastest OSS project

Hello!

A quick update on some things we have been working on: (1) a new benchmark initiative, (2) a set of models to try in Cline (including a free one), (3) a new feature for injecting custom logic into Cline, and (4) a recognition from GitHub as one of the fastest growing OSS projects.

1) cline-bench: help build a real world benchmark for agentic coding

We just announced cline-bench, a real world open source benchmark for agentic coding built from actual engineering tasks where frontier models failed and humans had to step in.

Each task becomes a reproducible RL environment using the Harbor framework, complete with a repo snapshot, real prompt, and ground truth tests. Labs, researchers, and open source teams can use these for evals, training, and studying real failure modes in coding agents.

You can contribute by using the Cline Provider on open source repos while opted in, or by making manual contributions from challenging OSS projects you work on. We are committing $1M in Cline Open Source Builder Credits to support contributors, particularly those working on commercial OSS.

Details: https://dxGnp504.na2.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/UF+113/dxGnp504/VWt0mF3_HrMmW2TZYWL9dh3tDW1RGk9h5G7P3DN4sL4c-3lcq-W6N1vHY6lZ3mnN1H79YjlqC9wW69gp6z3p2ym1N43jdK0PM0GDW27kWms1kgfkmW6VH5wz7lTWl7W6cg56K463d-2W3_3Jd74VZS9tW7r7YRm3RtvzzVsBmY45HqBTLVBhZtx5LzxRpW3ZJ2ry66hG3ZW5pjm916r7nYgW5ggPbY8xrtDvW1RbWjJ2csY-_W8BCV21120JTvW72nlw-4b-3pMW6c-DLt3G73J-W6mP1wM31sLZTW2Fngqc1txxHVW59D-_H2m2NMlVQYcTM5n8C5vW4HNk0N1J0GLdf58l-Bq04

2) New models to try in Cline

Three new models just came out recently, and each have different strengths you can try in Cline:

Gemini 3 Pro: (https://dxGnp504.na2.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/UF+113/dxGnp504/VWt0mF3_HrMmW2TZYWL9dh3tDW1RGk9h5G7P3DN4sL4c-3lcq-W6N1vHY6lZ3m6W2znWhk92P0zkN3bKLgmprg83W7W0K6k8lsrLgW8K51Bx2dTf18W8f27K94HPwc2N3Kfksv_FHgqW96DTzk6tkbZ8W7zJ0M56K-_31W1jdv1H1_jYZPW7gK_c_1Srt83W45Q_bM80Ys8qW8tq6255kl1ztW4rz68-1wRvn7W699Y6Z2C2XcdN5ZrZv_lJstJW5gbKVB9fbLN7W6w744S1CHbsRW1bynHP5dD5vLW5g-m1h7t1gGZVqYxQJ6PMC4dW7_G6H-7tn4nyW6pPzkd1xfD3Ff8vzBtT04 ) with a massive context window (1M tokens) and SOTA reasoning, this is the model to use for long-running tasks that span many files. It gives Cline the headroom to maintain context over extended sessions without losing the thread.

OpenAI’s GPT-5.1: (https://dxGnp504.na2.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/UF+113/dxGnp504/VWt0mF3_HrMmW2TZYWL9dh3tDW1RGk9h5G7P3DN4sL4c-3lcq-W6N1vHY6lZ3k_T5W7P4rst9QW51sJNh1w09Z4V5Zq-B1Lp4YvW76CPml6GZqwxW77tM6y1gYsrFW33Bvqw1xh5svW2LLM906g2ymlN64vbtVRK6W5W74kPzw7ftj-nN8WF4Z7LXwM6W4qwR8w48zFQmVQ_4kF6gW57vW731_2F7sxg0XW156RdP4WmjxpW181_4s18NT2SW5w3XRZ5LKrjdVQvGYG2hZcZrW1dmD1X6THr_TVpC1gx3fMklTW9h9Bpj43y2n8W21Fwlw1w-g7TW3ZQHK_6fPD-rf1xcpYs04 ) This model behaves like an obsessive researcher. It responds extremely well to structure and `/deep-planning`, making it ideal for complex architectural changes where you want a thorough plan before writing a single line of code.

MiniMax M2: A very capable open model that is now free to use via the Cline provider. It’s a great daily driver for standard tasks and a low-risk way to experiment with agentic coding. We also chatted with their research team about how they are building for code: https://dxGnp504.na2.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/UF+113/dxGnp504/VWt0mF3_HrMmW2TZYWL9dh3tDW1RGk9h5G7P3DN4sL4c-3lcq-W6N1vHY6lZ3m4W7Qqb9d8NRv9hW4NJ8q98FNGWrW6_bWMD4ZMRYBW9jwmDJ47bD9qW4TS7sY8NS8JLW1vc2nD5N3_yQN6RC2BgdV-_0W5knvJY70VYBfW1TptzX6sDyHxN7tp61Pz9xtBVNqtg890Bcj9N1XCCbJPf6yKW29C1sd6T1Qk-W3QvM5L2YRQRnW564gXt7rcT4wVjjh774S0MKsW1bNFCh3Gddt1W68gvJH4zk2QkW5Xhj7-5m8XgQVKLtlW3J2KgQW62Q85h8R_cZsW7T36228JdQkQf8bnpWR04 \&t=4s

We track "diff edit" performance closely for all these models. Diff edits are how Cline makes surgical, targeted changes to your code (using `replace_in_file`) rather than rewriting entire files. High reliability here means the agent applies changes correctly on the first try while applying a diff.

Lower is better (showing failure rate), and you can see how the new models compare:

3) Hooks: wire Cline into the rest of your workflow

We recently introduced Hooks, which let you inject custom logic into Cline's workflow at specific events (docs here (https://dxGnp504.na2.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/UF+113/dxGnp504/VWt0mF3_HrMmW2TZYWL9dh3tDW1RGk9h5G7P3DN4sL4c-3lcq-W6N1vHY6lZ3lwF4yV7HtqJrnW4vLlZP8cDSKGW6LbVqk34DHPSW3zVhKv2TnR0bW6SJSHT4PscJGW2CzFTg4BYZ-HVH2LNd53ns06W2LfMNC4QskgmW6Zgb7m3yWsWYN8thF-TwRy6rW4PYY9J8p3Q0zN3HxVTkY3xyYW6Cydz8636cbqW6_s2hl3P96hKV6w4YK23NzrgN4R5PNXP3wdpW1KfCfQ2ngs6zN3ntBcJMqb9LN8rNgb-ZWHw6W4nPz7F1R6RfDW1GvJTk6s2Cr4W716yj55nzjX4dG6bhT04 ) ).

Hooks are executable scripts that trigger at specific workflow moments like PreToolUse, PostToolUse, UserPromptSubmit, TaskStart, TaskResume, and TaskCancel. Each hook receives JSON about what Cline is doing at that moment and can decide whether to allow it, modify context for the next requ

The prize pool is $20,000+ in cash, plus job interviews and swag. Cline is one of the core "Infinity Stones" alongside Kestra, Vercel, Oumi, and CodeRabbit. We're specifically looking for people to build projects on top of the Cline CLI, and if you've been curious about extending Cline or building automation workflows around it, this is your chance. If you're looking to build something with Cline over the holidays, this is a good excuse.

Register: WeMakeDevs Hackathon (https://dxGnp504.na2.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/UF+113/dxGnp504/VWLzZD6TYkCnW3xvQdM5kbf6qW4dVnpw5GJRMpN99fz8z3lcq-W69sMD-6lZ3pNV9v2Kg6C0y-7W4KCfRC6TlskWW3PPKSX3x52DVW8VTz7d1QDN2HW7RKcNh8dm6GJW5--cBn1GTtxYVF5w5J5dZwZ9W6cDvzN8-BM0nW3XbnzW3P7CQFW53zR6n5XNnrYN51Xr9chkdVtN87jwcdJg1chW1J-wxj3dqjMBW82svjZ5YNt4DN4zSKszM-hwVW2f7t6t3-TJD_W21Vr8V7lxjXNW2Tklz883lRFtW83XddR4RVh-4W8tFh7R9llTHQf4JD7Rn04 )

New Feature: /explain-changes

The bottleneck in software development has shifted. Writing code used to be the hard part. With coding agents like Cline, you can generate multi-file changes in seconds. The hard part now is understanding what was done. Explain Changes closes that gap.

After Cline completes a task with file changes, you'll see an "Explain Changes" button alongside the "View Changes" button. Click it, and Cline opens the multi-file diff view with inline explanations streaming in as comments. These aren't summaries in a sidebar or chat responses you have to scroll through. The explanations appear as comments placed exactly where the changes are, walking through what changed and why.

Because Cline has the full conversation context, the explanations go beyond describing what the code does. They explain the reasoning behind the decisions.

Read more: Explain Changes blog post (https://dxGnp504.na2.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/UF+113/dxGnp504/VWLzZD6TYkCnW3xvQdM5kbf6qW4dVnpw5GJRMpN99fz8T3lcq-W6N1vHY6lZ3mVW7Z6ydl5HJRxvW20VVyM6v4RFhW8NLVPK11d4TyW5vsTgY7RjzNhW2MnGSP8mc2D4N3DfvS8DjnqQW12XNCL7_tMvkW4c97RY8CqtnxW6gnY-n48Tv4CW8VQ9b27XnPqwW3t7KK_1JqMCzW6P_kRv5_RT7yN8SwSpHXgd5TW4mDXXK3b7lmQW6s5KvB7mlwC3W6WxQNN686SsDW4LGCzk43tqm1W4qpn0c2X_HkyW8wzhlx8B1vMTW5Sddvd4Q5jQzW9754P57TPWv0W2wY1wL70sNNFf1L4DJz04 )

Introducing cline-bench

We're launching cline-bench, an open source benchmark designed to evaluate AI models on real-world engineering tasks rather than synthetic puzzles or LeetCode-style problems.

The benchmark draws from actual failures encountered when developers use the Cline Provider on open source projects. When a model struggles or requires manual intervention, those tasks become candidates for inclusion as reproducible RL environments.

The goal is to give the research community realistic evaluation criteria that reflect day-to-day software development. Model labs can identify genuine capability gaps and train better coding agents. Participation is opt-in through the Cline Provider dashboard, with full attribution for contributors whose tasks are selected.

To support this, we're committing $1M in sponsorship credits for open source maintainers who contribute challenging real-world tasks. We already have endorsements from leaders at OpenAI, Nous Research, Mistral AI, and Prime Intellect.

Read more: cline-bench initiative (https://dxGnp504.na2.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/UF+113/dxGnp504/VWLzZD6TYkCnW3xvQdM5kbf6qW4dVnpw5GJRMpN99fz8T3lcq-W6N1vHY6lZ3m6W80XhXr55C4jlW4P8fHY39vfTVW1Yb0Y238znzPW81xc3v72PYyrN7w5v56BBgQbW5jcRrQ8kRq90V7cMjC43tN0sW9bM_-b28t2lHN6Dq8w55hsG2W5l54hy6L8BLsW4JT-Gx1m-SjjW4n4Cy95p8SXgW7XDj9x5ll7ycVWTT3C1xc7hTW11XrvW6PcKSBW2Kck4J8Fxvf_N18RJv0cpJYSW7pbs6Y1MlpTsW9kWr4-74kFnKW1D7qZD3D4PCzN6NddtbLfYNxW3J8wMC8jTym9f5P8TTn04 )

emails.body:
亲爱的智谱大模型开放平台用户，


今天，我们正式上线并开源 GLM-4.6V 系列视觉理解大模型，这是 GLM 系列在多模态方向上的一次重要迭代！


🧾 模型版本：

  • GLM-4.6V（106B）：旗舰版，API 调用价格较 GLM-4.5V 下降 50%！
  • GLM-4.6V-Flash（9B）：轻量版，完全免费调用


📖 快速开始资源：

  • GLM-4.6V 使用指南
  • GLM-4.6V 接口文档


✨ 亮点概览：

  • 同规模SOTA表现：在 30+ 主流多模态评测基准上进行了验证，较上一代模型取得显著提升。在同等参数规模下，模型在多模态交互、逻辑推理和长上下文等关键能力上取得 SOTA 表现。
  • 原生工具调用：GLM-4.6V 原生支持基于视觉输入的工具调用，能够将“视觉感知”与外部系统互动无缝衔接，极大扩展了其在电商、内容创作、智能导购等场景中的应用。
  • 128k 上下文窗口：视觉上下文窗口扩展至 128K Tokens，支持长视频流处理和高分辨率多图分析，完美适配长文档、长视频等高信息量任务。
  • Coding 体验提升：即日起融入 GLM Coding Plan 视觉理解 MCP，此次升级针对用户 8 大类场景定向开发了专用工具，大幅提升前端页面复刻、代码修复与调试、图表问答等 Coding 场景常见任务效果。👉 立即解锁全新的多模态能力



智谱大模型开放平台

emails.body:
*International Journal of Modern Research in Engineering and Technology*



*Open Access, Peer Reviewed, International Journal, Secured Website*





*www.ijmret.org <http://https://ijmret.org/>                     **ISSN:
2456-5628                     editor@ijmret.org <editor@ijmret.org>*



*International Journal of Modern Research in Engineering and Technology *is
a peer reviewed online journal for professionals and researchers in the
field of computer science. The main aim is to resolve emerging and
outstanding problems revealed by recent social and technological change.
IJMRET provides the platform for the researchers to present and evaluate
their work from both theoretical and technical aspects and to share their
views.





*We request you to submit your papers on or before **December 2**0 2025.*



*Paper Submission Deadline   –   20th December 2025*

*Acceptance / Rejection Notification –   5 to 6 days*

*Paper Online Publication   –       30th  December 2025*



From this site you can easily download different research papers and read
them. This site also contains the different useful formats of research
paper widely acceptable which will help you to write a good paper.

 *http://www.ijmret.org/archives.html <http://www.ijmret.org/archives.html>*



*Subject list*

*Manuscripts that is suitable for IJMRET is following as and it is not only
within this subjects*

* Computer Science, *Neural Networks* Electrical Engineering* Software
Engineering* Mechanical Engineering* Information Technology* Chemical
Engineering* Plastic Engineering* Food Technology* Textile Engineering*
Nano Technology & Science* Power Electronics* Electronics & Communication
Engineering* Computational mathematics* Image processing* Civil Engineering





*Professor/Researcher can send your research paper to: editor@ijmret.org
<editor@ijmret.org> *





***You can forward this mail to your colleagues or friends.*

Lead Our Journal as Editor-in-Chief
emails.body:
Apply Now for Editor-in-Chief Role
Dear Li, HT; Song, WQ; Zhao, L; Guo, S...; Huang, L,
The platform's 300+ open-access journals provide researchers with a global
outlet to share their work across a diverse range of disciplines. More than
180 journals have been consistently releasing content for a decade.
Journal of Electrical and Electronic Engineering (e-ISSN: 2329-1605) is an
international journal available on this platform, addressing various
subjects related to electrical and electronic engineering.
Lead as the Editor-in-Chief by Submitting Your Application
Having been left a deep impression by your previous research article "A
Vine-Copula Method for Outlier Identification in Photovoltaic Arrays", we
would like to extend an invitation to you to apply to join as
Editor-in-Chief. We think your contribution will definitely bring Ьenefіts
to the scientific community.
If you are considering applying for the position of Editor-in-Chief, we
invite you to send your application via:
http://www.joeaeeng.com/ec/wigK30
To Be the Member of the Editorial Board/Reviewer Team
If the idea of being the Editor-in-Chief is not currently appealing to you,
we warmly welcome you to join our editorial team.
If you are interested in becoming a part of our editorial board members or
reviewers, please submit your application via:
http://www.joeaeeng.com/jy/wigK30

The level of the Editorial/Reviewer Team largely reflects the quality of
the Journal. Listed below are several of the Editorial Board Members and
Reviewers of *Journal of Electrical and Electronic Engineering*.
Assoc. Prof. Sichao Du
College of Information Science and Electronic Engineering, Zhejiang
University, Hangzhou, China
Assoc. Prof. Tripuresh Joshi
Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering, Tula's Institute,
Dehradun, India
Lingqiang Zhao
School of Power and Energy, Northwestern Polytechnical University, Xi'an,
China
Dr. Luis Pires
School of Eneginner and Technology (EET), Polytechnic University of
Lusofonia (IPLuso), Lisbon, Portugal
...
Requirements for Prospective Editors-in-Chief
Candidates should match the following profile:

   1. Proficiency in academic English, especially in writing.
   2. A minimum requirement is ten years' worth of professional experience
   in research and publishing.
   3. A minimum of 10 publications in peer-reviewed journals is required.
   4. The role demands terminal degree attainment (PhD) or equivalent
   senior research credentials.


Title of your paper is A Vine-Copula Method for Outlier Identification in
Photovoltaic Arrays and the detailed abstract: To improve the operational
efficiency and reliability of photovoltaic power stations, this paper
introduces a novel approach to detect outliers in photovoltaic arrays using
a Vine-Copula method. The procedure is divided into two distinct phases.
Initially, it identifies deviations in the direct current (DC) component of
the photovoltaic (PV) system. The following phase extends this by
pinpointing irregularities in the DC voltage of the array. To model the
interconnection between the PV current, irradiance, and temperature, the
Vine-Copula is employed in this process. The optimisation of this function
is based on the Akaike information criterion. Subsequently, a conditional
probability model for the PV current is developed along with a formula to
determine the quantile of this probability. This interval is then employed
as the primary metric for detecting and eliminating current deviations.
After refining the current data, a similar approach is taken to address
voltage irregularities. The results of the simulation tests indicate that
this proposed method is more effective, showing lower error rates and
higher accuracy in detecting outliers, compared to other methods.
Prefer to stop receiving emails? Unsubscribe
<http://www.joeaeeng.com/us/wigK30>

emails.body:
A post was added to the topic 顾问专属中文论坛.
(https://support.worldquantbrain.com/hc/en-us/community/topics/18910956638743-%E9%A1%BE%E9%97%AE%E4%B8%93%E5%B1%9E%E4%B8%AD%E6%96%87%E8%AE%BA%E5%9D%9B)

- 【 代码优化】如何解决限流429报错的问题 by XB37939
前言
近期调用api时经常提示api limit，status_code == 429，这就是api限流了。限流后会导致获取不到results，导致代码报错。
比如get_datafields方法datafields_list.append(datafields.json()['results'])时报错


解决方案
添加重试机制即可解决限流问题

代码
核心代码：

    for x in range(0, count, 50):
        datafields = s.get(url_template.format(x=x))
        #如果状态是429
        while datafields.status_code == 429:
            print("status_code 429, sleep 3 seconds")
            time.sleep(3)
            datafields = s.get(url_template.format(x=x))
        datafields_list.append(datafields.json()['results'])

普通重试机制，一直循环直到执行成功：

def get_datafields(
    s,
    instrument_type: str = 'EQUITY',
    region: str = 'USA',
    delay: int = 1,
    universe: str = 'TOP3000',
    dataset_id: str = '',
    search: str = ''
):
    if len(search) == 0:
        url_template = "https://api.worldquantbrain.com/data-fields?" +\
            f"&instrumentType={instrument_type}" +\
            f"&region={region}&delay={str(delay)}&universe={universe}&dataset.id={dataset_id}&limit=50" +\
            "&offset={x}"
        count = s.get(url_template.format(x=0)).json()['count']
       
    else:
        url_template = "https://api.worldquantbrain.com/data-fields?" +\
            f"&instrumentType={instrument_type}" +\
            f"&region={region}&delay={str(delay)}&universe={universe}&limit=50" +\
            f"&search={search}" +\
            "&offset={x}"
        count = 100
   
    datafields_list = []
    for x in range(0, count, 50):
        datafields = s.get(url_template.format(x=x))
        #如果状态是429
        while datafields.status_code == 429:
            print("status_code 429, sleep 3 seconds")
            time.sleep(3)
            datafields = s.get(url_template.format(x=x))
        datafields_list.append(datafields.json()['results'])
 
    datafields_list_flat = [item for sublist in datafields_list for item in sublist]
 
    datafields_df = pd.DataFrame(datafields_list_flat)
    return datafields_df
进阶代码，重试五次，失败即失败

def get_datafields(
    s,
    instrument_type: str = 'EQUITY',
    region: str = 'USA',
    delay: int = 1,
    universe: str = 'TOP3000',
    dataset_id: str = '',
    search: str = ''
):
    if len(search) == 0:
        url_template = "https://api.worldquantbrain.com/data-fields?" +\
            f"&instrumentType={instrument_type}" +\
            f"&region={region}&delay={str(delay)}&universe={universe}&dataset.id={dataset_id}&limit=50" +\
            "&offset={x}"
        count = s.get(url_template.format(x=0)).json()['count']
       
    else:
        url_template = "https://api.worldquantbrain.com/data-fields?" +\
            f"&instrumentType={instrument_type}" +\
            f"&region={region}&delay={str(delay)}&universe={universe}&limit=50" +\
            f"&search={search}" +\
            "&offset={x}"
        count = 100
   
    datafields_list = []
    for x in range(0, count, 50):
        datafields = s.get(url_template.format(x=x))
        retrycount=5
        #如果状态是429
        while datafields.status_code == 429 and retrycount > 0:
            print("status_code 429, sleep 3 seconds")
            time.sleep(3)
            datafields = s.get(url_template.format(x=x))
            retrycount-=1
        datafields_list.append(datafields.json()['results'])
 
    datafields_list_flat = [item for sublist in datafields_list for item in sublist]
 
    datafields_df = pd.DataFrame(datafields_list_flat)
    return datafields_df

 总结
世界上唯一不变的就是变，代码也不是一成不变的，要与时俱进，不断优化。
希望大家可以不断的优化代码，提高效率，早日进阶，多赚dollar

emails.subject: [顾问专属中文论坛] IND RA 如何开始开始？
emails.body:
A post was added to the topic 顾问专属中文论坛.
(https://support.worldquantbrain.com/hc/en-us/community/topics/18910956638743-%E9%A1%BE%E9%97%AE%E4%B8%93%E5%B1%9E%E4%B8%AD%E6%96%87%E8%AE%BA%E5%9D%9B)

- IND RA 如何开始开始？ by XD81759
由于IND-D1无法提交PPA，只能提交狭义的RA，且换手率限制在40以下、有额外的robust universe Sharpe test，因此提交难度相对较大。在此，从以下几个方面给予大家一些或许可行建议，抛砖引玉~
 
一、数据选择
 
我11月10日对国区datafield的使用做了个统计，由此发现了一些可能对大家有帮助的建议。本期聚焦IND RA，为新手、老手、高手推荐合适的data。

Alphas%代表所有地区，该数据类别产生的alpha占比，后三列都是指IND-D1。
 
推荐新手从model、pv、other这三个数据类别做起，他们最容易出货；进一步，探索analyst、fundamental、imbalance、institutions、risk这五个数据类别，他们的出货率已经得到了验证。
 
推荐老手在完成基础数据类别的探索后，尝试earnings、insiders、option这三个数据类别，他们虽然困难，但已有顾问成功。由于相关性较低，或许更易提交。
 
推荐高手挑战broker、macro、sentiment、shortinterest、socialmedia这五个数据类别，对于国人来说他们还是无人区，您的探索将给予大家信心，树立新的丰碑。
 
二、模版选择
 
建议先ASI提交过的alpha在IND-D1中回测，将信号明显的alpha抽象成模版，相信这些模版的出货效率会比其他模版更高。

emails.subject: [顾问专属中文论坛] MCP与模板两手抓——IND困难户探索出的2种出货方法
emails.body:
A post was added to the topic 顾问专属中文论坛.
(https://support.worldquantbrain.com/hc/en-us/community/topics/18910956638743-%E9%A1%BE%E9%97%AE%E4%B8%93%E5%B1%9E%E4%B8%AD%E6%96%87%E8%AE%BA%E5%9D%9B)

- MCP与模板两手抓——IND困难户探索出的2种出货方法 by PM90725
为了响应IND theme，也搞了几天IND，但即使参考了论坛中各位顾问的经验也还是没能手搓成功。这两天尝试了各种方法，其中有2种成功做出了pc<0.5的ra，在此分享一些小经验。
1. MCP微调
论坛中其他顾问的经验非常宝贵，但是交给我的话，一是我可能没充分理解文章内容，二是我没有那么多耐心做很多次调整。所以我挑选了我认为有用的内容交给MCP，让它帮我优化。那么你需要准备：

一个指标差一点点的alpha（Robust universe Sharpe或Weight Concentration不达标），我给的是一个Weight Concentration不达标的

给MCP的“攻略”，这里我选了2篇：关于IND地区Robust universe sharpe的改善方法，【哥布林】基于IND Region的Regular Alpha古法手搓技巧。

然后就可以给MCP下达任务。这次用的是cursor的Auto，我的指令：

这个alpha QPXLalzQ的IS指标中有一个FAIL，请参考以下2篇文章：@forum_post_36371597455127.md @forum_post_36222781155607.md 帮我优化这个alpha直至达到提交标准：sharpe>=1.58; fitness>=1; turnover>=1%; turnover<=40%; sub-universe sharpe>0.57; robust universe sharpe>=1; 2 year sharpe>=1.58; weight concentration<=10%
每次回测执行一个MCP调用`create_simulation`。其余设置参考原alpha。

经过37轮优化后，成功把alpha调整为可提交的状态：

2. 动量/反转策略
逛论坛的时候看到的一个不错的模板 一个改进的动量/反转策略的模板 ，让MCP帮我推荐了几个数据集，测试了一批213产出了1个可提交的。这次使用的是KILO CODE+gemini cli+Gemini 2.5 Pro
 
一些想法：

这里只是抛砖引玉一下，记录我成功的两种方法，这2个alpha其实也算不上各项指标很好，各位可以自行发挥，相信还有更多可以做出好alpha的工作流。
MCP从推出以来，也是一直在用，论坛上各种工作流也总在尝试，就是从来没成功过()，这次也算是个人的里程碑了。还是鼓励大家多用AI，摸索出属于自己的经验。

View the post
(https://support.worldquantbrain.com/hc/en-us/community/posts/36772513152663-MCP%E4%B8%8E%E6%A8%A1%E6%9D%BF%E4%B8%A4%E6%89%8B%E6%8A%93-IND%E5%9B%B0%E9%9A%BE%E6%88%B7%E6%8E%A2%E7%B4%A2%E5%87%BA%E7%9A%842%E7%A7%8D%E5%87%BA%E8%B4%A7%E6%96%B9%E6%B3%95)

emails.subject: [顾问专属中文论坛] 【Alpha 模板】基于情感数据的IND模板
emails.body:
A post was added to the topic 顾问专属中文论坛.
(https://support.worldquantbrain.com/hc/en-us/community/topics/18910956638743-%E9%A1%BE%E9%97%AE%E4%B8%93%E5%B1%9E%E4%B8%AD%E6%96%87%E8%AE%BA%E5%9D%9B)

- 【Alpha 模板】基于情感数据的IND模板 by LZ29996
S1=ts_mean(ts_backfill({sentiment},250),22);# 月平均情感分数
R1=ts_product(1+returns,22); # 月度收益率，本来应该是ts_product(1+returns,22)-1，没有-1不影响结果。
alpha=ts_quantile(S1-R1,5,driver=’cauchy’);# 归一化并加重极端值的权重，使用gaussian也可以。
 
// alpha idea:做多情感分数相对于收益高的股票，反之亦是。
// 初始setting:Region=IND,Universe=TOP500,Decay=10,Delay=1,Truncation=0.01,Neu=Industry,
// Pasteurization=On,NaN Handing=Off
// 迭代:{sentiment}使用与sentiment相关的datafiled。
 
和sentiment相关的datafiled可以通过以下代码获得：
def get_datafields(s,searchScope,dataset_id:str='',search:str=''):
    instrument_type=searchScope['instrumentType']
    region=searchScope['region']
    delay=searchScope['delay']
    universe=searchScope['universe']
    if len(search)==0:
        url_template="https://api.worldquantbrain.com/data-fields?"+\
            f"&instrumentType={instrument_type}"+\

            f"&instrumentType={instrument_type}"+\
            f"&region={region}&delay={str(delay)}&universe={universe}&search={search}&limit=50"+\
            "&offset={x}"
        count=s.get(url_template.format(x=0)).json()['count']
    
    datafields_list=[]
    for x in range(0,count,50):
        while True:
            try:
                datafields=s.get(url_template.format(x=x))
                datafields_list.append(datafields.json()['results'])
                break
            except:
                time.sleep(1)
 
    datafields_list_flat=[item for sublist in datafields_list for item in sublist]

return datafields_df

emails.subject: [顾问专属中文论坛] 【大角羊】使用tags管理已提交ra的pyramid-开箱即用版
emails.body:
A post was added to the topic 顾问专属中文论坛.
(https://support.worldquantbrain.com/hc/en-us/community/topics/18910956638743-%E9%A1%BE%E9%97%AE%E4%B8%93%E5%B1%9E%E4%B8%AD%E6%96%87%E8%AE%BA%E5%9D%9B)

- 【大角羊】使用tags管理已提交ra的pyramid-开箱即用版 by AL13375
在我看来，已提交的alpha是个人的专属宝藏。它们应该被挖掘利用，而不是已提交就让任不管，实在是太可惜了。
对于已提交的regular alpha和power pool alpha，可以考虑从以下几个方面来挖掘剩余价值：

横向点塔：比如将USA中成功点塔的数据集也放到其他地区去跑，一般也会有不错的信号；
更换模板：将出信号的alpha所在的数据集用在其他好用的模板中，也可以挖掘出不错的alpha；
换中性化

所以我写了一段代码来实现对已提交的alpha分析其点亮的pyramid并将其增添到tags中（只增加不改变原tags），这样就可以在网页上通过tags筛选某数据集下的alpha了。代码如下：

import requestsimport jsonimport timefrom collections import defaultdictdef login():    from os.path import expanduser    with open(expanduser('brain_credentials.txt')) as f:        credentials = json.load(f)    username, password = credentials    # Create a session to persistently store the headers    s = requests.Session()    # Save credentials into session    s.auth = (username, password)    # Send a POST request to the /authentication API    response = s.post('https://api.worldquantbrain.com/authentication')    print(response.content)    return sdef get_submited_alphas(s,start_date, end_date, alpha_num, region):    output = []    count = 0    for i in range(0, alpha_num, 100):        print(i)        url="https://api.worldquantbrain.com/users/self/alphas?limit=100&offset=%d" % (i)\            + "&status!=UNSUBMITTED%1FIS-FAIL&type=REGULAR" \            +"&dateSubmitted%3E=" + start_date +"T00:00:00-04:00&dateSubmitted%3C" + end_date +"T00:00:00-04:00&order=-dateSubmitted&hidden=false"        if region:            url+="&settings.region="+region        while True:            result = s.get(url)            if "retry-after" in result.headers:                time.sleep(float(result.headers["Retry-After"]))            else:                break        res=result.json()        alpha_list = res["results"]        for j in range(len(alpha_list)):            alpha_id = alpha_list[j]["id"]            name = alpha_list[j]["name"]            dateCreated = alpha_list[j]["dateCreated"]            sharpe = alpha_list[j]["is"]["sharpe"]            fitness = alpha_list[j]["is"]["fitness"]            turnover = alpha_list[j]["is"]["turnover"]            margin = alpha_list[j]["is"]["margin"]            colour = alpha_list[j]["color"]            tags = alpha_list[j]["tags"]            decay = alpha_list[j]["settings"]["decay"]            neutralization = alpha_list[j]["settings"]["neutralization"]            pyramids = []            for sorf in alpha_list[j]["is"]["checks"]:                if sorf['name'] == "MATCHES_PYRAMID":                    for py in sorf['pyramids']:                        pyramids.append(py['name'].split("/")[-1])            count += 1            exp = alpha_list[j]['regular']['code']            rec = [alpha_id, exp, sharpe, turnover, fitness, margin, dateCreated, decay,neutralization,tags,colour,pyramids]            output.append(rec)    print("count: %d" % count)    return output

region=Nonealpha_num=2000s = login()alphas = get_submited_alphas(s,"2024-01-01", "2025-12-31", alpha_num, region)

alpha_details=[[i[0],i[-1],i[-3]] for i in alphas]

alpha_format=defaultdict(list)for i in alpha_details:    alpha_format[i[0]]=list(dict.fromkeys(i[1] + i[2]))

for i,j in alpha_format.items():    response = s.patch("https://api.worldquantbrain.com/alphas/" + i, json={"tags": j})
 
我相信从已提交alpha中还能挖掘出更多有价值的信息，也欢迎各位大佬分享自己的观点！

View the post
(https://support.worldquantbrain.com/hc/en-us/community/posts/36514602805399--%E5%A4%A7%E8%A7%92%E7%BE%8A-%E4%BD%BF%E7%94%A8tags%E7%AE%A1%E7%90%86%E5%B7%B2%E6%8F%90%E4%BA%A4ra%E7%9A%84pyramid-%E5%BC%80%E7%AE%B1%E5%8D%B3%E7%94%A8%E7%89%88)

emails.subject: [顾问专属中文论坛] 【关于SA的思考】存在数据缺失的alpha可以用在SA中吗？
emails.body:
A post was added to the topic 顾问专属中文论坛.
(https://support.worldquantbrain.com/hc/en-us/community/topics/18910956638743-%E9%A1%BE%E9%97%AE%E4%B8%93%E5%B1%9E%E4%B8%AD%E6%96%87%E8%AE%BA%E5%9D%9B)

- 【关于SA的思考】存在数据缺失的alpha可以用在SA中吗？ by CL86067
——来自一个刚开始学习SA的量化小白，算是新人学习super alpha过程的一点疑问和思考，发出来看看能不能抛砖引玉一下
一·疑问怎么来的
       说到这个就必须说一下刚开始接触到SA必须面对的问题了，那就是怎么把用户阶段提交的alpha给踢出选择范围？读了文档和社区的一些帖子，都没找到合适的答案，最后搜索了一下才在一个同学的分享帖子和另外一个帖子评论区里找到了可能解决办法：
1：(own)&&not(in(competitions, 'challege'))&&(dataset_count <= 10) * (1)    类似这样
测试这个似乎不太行，不知道为什么明明是not，结果select出来全是用户阶段alpha，有点奇怪😓
2：prod_correlation > 0，这个测试可以解决，确实用户alpha没有PC
     然后继续学习中发现只用自己的一点alpha组SA太难了，PC很难达标，更别提实现大佬们说的三五SA了，后面就刷论坛各种尝试，结果有一次没有剔除用户alpha出来了个只有5年数据的SA，但是sharp和fitness都4点多，似乎有点接近三五了，汗，然后我就有点冲动的提交了，虽然后面就后悔了，vf估计要爆炸😓
     但是后面我突然就有了如题的疑问，数据缺失的alpha对SA真的没有价值吗？因为RA只是单一因子，部分数据缺失会导致参考价值下降好多，但是对于由多个alpha构建成的SA，会不会有不一样的结论呢？感觉大家应该也会想过这个问题，不知道大家怎么看的呢？
二·我的一些不专业的思考和想法
       首先，从概率论和统计学角度而言，样本数据更完善对概率的计算有很大意义，但是对于多个不同样本数据同时作为样本数据综合计算时，单一样本的数据完整性的重要性开始下降，数据的多方面性质都需要考虑，比如数据多样性也是重要参考，所以我在想合理数量的缺失但是更独特数据，会不会在对冲下可能提升概率的参考价值呢？就像组SA时加入一点存在数据缺失的alpha，会不会也不全是负面影响，毕竟有些数据集中的字段就是数据缺失字段，但是这些数据集肯定也是有意义的。
      其次，感觉数据缺失alpha的使用对组SA有好几个可能的好处：

 一是可以帮助降相关性，毕竟这种alpha低相关性的可能性比较大，大家都不太敢交
二是可以增加SA数据集选择上的多样性，这种alpha主要出在一些特定数据集，感觉也可以给SA带来更多可能性，为SA构建带来更多方向
三是可能可以用于SA的调优，如果有只是数据部分缺失但是各项指标很好的alpha，用在SA调优会不会也有点帮助

三·总结
      以上不过就是一个量化小白学习中冒出的一点想法，对于平台的一些规则和SA的构建原理等也不太懂，不知道这点想法是不是完全错的，欢迎各位大佬们批评指正，尴尬，好像冒出这点想法主要就是目前能选的alpha太少了，一个地区的更少了，就想着能不能把用户阶段的凑合用一下😅
     祝大家天天进步，VF节节高！

emails.subject: [顾问专属中文论坛] 因子复现日记：操作符复现（1）【传奇耐打王系列二】
emails.body:
A post was added to the topic 顾问专属中文论坛.
(https://support.worldquantbrain.com/hc/en-us/community/topics/18910956638743-%E9%A1%BE%E9%97%AE%E4%B8%93%E5%B1%9E%E4%B8%AD%E6%96%87%E8%AE%BA%E5%9D%9B)

- 因子复现日记：操作符复现（1）【传奇耐打王系列二】 by FX25214
大家好啊，传奇耐打王又来了。
这次我给大家带来了一个新的系列——因子复现日记。以后我也会不定期分享复现因子的整个操作流程。本期是一期非常简单易懂的操作符复现。
作为一个gold，在操作符上实在没有话语权。但是看到一些大佬分享的优秀因子又特别眼馋。咋办呢？心动不如行动，只能自己尝试着复现啦。
Weijie老师说的好：如果你把论坛上所有的东西都学会了，那你就是大佬。既然看着别人的因子眼馋，又有ppa的权利，何乐而不为呢？我们不能仅限于眼前的操作符。也要学会自己构建具有复杂功能或者说具有高级功能的操作符。
话不多说，现在我们请出今天的主角因子：

首先，这个因子缺了两年的数据，但是在10年的表现上，只有两年不达标，且达标的年份均为充分达标
加上当时传奇耐打王想点亮USA的Macro这个塔，就想把这个因子据为己有了。
天公不作美，我没有ts_ir这个操作符。
我就找了一位高段位大佬，让他把这个操作符的定义发给我。我们一起来看看：

我们看到，这是一个简单的时间序列上的均值与标准差的比值。这不就是我们熟悉的IR——信息比率吗？
我查看该字段的描述：

我们了解到：oth551_resret_qual 表示 QUAL 相对于其基准指数的每日残差收益，用于剔除市场整体变动后的质量因子独立表现。
那这个因子就是为了先用ts_quantile 提取长期极端残差收益行为，然后再用ts_ir来计算这个长期的信息比率，最后再进行分组的标准化。这么一看还真是挺有意思的。
恰恰好ts_mean和ts_std_dev我都有。那我们就来简单的复现一下：

我先不加分组的标准化，诶？首先可以肯定的是，这个复现是成功的。信号也相当的不错，似乎不加分组的中性化，虽然夏普降低了，但fitness、return、margin都有提升呢。
这时候我再加上分组的中性化进行回测比对结果：

我们欣喜的得到了一模一样的结果。
这个因子最终我优化成这样交了，惊喜的发现竟然还是一个ra，看来是成功的超越了分享这个因子的佬的sharpe的百分之十，也算是对我认真复现因子的赏赐。尤其我们还可以看到，原本负的两年现在只剩下一年了，且这个2015年有数据的部分非常少，我们可以当成一个回撤来微笑看待：


虽然这样导致最终这个因子使用了六个操作符，对于我可怜的六维来说并不是一件好事情。但是一个因子的复现成功，尤其是一个操作符的复现成功，会给我带来莫大的鼓励，就好比告诉我现在我的权限提升了，拥有了一个新的操作符。同时，其他佬分享的用到信息比率操作符的因子，我也可以开心的据为己有了。
如果你认为操作符复现如此简单，那你可能小看我们的世坤平台了。接下来我将带来更加困难的操作符复现。
如果大家想看这个因子是如何优化的，请献上你们宝贵的赞。越多的赞将越快鼓励传奇耐打王开启新的系列——因子手搓优化系列。我想这一定是大家都想要的。
最后希望各位佬们也可以在评论区分享自己复现操作符的经验之谈。无论成功或失败，对于传奇耐打王来说都是一笔宝贵的财富。
祝各位佬vf1.0，combine节节高！

View the post
(https://support.worldquantbrain.com/hc/en-us/community/posts/36596968893591-%E5%9B%A0%E5%AD%90%E5%A4%8D%E7%8E%B0%E6%97%A5%E8%AE%B0-%E6%93%8D%E4%BD%9C%E7%AC%A6%E5%A4%8D%E7%8E%B0-1-%E4%BC%A0%E5%A5%87%E8%80%90%E6%89%93%E7%8E%8B%E7%B3%BB%E5%88%97%E4%BA%8C)

emails.subject: [顾问专属中文论坛] 使用MCP构建SA
emails.body:
A post was added to the topic 顾问专属中文论坛.
(https://support.worldquantbrain.com/hc/en-us/community/topics/18910956638743-%E9%A1%BE%E9%97%AE%E4%B8%93%E5%B1%9E%E4%B8%AD%E6%96%87%E8%AE%BA%E5%9D%9B)

- 使用MCP构建SA by XY50888
我是使用windsurf搭配mcp来使用的，之前就是windsurf的付费用户，已经习惯使用它了。
而且使用得早，现在每月付费是9.9刀，收费和trae一样，可用模型比较多，而且它还经常推出很多免费的模型可以使用，非常不错。
我之前使用mcp构建了几个工作流，譬如更新描述，这个大家最常用。还有提交alpha（修改了代码）还有数据集探索工作流，今天修改了部分代码，然后使用mcp开始回侧SA,因为刚成为顾问不久，积累的alpha数据量不多，之前都是手搓SA。
之前一直不懂SA,后来慢慢明白，SA的两部分内容，selection 就是选择你的RA（gold用户） 相当于选股。combo 表达式就是 对选择的股票分配仓位。

stats = generate_stats(alpha); innerCorr = self_corr(stats.returns, 500); ic = if_else(innerCorr == 1.0, nan, innerCorr); maxCorr = reduce_max(ic); 1 - maxCorr

) -> Dict[str, Any]:
"""

creation date, submission date, and visibility. It also supports pagination and custom sorting.

stage (str): The stage of the alphas to retrieve.

- "OS": Out-of-Sample (alphas that have been submitted).

For example, `limit=50` will return at most 50 alphas. Defaults to 30.
offset (int): The number of alphas to skip from the beginning of the list.
Used for pagination. For example, `limit=50, offset=50` will retrieve alphas 51-100.
Defaults to 0.
start_date (Optional[str]): The earliest creation date for the alphas to be included.
Filters for alphas created on or after this date.
Example format: "2023-01-01T00:00:00Z".
end_date (Optional[str]): The latest creation date for the alphas to be included.
Filters for alphas created before this date.
Example format: "2023-12-31T23:59:59Z".
submission_start_date (Optional[str]): The earliest submission date for the alphas.
Only applies to "OS" alphas. Filters for alphas submitted on or after this date.
Example format: "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z".
submission_end_date (Optional[str]): The latest submission date for the alphas.
Only applies to "OS" alphas. Filters for alphas submitted before this date.
Example format: "2024-06-30T23:59:59Z".
order (Optional[str]): The sorting order for the returned alphas.
Prefix with a hyphen (-) for descending order.
Examples: "name" (sort by name ascending), "-dateSubmitted" (sort by submission date descending).
hidden (Optional[bool]): Filter alphas based on their visibility.
- `True`: Only return hidden alphas.
- `False`: Only return non-hidden alphas.
If not provided, both hidden and non-hidden alphas are returned.
color (Optional[str]): Filter alphas based on their color.
region: (Optional[str]): EUR/ASI/USA/IND/GLB settings.region
type: (Optional[str]): SUPER/REGULAR

Returns:
Dict[str, Any]: A dictionary containing a list of alpha details under the 'results' key,
along with pagination information. If an error occurs, it returns a dictionary with an 'error' key.
"""
try:
return await brain_client.get_user_alphas(
stage=stage,
limit=limit,
offset=offset,
start_date=start_date,
end_date=end_date,
submission_start_date=submission_start_date,
submission_end_date=submission_end_date,
order=order,
hidden=hidden,
color=color,
region=region,
type=type,
)
exceptExceptionase:
return {"error": str(e)}

emails.subject: [顾问专属中文论坛] 如何在 macOS/Linux 上以命令行方式安装运行 MCP？
emails.body:
A post was added to the topic 顾问专属中文论坛.
(https://support.worldquantbrain.com/hc/en-us/community/topics/18910956638743-%E9%A1%BE%E9%97%AE%E4%B8%93%E5%B1%9E%E4%B8%AD%E6%96%87%E8%AE%BA%E5%9D%9B)

- 如何在 macOS/Linux 上以命令行方式安装运行 MCP？ by ST63725
命令行的方式简洁明了，不涉及 VS Code 等 IDE。
假设 macOS/Linux 系统上已经有了 Python。
第一步，先建一个虚拟环境，以避免 Python 包的版本冲突。这里推荐的工具是uv，安装的方法是：
pip install uv
创建并激活虚拟环境：
uv init mcpcd mcpuv venv  --python=3.12source .venv/bin/activate
第二步，安装 MCP。
uv pip install cnhkmcp -i https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simplepushd .venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/cnhkmcp/untracked/APPuv pip install -r requirements.txt -i https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simpleuv pip install openai -i https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simplepopdln -s .venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/cnhkmcp/untracked/APP/Tranformer/output .
第三步，运行 MCP。
输入Worldquant Brain 的注册邮箱和密码并保存。
cd ..nano user_config.json
文件的第三行 email，第四行password。
运行 MCP：
cd APPuv run 运行打开我.py
第四步，在浏览器里访问 http://127.0.0.1:5000。

第五步，访问并配置运行“七十二变”。
点击左侧的按钮“七十二变”，选择“Web 界面”。

从上到下，依次操作。
先配置模型，以默认的模型为例。"LLM Model Name” 和 “LLM Base URL”已经默认填好。
https://www.moonshot.cn/，注册新用户，有 15 元的免费使用额度。
在 https://platform.moonshot.cn/console/api-keys "新建 API Key"，将 API Key 粘贴到 "LLM API Key"。
点击下面的绿色按钮"Test LLM Connection"，显示"Connection Successful!"，证明模型可以使用了。
注意：如果选择其他模型，"LLM Model Name"、"LLM API Key" 和 "LLM Base URL" 要同步修改为新模型的这三个参数。
下面，输入 Worldquant Brain 的账号和密码。
再下面的"Alpha ID"，填入一个你成功提交的因子的 ID。
可以调整默认的数量 50，测试可以选择一个较小的数字，比如 5。
点击最下面的蓝色背景按钮 "Run Transformer"开始生成。
右侧会显示日志。
运行结束后，日志下会显示：
Generation Complete!​Download Alpha_candidates.json
生成的数据在mcp/output/目录下。

View the post
(https://support.worldquantbrain.com/hc/en-us/community/posts/36836297909399-%E5%A6%82%E4%BD%95%E5%9C%A8-macOS-Linux-%E4%B8%8A%E4%BB%A5%E5%91%BD%E4%BB%A4%E8%A1%8C%E6%96%B9%E5%BC%8F%E5%AE%89%E8%A3%85%E8%BF%90%E8%A1%8C-MCP)

You are receiving this notification because you subscribed to updates in the topic "顾问专属中文论坛".

Please do not reply to this message. Email replies will not update Help Center content.
